title: NXT Builds to Cruz vs Lennox Main Event
raw_title: WWE NXT Coverage: Dame Vs Diggs, Dusty Road Tag Classic Continues, Grayson Waller And Tony D’Angelo Face Off Ahead Of Halloween Havoc
body: DMFirst Veer Game odds uden om ROFUS Jalwa Game Goa Game Raja Game MaanWin WWE NXT COVERAGE: DAME VS DIGGS, DUSTY ROAD TAG CLASSIC CONTINUES, GRAYSON WALLER AND TONY D’ANGELO FACE OFF AHEAD OF HALLOWEEN HAVOC By Eric Lewis on 2026-10-20 20:27:00 Welcome to PWInsider’s coverage of WWE NXT on The CW Network in the U.S. and on Netflix here in Canada and around the globe. Thanks to Mike Johnson for filling in for me last week! The show opens right away with a serious narrated promo for tonight’s main event, Cruz Montana versus DarkState leader Dion Lennox. The match was put over as a clash of personalities and upbringings. They cut briefly to Cruz and Dion each arriving at the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, FL, then we’re inside the arena, and Tony D’Angelo is on his way to the ring with something to say. Vic Joseph and Booker T are on the call. Grayson reminds the NXT audience that he and Tony entered WWE right around the same time. They’ve teamed together and had similar career arcs, but they’ve never really faced off. Grayson said he looks forward to taking out Tony. Tony says Waller always resented him. Waller said he’s right. Tony was chosen, but it took Grayson longer to get the spotlight he deserves. Tony says Waller still hides behind one-liners and memes because he’s desperate for attention. “You’re just a troll!” Waller said it’s called having a personality, but Tony left his personality in the fedora he used to wear. We cut to the women’s locker room earlier in the day, where Izzi Dame is upset because apparently Zaria packed up decorations Dame had set up at Zaria’s locker space. Skylar Rae and Layla Diggs ask Dame why she won’t simply leave Zaria alone. They assume it’s about the North American title. Dame says it’s not that simple. Diggs and Dame go back and forth, and we learn that they’ll have a match later that night. Vic Joseph begins to tell us what is in store for NXT tonight when suddenly BirthRight cuts in with a promo from outside the building. They say they’re going to win tonight in the Dusty Tag Team Classic. Match #1: Dusty Rhodes Tag Classic: Birthright’s Charlie Dempsey and Lexis King vs. AAA Tag Team Champions El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. & Galeno Joseph notes that Channing “Stacks” Lorenzo was injured on a Canadian tour over the weekend and is not cleared to compete, which is why he’s been replaced by his BirthRight stablemate Lexis King. Dempsey and Wagner start the match. It’s a technical fight at first. They’re trying to take each other down. This seems like Dempsey’s specialty, but they’re evenly matched. They each make tags. We see Hank and Tank backstage getting ready for their match later tonight. The other members of BirthRight get involved outside the ring. Ariana Grace distracts the referee, so Wagner leaps over the ref and nails a senton on King, Dempsey, and Uriah Connors on the outside. After a break, Dempsey has Wagner in an arm bar. He’s methodically wearing him down. The crowd is split between the two.

body: "I remember the guys there were telling me how impressed they were with Claudio, because Claudio would fly in there, and they would do these singles matches, and he would not get tired," Meltzer said. "And you know, the Mexicans don't get tired because they wrestle in that altitude. But a lot of the Americans have trouble." Castagnoli has not only shown no difficulty adapting to the elements in Arena Mexico, but has thrived there, winning the CMLL World Heavyweight Championship last fall and holding it for several months. Perhaps more impressively, Castagnoli was recently part of the CMLL International Gran Prix, and alongside fellow AEW/CMLL star Hechicero wrestled the entire match, which lasted a little less than seventy four minutes. CMLL's respect for Castagnoli is only matched by his own respect for the promotion, as Castagnoli became the first AEW star to sign a dual AEW/CMLL deal in March. In a recent interview, Castagnoli also referred to CMLL's homebase of Arena Mexico as his favorite wrestling venue to work in.

title: Syko Stu Recalls Raja Jackson Shoot Incident
raw_title: Syko Stu Details Incident With Raja Jackson
summary_src: At KnokX Pro on August 23, 2025, Raja Jackson, the son of Quinton “Rampage” Jackson, beat independent wrestler Syko Stu unconscious in a planned spot that went too far. Raja entered the ring and slammed Stu down, knocking him unconscious.
body: At KnokX Pro on August 23, 2025, Raja Jackson, the son of Quinton “Rampage” Jackson, beat independent wrestler Syko Stu unconscious in a planned spot that went too far. Raja entered the ring and slammed Stu down, knocking him unconscious. Raja then landed over 20 legitimate unanswered strikes to Stu’s head before independent wrestler Doug Malo pulled him off. “I don’t remember a lot of it. I do remember Raja coming backstage and he was filming. Usually you don’t film backstage like that. I know there was the can spot and I don’t remember too much after that. I do remember that we did call a finish and he was supposed to come in. I think he was going to give me one punch because of the can spot. It’s supposed to be a wrestling punch, but if he would’ve connected with it a little more, I could’ve sold it better. I don’t think anyone expected what was going to happen to happen,” he said. He stated that he doesn’t know why Raja took the beer can spot so personally, and that once he realized Raja wasn’t a worker, he admitted he was wrong and they came up with the angle. “I was out on the slam. I don’t remember anything. The match went really good until that. I don’t remember anything until, I believe it was Tuesday. I woke up in the hospital. I was in and out of consciousness the whole time. I woke up on Tuesday and saw some of the wrestlers. Rikishi was there and we were talking. I was just trying to recover,” he said. Stu noted that they wouldn’t show him the video or talk about it in the hospital. He said that his family was mad about what happened, but they remain a strong support group for him. He was discharged on Thursday after entering on Saturday. Stu said that he does a lot of word exercises as part of the rehab process, but it still affects his everyday life, as he’ll forget things five minutes later, will do things multiple times, and has forgotten names and faces. When asked about the statement where he said he forgave Raja, Stu replied, “That was a little bit out of context. What I actually said was, ‘I’m not holding a grudge.’ I never said anything about forgiveness. Everybody can learn something from this. I just didn’t want to hold a grudge because that brings the negative energy into it. When you have to let something go, it kind of helps you heal from it. As far as forgiveness, when we’re in the courtroom and I was reading that statement, I don’t think the LA Times heard the same statement that I read.” He said he doesn’t know what he would say to Rampage if he saw him today. Stu stated that he can physically wrestle, but he mentally can’t do it because he’s unable to remember matches and spots. He hasn’t wrestled since the incident and has been advised not to, but he would like to wrestle again. body: 0 WWE star Erik and his wife, former WWE wrestler Sarah Logan, have welcomed a new addition to their family. The War Raiders member shared the happy news on social media, marking another special milestone for the couple outside the wrestling ring. Erik, whose real name is Raymond Rowe, announced the arrival of their third child on Instagram on Tuesday, October 20. The couple also shared an update on how the mother and newborn are doing following the birth. Erik and Sarah, who previously performed in WWE under the names Sarah Logan and Valhalla, welcomed a baby girl named Dena Elizabeth Rowe. She was born at 2:13 p.m. local time, weighing nine pounds and measuring 21 inches long. The War Raiders star reassured fans that both his wife and their newborn were doing well. In his announcement, Erik wrote on Instagram , “Both mama and baby are healthy and safe.” He concluded the message with a heartfelt expression of gratitude, adding, “God’s gifts are truly endless.” Dena joins the couple’s two other children. Erik and Sarah welcomed their first child in February 2021 and their second in November 2024. The pair married in 2018 in a traditional Viking-themed ceremony, reflecting their shared connection to wrestling’s Viking-inspired presentation. Erik remains signed to WWE, where he teams with Ivar as part of The War Raiders. The duo have continued appearing on WWE programming, including SmackDown, and have also competed in AAA in recent months. Sarah, meanwhile, departed WWE in June 2025 after the company did not renew her contract. She later confirmed in February 2026 that she was stepping away from professional wrestling. body: Ilja Dragunov recently revealed that suffering panic attacks during his wrestling matches has become a consistent occurrence in his career. Recently, speaking to Ariel Helwani on The Ariel Helwani Show , Dragunov opened up about his experience with panic attacks. “ I still have that. Sometimes I have this very bad, sometimes I have it less, but it’s a consistent thing that is kind of a part of my life. “ But I came to the conclusion, and especially when you’re younger, you try to fix everything. You try to find the simple answer to complex questions, which the phrase itself explains that it’s not possible ,” he shared. “ Because it’s not only something negative. This kind of panic or this kind of feeling that I carry with myself is also letting me perform harder. It lets me put more effort and more devotion to what I’m doing. And it lets me love more,” he added. When asked by Helwani about his baddest panic attack, Dragunov answered, “ Well, that’s a good question. Well, I guess at least multiple times every week. I don’t even pay attention to it that much because, again, that’s what I said. I don’t try to be a polished person. “ As soon as I kind of accepted myself and saw the good sides of these things, because nothing is just black and white; there are a lot of gray areas, it gave me the option to deal with that way easier ,” he said. While Dragunov suffers panic attacks during matches, Helwani asked if he had faced something similar in the gorilla position before his matches. “ You accept. You try to go. I mean, the thing is, it gives me a lot of pride because I had this in the middle of a fight. I had this on my entrance. I had this seconds before where I felt like I was forgetting my whole match. “It’s the reason also I’m very proud of myself on certain days. It’s exactly that I never give in. I accepted it. I dealt with that. It made my performances for myself even more real ,” he finished. Done with WWE, Dragunov recently joined AEW and made his debut at WrestleDream 2026. body: The Hardys (Matt Hardy and Jeff Hardy) will have full creative control of the 10/13 TNA iMPACT taping. TNA Wrestling announced a very special night at the Dothan Civic Center on Tuesday, October 13, to mark the start of the 35 th year of Jeff and Matt Hardy as professional wrestlers. The wrestling legends, aka, The GOATs, have been given full creative control of that night’s show, which will air October 15, as Thursday Night iMPACT! on AMC, per TNA Director of Authority Santino Marella. Every element of the October 13 th show in Dothan will be orchestrated from the minds of Jeff & Matt. To celebrate this special anniversary night, every fan in attendance is encouraged to dress like Jeff or Matt from any era of their historic careers. The two best-dressed fans – one as Matt, one as Jeff – will be crowned the winners and be the first in line for the post-show meet and greet with the real Hardys. A special commemorative photo – of The Hardys and The Hardy Look-Alikes – will be taken and featured on TNA’s social media outlets and the TNA website. Special Hardy merchandise will be available exclusively at the Dothan shows to honor the Hardys’ 35 th year. The Hardys have held countless championships during their illustrious careers, which began on October 15, 1992, in North Carolina. They are recognised by fans, peers and media as the greatest tag team in professional wrestling history and are the only duo to have held the WWE/World, WCW, TNA, ROH, Raw and SmackDown Tag Team Championships. body: 0 Ilja Dragunov has finally addressed the backlash over his interaction with Brock Lesnar at the WWE Royal Rumble. That’s simply what would happen,” Dragunov explained. However, Ilja Dragunov believes running away would go against everything his character stands for. title: In Memoriam: AEW Star PAC’s Wife Called His Phone as Police Investigated His Death
raw_title: AEW Star PAC’s Wife Called His Phone as Police Investigated His Death
body: 0 Newly released medical examiner records have revealed further details about the final hours of AEW star PAC . This includes a heartbreaking moment when his wife, Natalie Taylor, tried calling him while authorities were investigating his death. The call came less than three hours after the couple had last spoken on September 27. According to a Cook County Medical Examiner report obtained by the New York Post , PAC, whose real name was Benjamin Satterley, was found unresponsive inside a rental car near a CAVA restaurant in Des Plaines, Illinois. Taylor called her husband’s cellphone after authorities arrived at the scene, but police answered instead. She told investigators that she had spoken with Satterley earlier that day. Moreover, he had explained his plans before heading out. “Satterley told his wife that he was stopping at the restaurant CAVA before heading to O’Hare Airport,” the report stated. Taylor also informed investigators that her husband had a previously diagnosed medical condition for which he had received medication. The specific condition was redacted from the documents. However, she told authorities that he had “no history of illicit drug or alcohol abuse.” The report noted that Satterley was discovered shortly before 4 p.m., slumped over in the driver’s seat of his running rental car. During the emergency call, the person who found him told dispatchers, “I don’t see his chest moving at all.” Toxicology testing did not reveal anything extraordinary. The medical examiner ultimately determined that PAC died from bronchial asthma and classified his death as natural. Inhalers were also found at the scene. Nevertheless, the report did not establish whether he utilized them during the medical emergency. PAC had wrestled Andrade at AEW All Out on September 26, the night before his death. He was 40 years old. Taylor later shared an emotional tribute on Instagram . She recalled the plans they had made for his return, including setting up his new home gym and spending time together. The report provides more detail about PAC’s final hours, but it does not establish whether he had time to use an inhaler before the emergency. title: Mickie James set to appear at TNA's Bound for Glory as incredible matches lined up on card
raw_title: Mickie James set to appear at TNA's Bound for Glory as incredible matches lined up on card
body: Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) legend Mickie James will appear at Bound for Glory next weekend as the company prepares for its biggest show of the year. During "Impact" on Thursday, TNA aired a vignette that showed an older logo on a crate. When the crate opened, a strong beam of light appeared. When the light went dark, a white cowgirl hat and a denim jacket appeared. A woman took the hat and placed it on her head. Wrestler Mickie James attends the 2013 Spike TV Guys Choice at Sony Pictures Studios on June 8, 2013, in Culver City, Calif. (WireImage) James’ "Hardcore Country" entrance theme played and fans knew exactly who was in the video. The legendary women’s wrestler had multiple stints in TNA. She joined the company initially in 2002 while TNA was under the National Wrestling Alliance banner. She worked there for about a year before moving to WWE . James returned to TNA in 2010, immediately getting into a feud with Madison Rayne. She defeated Rayne to win the TNA Knockouts Championship in April 2011, becoming the first woman in pro wrestling history to hold the TNA Knockouts Championship, WWE Women’s Championship and WWE Divas Championship. She’s a five-time Knockouts champion. She was also with the company from 2021 to 2023. Earlier this year, she battled the Elegance Brand at No Surrender and the "Impact" episodes afterward. Her appearance is just one of the many highlights set for Bound for Glory next week. The event takes place Sunday, Oct. 11, at the Yuengling Center in Tampa, Florida. There are four championships on the line, including a six-way scramble for the vacant TNA X Division Championship which will feature Fabian Aichner, KC Navarro, Cedric Alexander , Rich Swann, Ryan Nemeth and BDE; a Knockouts Championship match between Xia Brookside and Indi Hartwell; a four-way match for the TNA International Championship among Mustafa Ali, Jason Hotch, John Skyler and Special Agent Zero; and Nic Nemeth defending the TNA World Championship against Leon Slater. Elsewhere, Ricky Sosa will take on Eddie Edwards, Joseph Sawyer and Samuel Shaw go up against The Hardys in a Falls Count Anywhere match and a Call Your Shot Gauntlet will be held with the winner getting a future championship match. Mustafa Ali pins Jason Hotch to win the TNA International Championship at TNA Wrestling's Lockdown on Aug. 23, 2026. (TNA Wrestling) It will be a great weekend of professional wrestling, that’s for sure.

title: Injury Update: WWE NXT Star’s Return Timeline Revealed After Serious Injury
raw_title: WWE NXT Star’s Return Timeline Revealed After Serious Injury
body: 0 WWE NXT star Dorian Van Dux has received an update on his recovery from a serious injury. His tag team partner Sean Legacy revealed when doctors expect him to be cleared for in-ring action. The latest news offers a clearer picture of Van Dux’s road back after an extended absence from competition. Legacy shared the update during a backstage segment on the October 20 episode of NXT , where he was speaking with several members of the roster. During the segment, Legacy spoke with Romero Moreno, E.K. Prosper, Chazz “Starboy” Hall, Noam Dar, and Saquon Shugars. He revealed that doctors told him Van Dux should be cleared to compete in approximately two months. This timeline enables a potential return around December 2026. Van Dux was initially sidelined after suffering a punctured lung in September. The injury followed an attack by BirthRight, the faction consisting of Lexis King, Uriah Connors, and Channing “Stacks” Lorenzo, which had targeted Van Dux and Legacy during their ongoing rivalry. There was some positive news on September 27, when Van Dux was announced as medically cleared to compete. However, another backstage attack involving BirthRight on the October 6 episode of NXT created a further setback, and the team was subsequently removed from the Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic. Van Dux last competed on September 15 , leaving Legacy without his regular partner as their issues with BirthRight continued. The latest medical update suggests that the wait for their reunion in the ring could last several more weeks. The two-month timeline is based on what Legacy said doctors had relayed to him. WWE has not provided further medical details in the supplied information. Moreover, the update does not confirm a specific return date. For now, Van Dux’s recovery remains the key factor in his return to NXT competition. If the expected timeline holds, December could bring him another opportunity to get back in the ring and resume his partnership with Legacy — a comeback worth keeping on the radar. title: Legal Watch: WWE NXT Ends in Chaos as Cruz Montana Gets Arrested After Dion Lennox Match
raw_title: WWE NXT Ends in Chaos as Cruz Montana Gets Arrested After Dion Lennox Match
body: This week, Montana and Lennox wasted no time getting physical after the bell rang. Lennox landed a big right hand and a spinebuster, while Montana responded with a sit-out powerbomb and many hard-hitting moves. Neither man could take full control. Lennox landed several heavy strikes and used a headlock to wear Montana down. However, Montana eventually broke free and hit a superkick, followed by a clothesline, an enzuigiri, and a stunner that nearly ended the match. The bell did nothing to calm Montana down. He continued attacking Lennox, forcing security to step in. Lennox kept taunting Montana even while lying at ringside. Montana responded by slamming him onto the exposed concrete and hit a curb stomp that left him down. Montana then picked up the steel ring steps and prepared to smash Lennox with them. However, Cutler James stepped in and threw himself over Lennox, taking the impact to protect his fellow DarkState member. The situation eventually led to what appeared to be police officers stepping in. Two officers confronted Montana, restrained him, and handcuffed him before escorting him away. title: The 50 coolest maneuvers of all time
raw_title: The 50 coolest maneuvers of all time
body: Which Superstars with shared finishing maneuvers did it better? And what exactly do we mean by coolest? If you were cool you wouldn’t be asking that question. Pure intensity, pure mayhem, pure Warrior. Whenever Ultimate Warrior’s music hit, all hell would inevitably break loose. But nothing demonstrated the sheer electricity and powerful essence of such a wild Superstar like his Gorilla Press Slam. Putting her own spin on the Gory Neckbreaker — a move innovated by Mexican ring legend Gory Guerrero — Victoria felled many a female in WWE with the chiropractic nightmare she called the Widow’s Peak. In executing the maneuver, the raven-haired aggressor would hoist her opponents back-to-back over her shoulder then drop them savagely to the canvas, twisting their necks backward in a sickening show of force. Incapacitating such iconic Divas as Torrie Wilson, Stacy Keibler and WWE Hall of Famer Trish Stratus, the Widow’s Peak earned Victoria her second Women’s Championship in a Fatal 4-Way Match on the Feb. 23, 2004, edition of Raw, when she used the dreaded maneuver to take out Lita. — JAMES WORTMAN Some wrestling moves are precision holds, designed to stretch opponents’ limbs past their breaking points. Others are about hitting a dude so hard his head might pop off. JBL’s Clothesline from Hell clearly falls into the latter category. The big Texan took a cue from fellow Lone Star State native Stan Hansen, as both men enjoyed recklessly throwing their beefy arms at foes like big league sluggers swinging for the fences. JBL almost always connected, knocking the poor sap across the ring from him into next week. Hell probably sounded like a vacation after getting clobbered by The Wrestling God’s signature clothesline. — BOBBY MELOK If finding a four leaf clover is considered good luck, then finding yourself in Dean Malenko’s Texas Cloverleaf must be just the opposite. Watch Malenko execute the Texas Cloverleaf in an underrated classic It’s a hold that looks awesome as it inflicts pain and certainly spells bad luck for anyone finding themselves locked in it. — TOM LIODICE A close-fisted punch in a WWE match usually garners an admonishment — almost always unheeded — from the referee. However the rule book goes out the window when Roman Reigns lands his breathtaking Superman Punch. A jumping, cross-body right hand delivered with phenomenal impact, the blow is made all the more devastating by the incredible torque generated by The Shield member’s 250-pound frame. John Cena, Sheamus and Big E have all been flattened by a hit so impactful it would rival the power of George Foreman in his prime. What makes this move even more frightening? Even if an opponent is somehow able to avoid the strike, they still have to worry about a Roman Reigns spear that can rearrange the organs of any Superstar today. — ANDY SEIFE No one threw a Spinebuster quite like Arn Anderson. title: Syko Stu Recalls Raja Jackson Shoot Attack Aftermath
raw_title: Syko Stu says he had to relearn to walk after Raja Jackson incident
summary_src: Last year, things went out of hand when Raja Jackson launched a shoot attack on Syko Stu during one of his matches at a KnokX Pro Wrestling event. In August 2025, Jackson was involved in an angle with Stu at a KnokX Pro Wrestling event.
body: Last year, things went out of hand when Raja Jackson launched a shoot attack on Syko Stu during one of his matches at a KnokX Pro Wrestling event. “I don’t remember a lot of it. I do remember Raja coming backstage, and he was filming. Usually you don’t film backstage like that. I know there was the can spot, and I don’t remember too much after that. I do remember that we did call a finish, and he was supposed to come in. I think he was going to give me one punch because of the can spot. It’s supposed to be a wrestling punch, but if he would’ve connected with it a little more, I could’ve sold it better. I don’t think anyone expected what was going to happen to happen ,” he said. “ I was out on the slam. I don’t remember anything. The match went really good until that. I don’t remember anything until, I believe it was Tuesday. I woke up in the hospital. I was in and out of consciousness the whole time. I woke up on Tuesday and saw some of the wrestlers. Rikishi was there, and we were talking. I was just trying to recover ,” he further added. However, the attack was extremely severe and he suffered from a traumatic brain injury as well as had to learn back to walk after the incident. When asked if Raja Jackson or his father, Rampage Jackson, reached out to Stu after the incident, he said, “ I didn’t have my phone the whole time I was in hospital. In the end, Stu claimed that while he is physically fit to wrestle, he does not know if he would be able to wrestle mentally. llm_long: At a KnokX Pro event on August 23 2025, Raja Jackson knocked independent wrestler Syko Stu unconscious during a planned spot that escalated beyond the script.
Raja slammed Stu and then delivered more than 20 unanswered legitimate strikes to his head until independent wrestler Doug Malo intervened and pulled him away.
Syko Stu has limited memory of the incident itself. He recalled Raja filming backstage, which is unusual, and remembered calling a finish that involved one wrestling punch after a beer can spot.

Stu stated he was unconscious from the initial slam and has no recollection of the following events. He woke up in the hospital on Tuesday after being admitted on Saturday and remained in and out of consciousness until then.
During his hospital stay, medical staff would not show him video of the incident or discuss it. Wrestler Rikishi visited him there as he began to recover.

Stu was discharged from the hospital on Thursday. He now participates in word exercises during rehabilitation but continues to experience short-term memory issues such as forgetting things within minutes, repeating actions, and failing to recall names and faces.

title: Ilja Dragunov explains AEW signing over WWE

body: Ilja Dragunov said he decideioid to leave WWE and sign with AEW because he saw AEW as a better fit for him. “It was an accumulation of a lot of things,” said Dragunov during an interview on The Ariel Helwani Show. “An accumulation of, of course, the offering, because we all know, at the end of the day, it’s the business. But it’s also definitely based on my feeling of, like, how do I want to work creatively? Do I need a scenery change? Is the scenery change something where I can see myself staying forever? Because you’ve got to consider a lot of factors. Like, I spent the most of my 20s in WWE. That’s a very, very long time.” Dragunov mentioned that since he signed with WWE, the wrestling landscape has changed with AEW launching as a new alternate. “And the landscape in this beautiful business changed. So, the beautiful thing is nowadays we have other opportunities. And for me personally, after such a long time being with a company, to not seek out new opportunities, maybe a place where I see myself more fitting — who wouldn’t do that?” Dragonuv made his AEW debut on Oct. 17 at the WrestleDream PPV. He is scheduled to make his in-ring debut on Dynamite this week.

If you’ve paid NXT any attention in 2026, or followed it here on Cageside, you know the developmental brand’s crown jewel (pun intended) has been the women’s division. Maybe the ladies down in Orlando are just more talented than their male counterparts, or maybe Raw and SmackDown haven’t raided their division as much. Either way, the men’s division has had a hard time keeping up this year. With so many of NXT’s top male stars getting promoted this year, there’s been an influx of new talent (including the return of an old talent) trying to stand out in a crowded field of meh. If we can make one complaint about NXT, it’s not that they’re not trying. Between the leader of a nepo-baby faction dropping diss tracks and a toothless LFG winner hallucinating talking raccoons , they are certainly throwing anything they can against the wall to see what sticks. Without further ado, let’s talk about what went down tonight! As NXT went on the air tonight, we saw a stellar video package detailing the recent rivalry between Dion Lennox and Cruz Montana and hyping us up for tonight’s main event. After an in-ring promo battle a few weeks ago and an exchange of pre-packaged promos the week after, the tension between them ratcheted up last week when Dion attacked Cruz as Montana was getting off the phone with his mother. After laying Cruz out, Dion hit redial and had his own conversation with Momma Montana. About an hour before meeting Cruz in the ring, Dion paced backstage as Osiris Griffin and Cutler James watched a cell phone video Montana made last week, vowing to beat Lennox’s ass tonight. Dion made a few cryptic threats about taking Cruz back to that dark place, and the DarkState trio walked off to plan how. As the dust cleared and Cruz surveyed the damage, two supposed police officers came out and tackled him to the ground. The show closed with Montana pinned to the ground being restrained, while Dion looked on, seemingly satisfied that he had pushed his rival to return to “that dark place”. A few weeks after making a surprise return to NXT and winning a #1 Contender’s Battle Royal, Wren Sinclair met NXT Women’s Champion Kelani Jordan in the ring to sign their contract for Halloween Havoc. On her way, Wren got last-minute motivation from Kendal Grey after the WrenQCC crossed paths with an irate Birth Right (find out why they were mad by scrolling down a bit!) and Chantel Monroe (more on her below!). NXT put a different (and refreshing) spin on the contract-signing gimmick by sending the challenger out with the contract and calling the champion out to sign it. No authority figure or table in the ring. Wren called Kelani out, and Jordan’s music cut her off mid-sentence. Kelani came out wielding a chair and claimed she had a gift for Wren. title: Billy Gunn required sons to graduate college before AEW
raw_title: Billy Gunn says he refused to get his sons hired by AEW
summary_src: A part of AEW since 2020, Billy Gunn was never in favor of his sons getting hired by Tony Khan’s promotion before they graduated from college.
body: A part of AEW since 2020, Billy Gunn was never in favor of his sons getting hired by Tony Khan’s promotion before they graduated from college. Speaking to Kenny McIntosh of Inside The Ropes , Gunn recently opened up and shared that he refused to get his sons hired by AEW, and instead wanted them to finish college first. “ I’m not that guy anyway. Like if you suck, I’m telling you, you suck. I wanted my kids to actually suck so they didn’t do this job. But unfortunately, their dad was in DX. But that doesn’t matter. Just because I’m good at something doesn’t mean they’re going to be good at something ,” Gunn said. “First of all, they had to graduate from college. That was number one. Don’t even come to me. Don’t even attempt to do this job if I don’t get that. “ Austin [Gunn], the day he graduated, walked from the stage up the balcony where I was sitting, handed me this and goes, ‘When do we start?'” He further discussed that while his other son, Colten, had everything planned out for him till he was 60. However, when even Colten Gunn wanted to wrestle, it shocked his wife and him. “ They’ve known that because they’ve lived it their entire life, is me never being around. Like never being home. It’s a little easier now, but when I first started, I was on the road 300 days out of the year, ” Gunn said when asked why he didn’t want his sons in wrestling. “ That’s insane. That’s zero life at home. That’s zero seeing your kids do [anything]. That’s zero seeing anybody do anything because when you go home, you sleep the entire time because you don’t do that on the road. So I don’t want that for my kids. I want better things for my kids like we all do.” Despite training his sons, Gunn wanted them to earn an AEW tryout first. Saying he handed his sons nothing, Gunn added, “ I did teach them. I trained them up until a certain point to where they were kind of getting the feel of it. “ And then I would send them away to people that I trusted to kind of just get a different perspective. But they had to go to Tony. They had to ask to get a tryout. They had tryouts. They did all that. I didn’t go, ‘Hey, would you hire my kids because they’re my kids?’ No, that ain’t me ,” he shared. The veteran added that he did not visit AEW asking them to hire his kids. Gunn claimed that he always had the belief that one had to earn their opportunity and work for it. “ Too many people just get it handed to them and they don’t understand the struggle it takes to do this job.” The Gunns have been a part of AEW since 2020 and have won the AEW tag team and trios titles. body: 0 WWE’s Independent Development (ID) program has seen another departure. This exit adds to a growing list of talents who have recently moved on from the system. The latest exit involves a wrestler who joined the program earlier this year and gained experience on WWE EVOLVE under a different ring name. The departure was confirmed directly to Fightful Select, bringing his brief run with WWE’s developmental initiative to an end. Jimmy House, who performed as CJ Valor during his time on WWE EVOLVE, confirmed to Fightful Select that WWE released him from its ID program. He signed an ID contract in March 2026, around two months after participating in the company’s tryouts in Orlando. House had already indicated a change in direction last month when he announced that he would return to using his independent wrestling name. If you’ve paid NXT any attention in 2026, or followed it here on Cageside, you know the developmental brand’s crown jewel (pun intended) has been the women’s division. Maybe the ladies down in Orlando are just more talented than their male counterparts, or maybe Raw and SmackDown haven’t raided their division as much. Either way, the men’s division has had a hard time keeping up this year. With so many of NXT’s top male stars getting promoted this year, there’s been an influx of new talent (including the return of an old talent) trying to stand out in a crowded field of meh. If we can make one complaint about NXT, it’s not that they’re not trying. Between the leader of a nepo-baby faction dropping diss tracks and a toothless LFG winner hallucinating talking raccoons , they are certainly throwing anything they can against the wall to see what sticks. Without further ado, let’s talk about what went down tonight! As NXT went on the air tonight, we saw a stellar video package detailing the recent rivalry between Dion Lennox and Cruz Montana and hyping us up for tonight’s main event. After an in-ring promo battle a few weeks ago and an exchange of pre-packaged promos the week after, the tension between them ratcheted up last week when Dion attacked Cruz as Montana was getting off the phone with his mother. After laying Cruz out, Dion hit redial and had his own conversation with Momma Montana. About an hour before meeting Cruz in the ring, Dion paced backstage as Osiris Griffin and Cutler James watched a cell phone video Montana made last week, vowing to beat Lennox’s ass tonight. Dion made a few cryptic threats about taking Cruz back to that dark place, and the DarkState trio walked off to plan how. As the dust cleared and Cruz surveyed the damage, two supposed police officers came out and tackled him to the ground. The show closed with Montana pinned to the ground being restrained, while Dion looked on, seemingly satisfied that he had pushed his rival to return to “that dark place”. A few weeks after making a surprise return to NXT and winning a #1 Contender’s Battle Royal, Wren Sinclair met NXT Women’s Champion Kelani Jordan in the ring to sign their contract for Halloween Havoc. On her way, Wren got last-minute motivation from Kendal Grey after the WrenQCC crossed paths with an irate Birth Right (find out why they were mad by scrolling down a bit!) and Chantel Monroe (more on her below!). NXT put a different (and refreshing) spin on the contract-signing gimmick by sending the challenger out with the contract and calling the champion out to sign it. No authority figure or table in the ring. Wren called Kelani out, and Jordan’s music cut her off mid-sentence. Kelani came out wielding a chair and claimed she had a gift for Wren. title: TNA Wrestling Partners With LaMelo Ball’s Fashion Brand
raw_title: TNA Wrestling Partners With LaMelo Ball’s Fashion Brand
body: "TNA Wrestling is so proud to welcome LaFrance, the premium lifestyle brand of NBA superstar LaMelo Ball, as our new official apparel partner," Hannifan said. Hannifan announced that TNA referees will wear LaFrance apparel instead of the generic black-and-white striped shirt. Plus, TNA stars and fans can soon purchase TNA-themed LaFrance apparel. TNA fans got a first look at the new referee LaFrance uniform at Bound For Glory. The blue shirt features a white collar and the TNA and LaFrance logos displayed on the front. LaMelo Ball , the No. 3 pick in the 2020 NBA Draft, is one of the NBA's most exciting players. The skilled point guard frequently dishes out highlight-worthy passes and shows off his impressive range with one-legged jumpers and half-court three-pointers. Off the court, the California-born guard is equally as flashy. Ball often showcases his insane car collection , featuring a Rolls-Royce Cullinan, McLaren 750S Spider, Lamborghini Urus and Tesla Cybertruck, among others. In 2020, the NBA star launched his lifestyle fashion brand LaFrance . In addition to becoming an official TNA Wrestling partner, LaFrance will soon release a Stranger Things-themed collaboration with PUMA . The upcoming collection includes the Stranger Things x PUMA MB.06 , LaFrancé , and LaFrance RNR , with each pair featuring different elements from the Netflix series' supernatural world. TNA Wrestling's LaFrance partnership announcement was not the only exciting news at Bound For Glory. Leon Slater cemented himself as the youngest World Champion in TNA history by defeating Nic Nemeth in the main event of Bound For Glory. The 22-year-old high-flyer is the youngest wrestler to hold World Championship gold in TNA, WWE or AEW. After the historic win, Slater said he was "grateful" for the support he's received along the way to achieving his dream of becoming a World Champion. "I'm a big believer in manifestation and self-confidence and all of that jazz . I always saw myself with something like this," Slater said while holding the TNA World Championship. "People have asked me if I'm nervous or if I'm worried. I say no. I feel like everything is happening how it's supposed to. "I'm just so grateful. I'm grateful for the people God put me around," he continued. "Grateful for the environment God put me in." The TNA star concluded, "I could not be prouder to represent Total Nonstop Action!" Slater is now the youngest X-Division Champion and World Champion in TNA history. Slater is expected to appear on the next episode of TNA iMPACT! on Tuesday, Oct. 13, following his historic performance. body: -Hype for tonight’s show centered around the Montana-Lennox match that’s been promoted quite a bit better than anything that’s going to run at Halloween Havoc. -It’s not often that NXT opens with a talk segment, but Tony D’Angelo showed up first as the show has a lot of work to do to make Halloween Havoc seem like a big deal. He immediately called out Grayson Waller, who obliged by heading to the ring with his own mic. Waller said that back in their beginnings, he knew they’d meet at some point. He said they were signed at about the same time and even teamed together at WarGames. They talked about not liking – and even resenting – each other. Waller said that D’Angelo was chosen and he didn’t even know what any of this was. He said he had to take Tony upstairs and show him what a WarGames match is because he didn’t know. D’Angelo countered by saying Waller was more about viral moments than championships. Waller again took down D’Angelo verbally in response. Waller stayed in a heel context but just ate D’Angelo alive on the mic. Waller said the title means more than when Bron had it (low bar; Breakker had a terrible title run), more than when Trick had it (I wish I could say Trick had a great run, but all his best presentation was when he was chasing and not the champ) and it would be more than anything D ever did. D’Angelo interrupted and yelled out some final threats. This wasn’t a bad segment or anything, but I came away wanting to see Waller destroy D’Angelo for being an interloper in wrestling, which certainly wasn’t the intent. -Earlier today, Layla Diggs was talking to some people in the locker room when Izzi Dame showed up and stirred it up, leading to a match later tonight. -In the parking lot for some reason, Birthright talked big ahead of their next Dusty Cup match. After they headed inside, we could see a truck approaching from a distance. Announcers didn’t mention it, but it seemed like something with implications. But maybe it was just a truck. [c] -Chantel Monroe got a brief pre-taped hype segment. I saw a ton of her on Evolve and the biggest work she had to do was on the mic, which she’s really starting to get down. She’s a snotty self-involved heel. (1) EL HIJO DE DR. title: Natalya thanks Nick Khan for outside WWE bookings
raw_title: Natalya credits Nick Khan for giving her opportunities outside WWE
summary_src: A WWE veteran, Natalya recently found herself wrestling for other indie promotions while still being part of the WWE roster. Recently, speaking on The West Sport, Natalya opened up and credited WWE President Nick Khan for allowing her opportunities outside of the promotion.
body: A WWE veteran, Natalya recently found herself wrestling for other indie promotions while still being part of the WWE roster. Recently, speaking on The West Sport , Natalya opened up and credited WWE President Nick Khan for allowing her opportunities outside of the promotion. “ It takes an extraordinary amount of courage to be able to go, I know I’m performing and firing on all cylinders, but I have to leave because I don’t want to be the last girl at the party. “ Natalya claimed for nearly two decades she wrestled in WWE and never got to do anything outside the promotion. However, when her friend, Josh Barnett, wanted her to Bloodsport, she was allowed to do so. “ For me, I’m not going to be around forever. But I’m in the best shape of my life. And I feel like in the last year, especially stepping outside of WWE, Nick Khan has allowed me to work outside of the company in places that really fulfill my soul ,” she said. Natalya claimed that Khan allowed her to do Bloodsport, NWA, Reality of Wrestling, GCW, AAA, and other stuff. “ It just lit my soul. It just set me free. And so I feel like I’m doing amazing work. But I also admire AJ [Styles] and [John] Cena in the way that they beat the house. So you never know. I’m not going to be here forever ,” she finished. Natalya, 44, last wrestled at AAA Triplemania 34 in the AAA Reina de Reinas championship number one Contendership Fatal Four Way bout. title: MLW star Lady Frost Responds To Tessa Blanchard signing: 'It's good for business'
raw_title: MLW star Lady Frost reacts to Tessa Blanchard signing: 'It's good for business' | OutKick
body: Pro wrestling star Tessa Blanchard signed with Major League Wrestling (MLW) earlier this week, bolstering an already stacked women’s division. Lady Frost, who joined MLW earlier this year, reacted to Blanchard’s arrival in an interview with OutKick Dropkick. Lady Frost signed with Major League Wrestling in April 2026. (MLW) "First of all, it’s an incredible signing," she said. "We understand the pedigree that comes with Tessa Blanchard and you’ve heard high tides raise all ships. And I think everyone is just going to want to up their game even more. "I’ve been in the ring with Tessa. I’ve done tours in Mexico and it’s good for business." MLW said Blanchard will make her debut appearance at Fightland on Sept. 12 in Charleston, South Carolina. Tessa Blanchard, who currently competes in CMLL, has signed with MLW. (CMLL) "Heavy is the crown, but legacy isn't handed to you... it’s forged under pressure," she said in a news release. "I’ve earned my place as one of the best in the world at what I do, but I’m not coming to MLW to rest on the Blanchard name. "MLW is bringing some of the purest, hardest-hitting action in the sport today, and the ‘Undeniable Diamond’ belongs right at the top of it." Frost told OutKick Dropkick she wouldn’t rank the MLW women’s division among the rest of the pro wrestling world but agreed the roster is "stacked." "It is stacked. I don't do rankings. That's not my department. I do the fighting," she said. "I get in there and I do my job and it's for the fans to decide. We make it very easy for them. Too easy. "It's $15 to show up to a live event and it's free on YouTube. So, they can make that decision themselves. I know fans have a lot to say about rankings and wrestling and they really have no idea, but you can go ahead and chime in." Lady Frost is set for a matchup against Corinne Joy on Saturday as MLW holds its Kings of Colosseum event. The matches can be seen on YouTube, beIN Sports and Veeps.

body: Which Superstars with shared finishing maneuvers did it better? And what exactly do we mean by coolest? If you were cool you wouldn’t be asking that question. Pure intensity, pure mayhem, pure Warrior. Whenever Ultimate Warrior’s music hit, all hell would inevitably break loose. But nothing demonstrated the sheer electricity and powerful essence of such a wild Superstar like his Gorilla Press Slam. Putting her own spin on the Gory Neckbreaker — a move innovated by Mexican ring legend Gory Guerrero — Victoria felled many a female in WWE with the chiropractic nightmare she called the Widow’s Peak. In executing the maneuver, the raven-haired aggressor would hoist her opponents back-to-back over her shoulder then drop them savagely to the canvas, twisting their necks backward in a sickening show of force. Incapacitating such iconic Divas as Torrie Wilson, Stacy Keibler and WWE Hall of Famer Trish Stratus, the Widow’s Peak earned Victoria her second Women’s Championship in a Fatal 4-Way Match on the Feb. 23, 2004, edition of Raw, when she used the dreaded maneuver to take out Lita. — JAMES WORTMAN Some wrestling moves are precision holds, designed to stretch opponents’ limbs past their breaking points. Others are about hitting a dude so hard his head might pop off. JBL’s Clothesline from Hell clearly falls into the latter category. The big Texan took a cue from fellow Lone Star State native Stan Hansen, as both men enjoyed recklessly throwing their beefy arms at foes like big league sluggers swinging for the fences. JBL almost always connected, knocking the poor sap across the ring from him into next week. Hell probably sounded like a vacation after getting clobbered by The Wrestling God’s signature clothesline. — BOBBY MELOK If finding a four leaf clover is considered good luck, then finding yourself in Dean Malenko’s Texas Cloverleaf must be just the opposite. However the rule book goes out the window when Roman Reigns lands his breathtaking Superman Punch. title: Was Tito Santana Considered As a Possible Face of WWE? — Ask 411 Wrestling
raw_title: Ask 411 Wrestling: Was Tito Santana Considered As a Possible Face of WWE?
body: I am your party host, Ryan Byers, and I am here to answer some of your burning inquiries about professional wrestling. If you have one of those queries searing a hole in your brain, feel free to send it along to me at [email protected] . Don’t be shy about shooting those over – the more, the merrier. Did the Ultimate Warrior or Randy Savage say anything negative in shoot interviews towards the other? Not that I’m aware of. With Randy Savage passing away in 2011, shoot interviews were definitely “a thing,” but we hadn’t yet made it into the era where wrestlers were dropping new interviews every couple of weeks and we now know what Maven had for breakfast the morning after he eliminated the Undertaker from the Royal Rumble. We have more shoot interviews out there from the Warrior, but none of them that I was able to track down were particularly negative on Savage. In fact, he spoke about the two of them working well together and having a collegial relationship. I’ve heard before that when the WWF decided to give main-event pushes to smaller guys who weren’t obviously on steroids in the early 1990s, Tito Santana was one of the talents they considered as the face of the company, a position that ultimately went to Bret Hart and later Shawn Michaels. You want to know who doesn’t seem to believe that Tito Santana was “in the mix” to become the WWF Champion? In 2022, the man from Mission, Texas sat down with WSI – Wrestling Shoot Interviews and was asked about the longstanding rumors that he was on a shortlist of four names to take the belt off of Ric Flair. Tito denied that he had ever heard about such a list at the time that these events were going down. He went on to say that, after Bret Hart won the championship, he was approached by Pat Patterson backstage with Patterson telling him that the decision for a new champ had come down to him and the Hitman. However, Santana went on to say that, just a couple of hours later, Ted DiBiase came up to him, and DiBiase reported that Pat Patterson had also told him that he was the last guy under consideration before the call was made to go with Hart. In other words, Tito felt like Pat Patterson had been blowing smoke up his ass. I don’t totally deny the notion that Tito Santana’s name may have been mentioned as a potential WWF Champion at one point in time, but given the longstanding history of wrestlers trying to overstate their importance in the pecking order as opposed to understate it, if Santana himself doubts he was ever a serious contender, then he was probably never a serious contender. Given his still-protected status and fans’ memory of him as a popular ethnic babyface during the height of Hulkamania and a former Intercontinental Champion, I don’t think that he would have had a credibility issue at all as WWF Champion in 1992, particularly if they tuned down the new cornball gimmick just a bit. body: AEW Dynamite is live tonight at 8 p.m. ET/7 p.m. CT on TBS and HBO Max from the Credit Union of Texas Event Center in Allen, Texas, with all the fallout from the biggest night in AEW history, led by Will Ospreay dethroning Kenny Omega at Wembley Stadium to become the first-ever UK-born wrestler to win a world title on UK soil, and "The CEO" Mercedes Moné finally capturing the AEW Women's World Championship from Willow Nightingale. The night also saw the earth-shaking AEW debut of Austin Creed and Kofi — The New Level — who became AEW World Trios Champions alongside Swerve Strickland in memorable fashion. Plus, we saw the returns of a host of past champions, including Dr. Britt Baker, and the icon Sting making his presence felt at Wembley! Tonight, Creed and Kofi make their Dynamite debut, defending their AEW World Trios Titles with Swerve against The Rascalz! Plus, Moné celebrates her AEW Women's World Championship victory in a big way after the fight of her life at All In! Will Ospreay has been the talk of the wrestling world since beating Kenny Omega to win the AEW World Championship this past Sunday on his home soil at All In: London. From his emotional entrance to a bloody war with Omega to the final Hidden Blade that won him the title, Ospreay certainly has a lot to talk about, and tonight, he will kick off Dynamite! What will Ospreay have to say about achieving his childhood dream? And what’s next now that he’s finally AEW World Champion? body: While the world waits with bated breath to see if WWE relocates its upcoming show, it feels like an appropriate time to take the temperature of the American pro-wrestling landscape. This is the first AFP pound-for-pound power rankings of the best pro-wrestlers in AEW and WWE. While Darby Allin’s effort in Saturday’s inaugural “Clockwork Carnage” has surely affected his evaluation, there’s no shame in losing to the king. Now, the only question is whether or not he opts to tread familiar water in Roman Reigns, or set his sights on WWE Undisputed Champion, Sami Zayn. Andrade El Idolo hasn’t lost in an All Elite Wrestling ring since April, quietly building one of the strongest bodies of work in 2026. Since dethroning Mark Davis for the AEW National Championship, Andrade has recorded six title defenses, punctuating his case on Saturday with a victory over Tommaso Ciampa . With the Casino Gauntlet contract in hand, and victories earlier in the year over the likes of Swerve Strickland and Kenny Omega, the world is Andrade’s oyster. If Jon Moxley was baptized by fire in last year’s Continental Classic, his reign as AEW Continental Champion has absolved him of all his previous sins. The WWE has a history of insisting upon itself. In the case of Oba Femi, its made the “Ruler” a walking contradiction. Right now, he’s treading water, biding his time until his long-awaited clash with Roman Reigns at next year’s “WrestleMania.” Still, it feels like he has more momentum than any wrestler in the world. The highlights of his 2026 campaign include winning the King of the Ring Tournament and retiring Brock Lesnar in Hell in a Cell. Persephone’s case is two-fold: (1) her impressive record and (2) her status as CMLL’s top women’s champion. As TBS Champion, she’s staged four successful title defenses, including last Saturday’s four-way dance with Dani Luna, Queen Aminata, and Hyan. A day later, she put her CMLL World Women’s Championship on the line, conquering AZM in Arena Mexico. Roman Reigns has only wrestled seven times in 2026. Still, it’s difficult to deny the “Tribal Chief’s” strength of schedule. With notable victories over CM Punk, Seth Rollins, and Penta; Reigns has cultivated an aura of inviolability. He is more than a man; more than an obstacle to overcome. He is a colossus. body: Ilja Dragunov didn’t come to AEW for an easy first match. Dragunov officially arrived at WrestleDream , and Tony Khan has already given AEW’s newest signing his first opponent. title: RVD Speaks On Possibility of Another AEW Run
raw_title: RVD Addresses Possibility of Another AEW Run
summary_src: RVD still thinks he has another wrestling run left in him, and AEW sounds like a pretty good place to make it happen. The WWE Hall of Famer believes he could have a “really good run” there and already has a few familiar names he’d be interested in getting back in the ring with. Speaking ...
body: “Yeah. They’ve definitely proven themselves. You know, like, it was so easy when they first came out to be like, ‘Yeah, well, let’s see how long they stick around.’ And I don’t think there’s anything wrong with any of us that felt that way because promotions over the years come up all the time.” RVD said AEW has clearly managed to fill a void in wrestling and believes the company will continue growing. He also noted that plenty of fans he speaks with aren’t necessarily picking one company over another and instead watch both AEW and WWE. “‘Oh, they got Major League Baseball money. This shit’s for real,’ and they got this and that, and it never lasts. And those guys, you know, really fill the void, and so it’s cool. Congrats to AEW, and they’re just going to keep growing. You know, I always check with the fans and ask what they watch, and a lot of people are watching both products. I don’t know how much international distribution they have, but obviously they must be on in the places that they’re going to, at least.” There’s also something about AEW’s environment that stands out to RVD. From his perspective, the company feels more wrestler-driven and gives talent more room to express themselves than what he remembers from his time in WWE. “But yeah, pretty cool. And it still — and I think always will — be coming across as, and I think for valid reasons, the boys being the ones that are kind of running the show more.” RVD contrasted that with his WWE experience, where he felt some wrestlers were worried about their jobs and hesitant to push back. AEW, in his eyes, comes across as a place where wrestlers have more freedom to do things their own way. “You know, whereas WWE was like a lot of people afraid for their job and doing whatever they’re told, and sometimes afraid to go against it or say the wrong thing or whatever. And this seems more like guys that want to be out there expressing themselves with their talent and doing it their way.” That’s when RVD started thinking about what another AEW run could actually look like. Rather than immediately naming some of the company’s younger stars, he pointed toward several veterans with whom he already shares plenty of history. RVD then threw one more name into the conversation — Jeff Hardy. The two have plenty of history together, and Van Dam wouldn’t mind getting one more match with his former rival. “And I also think I wouldn’t mind having one more match with Jeff Hardy, you know?” None of this means RVD is actively pushing Tony Khan to book those matches. He made it clear that Jericho, Christian Cage, Adam Copeland and Hardy are simply ideas he likes rather than matches he’s desperate to make happen. “But these aren’t things that I, you know, dream about and, ‘Oh, I gotta make it happen.’ It just sounds like good ideas, you know?” H Jenkins H Jenkins has been breaking pro wrestling news on Ringside News for nearly a decade, with his reports featured by TMZ, Forbes, The Sun, and more.

title: Dragon Lee Re-Signs With WWE
raw_title: Dragon Lee Re-Signs With WWE
summary_src: Dragon Lee isn’t going anywhere after all. After weeks of questions about his expiring WWE contract, the luchador has reportedly worked things out with the company — and he could be sticking around for another five years. According to PWInsider, WWE and Lee have come to terms on a new contract.
body: There had been some reason for fans to wonder what Lee might do next. His brother Dralistico is also nearing the end of his AEW deal, and the two recently filed a trademark for “Hermanos Lee,” which naturally got people wondering whether something involving the brothers could be coming. That wasn’t just a guess either. The indication he received was that people inside WWE weren’t expecting Lee to start looking around once his deal was up. “I was given the indication that, like, people don’t anticipate Dragon Lee looking to leave WWE.” Now it looks like they had good reason to feel that way. Lee originally signed with WWE in December 2022 on a three-year deal before getting a one-year extension in 2023 after making his way onto the main roster. He’s also spent a good chunk of 2026 chasing the Intercontinental Championship. Lee has challenged for the title four times this year, including another unsuccessful shot on the October 19 episode of Monday Night RAW. So after all the questions about whether Dragon Lee might hit free agency, WWE appears to have taken that possibility right off the table. If the reported five-year term checks out, Lee won’t just be staying — WWE has apparently locked him down for the long haul. title: On the Record: Ilja Dragunov Opens Up On Why He Was Able to Keep His Name After WWE Exit
raw_title: Ilja Dragunov Reveals Why He Was Able to Keep His Name After WWE Exit
summary_src: Ilja Dragunov didn’t have to leave his identity behind when he walked out of WWE. Unlike plenty of wrestlers who have been forced to rebrand after leaving the company, Dragunov was able to take his name straight to AEW with him.
body: Dragunov explained that he’d already spent his entire independent career wrestling under that name. When WWE signed him, the company didn’t ask him to change it or come up with a new identity. “They never asked me to change it. I had this name before. I had this name for my entire independent career. I came to WWE with this name, and I left WWE with this name.” That also meant Dragunov didn’t suddenly find himself searching for a new name once his WWE run was over. He confirmed that he kept the rights to Ilja Dragunov, something he’s especially happy about considering how closely the name is tied to everything he’s accomplished in wrestling. “So, there was never a point where they asked me to change the name or anything like that. So, I kept the rights for this name, and I’m very happy about that because, I mean, this name is connected to my entire career.” For Dragunov, there really wasn’t an alternative identity sitting around anyway. From the independents to NXT UK, NXT, WWE’s main roster and now AEW, he’s always been Ilja Dragunov. That made at least one part of Dragunov’s jump from WWE to AEW incredibly simple. He may be starting a completely new chapter of his career, but fans won’t have to get used to calling him anything different. title: WWE Writers Were Allegedly Expected to Take the Blame for Vince McMahon’s Decisions
raw_title: WWE Writers Were Allegedly Expected to Take the Blame for Vince McMahon’s Decisions
summary_src: Jimmy Jacobs says wrestling fans have spent years blaming WWE’s creative writers for decisions they were never actually in charge of. According to the former WWE writer, when Vince McMahon didn’t want someone on television, the creative team often ended up taking the heat for it anyway.
body: Speaking to Till Five Wrestling , Jacobs explained that there’s a major difference between being a writer and actually being the person running creative. He described WWE’s writers as advisers who could bring ideas to the table but couldn’t force the person at the top to use them. “There is such a misconception about what the job of creative is. Writers aren’t the head of creative. That’s one thing, but the writers are a different thing. The writers aren’t shot-callers. They’re advisers to the king. That’s what they are.” Jacobs said that distinction wasn’t just lost on fans either. In his experience, plenty of wrestlers and veteran personalities also talked about WWE creative without really understanding what happened behind the scenes. “And for some reason, nobody — none of the fans — understands this. A bunch of the wrestlers don’t understand this. A bunch of the old marks. Like, who’s that guy with the plug up his butt? Rip Rogers. Is that his name? Rip Rogers.” Jacobs specifically remembered seeing Rip Rogers pitch an idea involving Brock Lesnar on social media while he was working on WWE’s creative team. Whatever Rogers suggested immediately told Jacobs that he didn’t understand how WWE’s creative system actually operated. “I remember being on the creative team and him tweeting something about Brock Lesnar should do something, something, something that let me know, ‘Oh, this old guy has no idea how this works. He has no idea how this works.’” That frustration extended to fans who listened to former wrestlers discuss the business and then assumed they understood WWE’s internal creative process. Jacobs argued that unless someone had actually worked on that side of the company, they couldn’t really know how those decisions were being made. You want to know what the creative process is? If you’re on the side of the creative process, you know what the creative process is. If you’ve never been on that side, you don’t know what it is.” What really surprised Jacobs was discovering that even some WWE talent didn’t completely understand the system. After spending a few months inside the company, he realized wrestlers themselves sometimes didn’t know exactly where their creative decisions were coming from. “I was shocked. I was actually shocked going into WWE. Once I got there for a few months, I was like, ‘Oh, the wrestlers don’t know what the creative process is. They don’t know what it is.’” “Like when these people, man, some of these people that talk about this stuff, it’s like, ‘Oh, you know, creative has nothing for him. Well, then creative should be fired if they have nothing for him.’” Jacobs then spelled out what he says was actually happening whenever wrestlers heard that line. With McMahon holding final creative authority, Jacobs said it ultimately meant the boss simply didn’t want that wrestler on his show. “It’s like, yo, let me smarten you up. title: On the Record: Details begin to emerge in death of All Elite Wrestling star Pac
raw_title: Details begin to emerge in death of All Elite Wrestling star Pac
body: Benjamin Satterley, the pro wrestling star known as Pac, was found dead in Illinois on Sunday hours after he had wrestled for the All Elite Wrestling (AEW) National Championship at All Out. The Des Plaines Police Department told OutKick Dropkick there were no indications of foul play and the circumstances around Satterley’s death were not deemed to be suspicious. Police said the cause of death would be determined by the Cook County Medical Examiner’s Office. AEW announced Satterley’s death late Sunday, sending shock and disbelief across the pro wrestling world. "All Elite Wrestling is saddened to announce the passing of Benjamin Satterley, aka Pac," the company said. "A native of Newcastle upon Tyne, England, Satterley began his wrestling career in 2004 and went on to perform for wrestling organizations all over the world, captivating fans with innovative high-flying moves and incredible in-ring ability. "Pac signed with All Elite Wrestling in 2019 and held multiple AEW Championships and competed in some of the most memorable matches in AEW history. Our condolences go out to Satterley’s family, friends and fans." AEW owner Tony Khan also paid tribute to Satterley in a separate post. "Benjamin Satterley defined excellence, as a beloved husband & friend to his many loved ones, + in his wrestling knowledge, skill, unprecedented athleticism, professionalism, consistency + dedication to the sport that he loved & traveled the world to pursue," he wrote on X. "May Ben rest in peace." Satterley was found "passed out" outside of a CAVA restaurant at around 4 p.m. local time, the California Post reported, citing 911 audio. An official who arrived on the scene reportedly said Satterley was dead on arrival. Satterley, 40, was one of the first wrestlers to sign with All Elite Wrestling in 2019. He was a two-time trios champion and the inaugural all-Atlantic champion. Before wrestling in AEW , he was with WWE and known as Adrian Neville. Satterley was a two-time cruiserweight champion, an NXT champion and two-time NXT tag team champion. WWE Chief Content Officer Paul "Triple H" Levesque added to the chorus of tributes.

llm.headline: Wrestling Open Celebrates Five Years in Worcester
llm.summary: Erik Chacha pinned Jose Zamora in the spotlight match. Dustin Waller teamed with Kyle King and Colton Charles to face Aaron Ortiz, Danny Miles and Bobby Casale in a six-man tag that quickly turned into a wild brawl. The event marked Wrestling Open's five-year anniversary.

llm_long: Wrestling Open marked its fifth anniversary with a live event in Worcester, Massachusetts. The celebration featured multiple matches and ongoing storylines as the promotion reflected on its milestone.
In the spotlight match, Erik Chacha defeated Jose Zamora. The bout included an unplanned microphone incident that briefly disrupted the live broadcast.

A six-man tag team match followed, pitting Dustin Waller alongside Kyle King and Colton Charles against Aaron Ortiz, Danny Miles, and Bobby Casale. The contest turned into a hardcore-style brawl resembling a parking lot fight.

Another match saw Jake defeat Sawain after a back-and-forth battle that included heavy bleeding and a missed flying headbutt. Following the victory, Jake addressed the crowd about his future goals in the promotion.

Brick City called out their rivals Big Business to settle a long-running feud. The segment involved imposters posing as Big Business members before the real Brad Hollister intervened with a chair, promising a legitimate confrontation ahead.
The event continued with the Discovery Gauntlet, a format requiring competitors to win in order to remain active in the promotion.

title: Ilja Dragunov reflects on Lesnar Rumble moment
raw_title: Ex-WWE star Ilja Dragunov has no regrets about infamous Brock Lesnar moment
body: Almost everyone remembers Brock Lesnar no-selling Ilja Dragunov at the 2026 WWE Royal Rumble , and the released Superstar has talked about it extensively. "My best career moments were made by my vulnerability. I wasn't becoming a name by being the person who dominates at all times. I became a name on moments where I got beaten down badly," he continued. At one point in the Royal Rumble , Lesnar was backed into a corner by Dragunov. The former United States Champion delivered several chops to the "Beast Incarnate's" chest. However, he was not fazed whatsoever. Lesnar screamed in Dragunov's face before tossing him over the top rope, eliminating him with ease. This ended Dragunov's 11-minute run in the battle royal. The "Beast Incarnate" would be eliminated a few moments later by Cody Rhodes and LA Knight.
summary: Former WWE star Ilja Dragunov discussed the memorable 2026 Royal Rumble segment where Brock Lesnar no-sold his chops and quickly eliminated him. Dragunov said his best career moments came from showing vulnerability rather than constant dominance. Lesnar tossed him out after an 11-minute stay while the Beast Incarnate was later eliminated by Cody Rhodes and LA Knight.

title: Jeff Jarrett defends comedy spot at WrestleDream
raw_title: Jeff Jarrett defends comedy spot from AEW WrestleDream PPV
summary_src: AEW performer Jeff Jarrett recently discussed the comedy spot from the Tommaso Ciampa vs Andrade match at WrestleDream this past weekend. Speaking on his My World podcast, the former TNA owner would defend the pants spot, saying that ‘comedy doesn’t draw money’ is a “situational” concept.
body: “I mean, funny, don’t draw money is such a situational [concept]. I just don’t think you can paint it as…look, creative is subjective. Did you hear the reaction? They [the crowd] loved it. So I just think—and I get it, to each his own. It’s [that sort of spot] not for everybody.” Jarrett would also note how Mick Foley would be able to use comedy but then still be able to get the crowd believing in his character when he wanted to be serious: “Mick Foley is very, very good at that. Pull a freaking sock out, get the pop and the Mandible Claw, and they go crazy. But you watch his matches when he was in his prime and he’d do that, but boy, oh boy, just keep the ball rolling.” If you use any of the quotes here then please link back to this page and note F4WOnline put together the original transcription Jake Jeremy Jake Jeremy is the Head of Audience Development at F4WOnline, having previously worked as a Combat Sports, Gaming and Pro Wrestling writer, successful Editor in Chief and Sports Coordinator. He has more than ten years of experience covering mixed martial arts, pro wrestling, football and gaming across a number of publications, starting at SEScoops in 2012. He previously also worked for PROGRESS Wrestling as Head of Media as well as working on the social channels of the company.
summary: Jeff Jarrett discussed the use of comedy in pro wrestling during an appearance reported by the Wrestling Observer. He explained that crowd reaction determines whether a comedic spot works and noted that creative decisions are subjective. Jarrett pointed to Mick Foley as an example of someone who could execute comedy effectively while maintaining seriousness when needed.

title: Zaria Offers NXT Title Match, Izzi Dame Turns It Down
raw_title: WWE Star Rejects Championship Opportunity at NXT Halloween Havoc
body: The confrontation took place during the October 20 episode of WWE NXT . Zaria confronted Dame after her victory over Layla Diggs. After weeks of mind games and attempts to expose the champion's past, Dame finally got the reaction she wanted. However, Zaria offered her a championship match, which Dame surprisingly turned down. After Dame defeated Layla Diggs, Zaria came to the ring to confront her. The champion questioned what Dame was trying to prove and stated that she was tired of the mind games. Zaria also pointed out that Izzi Dame could have earned a shot at the NXT Women's North American Championship in other ways. However, she decided to end their back-and-forth by offering Dame a title match at Halloween Havoc on Saturday, October 31. Dame gave Zaria a thumbs-up before taking the microphone and accepting the match. However, she then surprised the champion by turning down the title opportunity. "Don't worry about putting that little title on the line. See you at Halloween Havoc, Princess," Dame told Zaria before leaving the ring. Calling Zaria "princess" was her one final taunt before they face off at the upcoming event. For Zaria, the upcoming match is a chance to silence Dame and put an end to the mind games without worrying about defending her championship. The post WWE Star Rejects Championship Opportunity at NXT Halloween Havoc appeared first on Wrestlezone .
summary: During the October 20 episode of WWE NXT, Zaria confronted Izzi Dame following her win over Layla Diggs. After weeks of mind games from Dame, Zaria offered her a shot at the NXT Women's North American Championship for Halloween Havoc. Dame initially appeared to accept before rejecting the title opportunity and promising to see Zaria on October 31.

body: STARS and HATE will clash in a 10-person tag team match. Hana, Iida Saya, Hayashishita Utami, Tsukiyama Waka, and Hime Yuria will face Tora Natsuko, Watanabe Momo, Konami, Ruanka, and Rina. What will be the outcome of this battle where the pride of both teams will be on display? They will team up with their mentor, Ito Maki, to face Yamashita Rina, Aoki Itsuki & Tetsu Akira. Ito is determined to achieve results with the three of them and aim to officially establish the "Ito Respect Army". Can Meni☆Mani and their mentor Ito secure a victory against Mi Vida Loca in order to become the new champions? llm_long: Stardom is holding a meet-and-greet event with the NEW BLOOD tag team challengers known as Meni☆Mani at Korakuen Hall. The event is scheduled for Tuesday, October 20, 2026, and is set to begin at 17:35. It will take place at a special booth located in the lobby of the venue.

Participation requires the purchase of a specific portrait designated for the meet-and-greet at the special booth. Regular portraits and individual wrestler merchandise available at the Stardom merchandise booth do not qualify for the event. The special portraits include a handwritten message from the wrestler along with a printed signature.
The portraits for the October 20, 2026 event are priced at 3,000 yen including tax. This price differs from that of regular meet-and-greet portraits. Payment is accepted in cash only.

Several precautions are in place for the handover event. Any acts of violence, abusive language, slander, or remarks violating public order and morals toward wrestlers or staff may result in the customer being asked to leave without a refund. Customers failing to follow rules may also be removed if deemed malicious.
The event concludes once the line ends. Due to time and stock limits, new queues will be refused after capacity is reached. Each person is limited to purchasing one portrait per session.

After payment, participants must join the event without holding any items. The use of smartphones or other devices to show or hand to wrestlers is not allowed. Gifts such as fan letters or presents cannot be accepted, and physical contact including handshakes is prohibited. Photography and videography are also not permitted.

title: AJ Francis Praises Carlos Silva's TNA Leadership
raw_title: Former WWE star says Carlos Silva recognizes his value amid two-year TNA championship absence
summary_src: AJ Francis praised Carlos Silva’s leadership capabilities in TNA while expressing he knows his value and contributions to the promotion. Speaking with Justin Dhillon of The Wrestling Classic, Francis discussed the change in TNA’s leadership style with Silva at the helm.
body: AJ Francis praised Carlos Silva’s leadership capabilities in TNA while expressing he knows his value and contributions to the promotion. Speaking with Justin Dhillon of The Wrestling Classic, Francis discussed the change in TNA’s leadership style with Silva at the helm. He also touched on not being a champion in the promotion for nearly two years, noting Silva has recognized the situation unlike others in leadership positions. “His leadership style is more so of real sports. He doesn’t ignore what’s right in front of his face. It’s a damn shame that it’s been two years since I’ve been a champion in TNA. And Carlos recognizes that. The old wrestling leadership style would be like, ‘Well, he’s still got a lot to prove, but let’s put a title on this guy who’s been here six months who nobody gives a sh*t about.’ Like that’s the old wrestling style. And Carlos recognizes what’s in front of his face.” Francis explained the difference between the former TNA management’s approach and current leadership under Silva. He praised the TNA President’s modern outlook on wrestling and credited him for securing the promotion’s TV deal with AMC . “That’s huge, right? And so to have someone like that at the helm that I can, I mean I talked to him today, he’s my favorite boss I ever worked for and I think that having him at the helm has been such a big help, such an improvement.” Francis debuted on TNA Wrestling in 2024 and shortly after won the Digital Media Championship. He has expressed interest in pursuing the TNA World Championship.
