title: Wren Sinclair Was Told She Was “Too Old” for WWE Before Signing
raw_title: Wren Sinclair Was Told She Was “Too Old” for WWE Before Signing
summary_src: Wren Sinclair made it to WWE, but apparently there was a point when she was being told that ship had already sailed. The NXT star revealed that before finally getting signed in 2023, she actually heard that she was “too old for WWE” and should start looking somewhere else.
body: Speaking to TMZ’s Inside the Ring , Wren was asked whether she thinks she’d still be wrestling today if WWE hadn’t eventually come calling. She initially wanted absolutely nothing to do with imagining that alternate timeline. “Um, let’s just not say I didn’t get signed. Um, no, I’m kidding.” Once the question got a little more serious, so did Wren. She admitted there were definitely moments before WWE when injuries had her wondering whether continuing to chase wrestling was even worth it. “Yeah. Um, so I think wrestling holds a really special place in my heart, and I definitely think there were times, um, injuries, where you question whether or not it’s worth it.” Then came the part that makes her eventual WWE signing even more interesting. Wren revealed that she was actually told at one point that she was too old for WWE and should turn her attention somewhere else. “Um, there were times in the process where I actually heard, like, uh, that I’m too old for WWE, um, and to, like, look elsewhere and whatnot.” “And I think at the end of the day, um, I’m not sure because I think I love this so much that it hurts sometimes when it doesn’t love you back.” “Um, and I’m a big proponent of mental health. So, depending on the journey that happened after, uh, said not being signed, um, I’m not sure.” Thankfully for Wren, she never had to find out how that version of the story ended. WWE ultimately signed her in 2023, and after everything it took to get there, she’s joking that the company is going to have a pretty difficult time getting rid of her now. “But I’m glad that I’m here, and I’m going to hold on to this, and I’m just never going to let them fire me.” Being told she was “too old” could have easily been the moment Wren decided to walk away, especially with injuries already making her question her future. Instead, she eventually got the WWE opportunity she was chasing, and now she’s holding onto it as tightly as she can. Subhojeet Mukherjee Subhojeet Mukherjee has covered pro wrestling for over 20 years, delivering trusted news and backstage updates to fans around the world.

title: Swerve Strickland doubts AEW-WWE crossover event
raw_title: Swerve Strickland doubts WWE x AEW show will ever happen: ‘Not in my lifetime at least’
summary_src: Swerve Strickland doubts that we’ll ever see AEW and WWE come together for a cross-promotional event. Though Tony Khan has sounded open to collaboration if the logistics were to make sense, a full-on AEW & WWE event would seem to be a near-impossibility given the current landscape of competition.
body: Swerve Strickland doubts that we’ll ever see AEW and WWE come together for a cross-promotional event. “No,” Strickland responded when asked about the possibility. “Not in my lifetime at least.” One of the obvious barriers is that, when co-promoting a show, AEW & WWE would want to protect their talent and have them win. As a performer, Strickland isn’t concerned with that and would be fine with every match ending in a double DQ if he got to face opponents like Oba Femi, Je’Von Evans, and Carmelo Hayes. “It’s control. It’s all about marketing. It’s like the NFL, WWE has to protect their shield. There’s no way they’d allow any of our wrestlers to look better and be better [than them],” Strickland said. “Oba Femi is a world beater. You gotta protect that and make sure he keeps looking good. Gunther, have to protect that. Roman [Reigns], have to protect that. Cody [Rhodes], have to protect, even more so because of AEW. There’s a lot of that happening. The Billboard article was largely centered around Strickland’s pursuits in hip-hop. It would be a dream come true for Strickland to reach heights like winning a Grammy Award, but wrestling is his first love. His AEW World Championship reign from 2024 means more than a Grammy would. “Wrestling has always been my true love,” he said. “A Grammy is more like, ‘Oh my God. How is this even possible?’ That’s another dream, but that’s what this World title was for me. I’m the only person to come from 205 Live and be a World Champion. I’m the only one. If you were ever to ask anyone from the 2017, 2018, 2019 class, and it would have been me out of all those guys? No way. Even me, no way. We don’t see it. A lot of people at that time didn’t see it. Same way in music. ‘Him? Who just did On the Radar ? He got some clicks and stuff, but no way.'” Joseph Currier Joseph Currier is a graduate of the University of Massachusetts, obtaining a journalism degree in 2016. Joseph joined F4W during his time at UMass and has now been writing about the industry for nearly a decade. In addition to his work with F4W, Joseph has previously contributed to Sports Illustrated's wrestling coverage. He lives in Massachusetts and is a diehard fan of the Boston sports teams and Liverpool Football Club.
summary: Swerve Strickland was asked about the possibility of a co-promoted show between AEW and WWE and responded that it will not happen in his lifetime. He cited the need for both companies to protect their talent and maintain their marketing image as a major barrier, comparing it to the NFL safeguarding its shield. Strickland added he would be open to facing stars like Oba Femi, Je’Von Evans and Carmelo Hayes even if every match ended in a double disqualification.

llm_long: Fans have long speculated about potential dream matches between WWE and AEW wrestlers. However, only a small number of independent matches involving lower-level talents from both promotions have taken place.

Swerve Strickland expressed doubt that cross-promotional events between the two companies will occur during his lifetime. He cited control and marketing as the primary reasons preventing such collaborations.

According to Strickland, WWE prioritizes protecting its image and ensuring its top stars maintain an advantage. He noted that talents like Obi Femi, Gunther, Roman Reigns, and Cody Rhodes are shielded to preserve their standings.
Strickland indicated he no longer seeks out specific opponents for fantasy matches. He now aims to position himself as the desired fantasy match for others.
In AEW, Strickland teams with Kofi and Austin Creed as part of The New Level. The group lost the AEW Trios Titles to Hangman Page, Bandido, and Brody King at WrestleDream.

Sign in to your TheSportster account ‘Timeless’ Toni Storm has been absent from AEW programming since her defeat over Marina Shafir all the way back at the 2026 Revolution PPV, with details sparse on the reasoning behind her prolonged disappearance. At the time, AEW posted an image to social media of Storm laid out backstage, posing the question of “Who Killed Toni Storm?” , with many clues left in plain sight around her, generating a murderm mystery angle with many different suspects. Following months of little word on her condition, several content creators were handed mysterious tapes regarding the missing Toni Storm, and here is everything we know about them. The character of ‘Timeless’ Toni Storm has been one of the most unique and creative in the entire history of AEW, with short films, black-and-white effects, silent movies, and more, and the latest development is yet another brand new storytelling technique on the part of AEW. At AEW’s WrestleDream 2026 PPV at the Addition Financial Arena in Orlando, Florida, several cassette tapes were handed out to some of the content creators who were present at the show. Amongst those who were on the receiving end of the tapes was Astrid Pizarro , who revealed the contents of the tapes on social media. With Toni Storm being off television for many months, being shown sprawled backstage following the Revolution 2026 PPV, there were a lot of question marks over the “whodunnit” angle, and these tapes could begin the path to answering the mystery. It is an intriguing approach from AEW, and one that is certainly welcomed as something new and different. The contents of the mystery missing tapes saw Renee Paquette narrating, unveiling audio files, stating the following (H/T Cultaholic ); "It is the year 2026. No one has seen or heard from Toni Storm. But last Wednesday, a package arrived at the offices of AEW in Jacksonville, Florida. A brown paper package tied up with string and no return address. Inside, five analogue cassettes, all from an indeterminate past, all meticulously labelled. It was long rumoured that Toni had a recording device inside her purse capturing every conversation, every meeting, every moment. Well, now those rumours are true. These are the Toni Storm Tapes." body: The wrestling world has been closely following the story, as WWE is still planning to hold its Crown Jewel premium live event there on Sat., Nov. 7. It prompted reports that the Embassy was order to be evacuated, which State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott corrected as only being for nonessential personnel and their families: The U.S. Department of State issued an ordered departure for non-emergency U.S. government employees and their family members in Saudi Arabia only. Iranian-supported Houthis have increasingly engaged in hostilities against Saudi Arabia, including attacks on civilian airports and other critical infrastructure resulting in civilian casualties and severe travel disruptions. title: What Worked and Didn't in AEW's Clockwork Carnage
raw_title: Big Vinny V: What did and didn’t work in AEW’s Clockwork Carnage match at WrestleDream
summary_src: All Elite Wrestling tried something new at WrestleDream, and innovation is always a good thing. Now that Clockwork Carnage has happened, was it a success? What worked in the match, what didn’t, and what should AEW change if they try it again?
body: All Elite Wrestling tried something new at WrestleDream, and innovation is always a good thing. Now that Clockwork Carnage has happened, was it a success? What worked in the match, what didn’t, and what should AEW change if they try it again? If you’re reading this, you’re probably familiar with the rules of Clockwork Carnage, but here’s a brief summary: Eight men compete in a match with two phases. The first is similar to a Royal Rumble, with pinfalls and submissions resulting in eliminations from the match. Once the eighth man enters, the second phase begins, and all surviving wrestlers compete in a 15-minute Iron Man match. AEW World Champion Will Ospreay invented the match, which became part of the story. He entered the match first, survived the first phase, and went on to win the scoring portion, pinning Adam Copeland with seconds to spare to pull out of a tie with Copeland, Samoa Joe, and Darby Allin. Most of the best parts of the match were Rumble-adjacent. Wrestling crowds love their countdowns and surprises, always rising to their feet to see who’s coming out next, even when they know who that person is. And with a new entrant every few minutes, there was always something exciting going on during the first phase. With so many participants in the match, it also delivers dream matchups, even if just for a few minutes. Clockwork Carnage was the first time Adam Copeland ever wrestled Ospreay, Okada, Konosuke Takeshita or Speedball Bailey. And if you don’t count Royal Rumbles, it was the first time he competed against Samoa Joe or Ricochet as well. There was a lot going on in the second phase of the match, a lot more than typically happens in AEW. Between the first eight matches of the main show and the first phase of Clockwork Carnage, there were 12 finishes (pins or submissions) in about three hours of ringtime, or one finish every 15 minutes. The 15 minutes of phase two then produced eleven finishes in 15 minutes. That’s a blistering pace in any promotion, but especially in AEW, where some of the biggest spots in each match are built around false finishes and nearfalls. After four hours of seeing people kick out of finishers, often at a count of one, it was bizarre to see so many wrestlers go down after just one shot. A side effect of that flurry of action is that some of the biggest results were lost in the shuffle. Did you even remember that Allin pinned Ospreay? A victory over the reigning world champion should have been a gigantic moment, but it was nearly forgotten because barely a minute went by before Allin also pinned Copeland, then was pinned himself by Ospreay. This all means that wrestlers who are normally protected are suddenly doing jobs left and right. Going into Clockwork Carnage, Copeland had only been pinned twice all year, first by Dax Harwood when FTR defeated Cage and Cope at Dynasty in April, and then by Jon Moxley in an eight-man tag team match at Grand Slam Mexico in August. summary: All Elite Wrestling introduced the Clockwork Carnage match at WrestleDream featuring eight competitors in two phases. The first phase functioned like a Royal Rumble with pinfalls and submissions causing eliminations while the second phase shifted to a 15-minute Iron Man match once the final man entered. Will Ospreay who created the concept entered first survived the opening phase and secured the victory by pinning Adam Copeland in the closing seconds to break a tie with Copeland Samoa Joe and Darby Allin per the Wrestling Observer.

title: WWE announces "WWE Campus Rush" recruitment tour
raw_title: WWE announces "WWE Campus Rush" recruitment tour - WWE
body: More Share Options More Share Options Share close facebook x threads email STAMFORD, Conn., October 11, 2022 – WWE today announced “WWE Campus Rush,” a multi-campus college athlete recruitment tour which will visit top NCAA Division I universities in search of the next generation of WWE Superstars. WWE Superstars such as Big E, Bianca Belair, Omos, Madcap Moss and Raquel Rodriguez, all of whom have transitioned from college athletics to a career in WWE, will address student athletes at each tour stop and educate them about the global leader in sports entertainment. In conjunction with each university, student athletes will learn about WWE’s “Next In Line” (NIL) program and the resources that they can utilize including brand building, social media, fan engagement, media training and more. Each stop of the tour will include a lively competition that features student athletes facing off on the microphone to cut the best WWE-style promo. “WWE Campus Rush” will begin tomorrow, October 12 at the University of Mississippi and will visit a total of eight universities from five conferences during the fall semester, including: Looking ahead to 2023, ‘WWE Campus Rush” will visit the University of Florida, University of Michigan, Michigan State University, University of North Carolina, Texas A&M University, University of Oklahoma, Auburn University, University of Illinois, and Northwestern University. “WWE Campus Rush will serve as a core pillar in our commitment to finding the next generation of WWE Superstars among today’s elite college athletes,” said James Kimball, WWE’s Head of Talent Operations and Strategy. “The talent pipeline from college sports to WWE has proven to be effective, as evidenced by current champions Roman Reigns and Bianca Belair, and we are looking forward to visiting major college campuses around the country to introduce ourselves in a new way.” WWE launched its “Next In Line” program in December 2021 and currently has 25 active athletes with NIL partnerships. Three athletes from the inaugural class have joined the company following their graduation from school and have started training full-time at the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Fla. Additionally, WWE has exclusively hosted more than 100 college athletes from more than a dozen different sports at multi-day talent tryouts in 2022. WWE signed nearly 50 athletes from those events in a growing effort to find the most talented athletes in the world.

title: Damian Priest Details Split From R-Truth
raw_title: Damian Priest Explains Why He Turned On R-Truth, 'This Is An Individual Business'
summary_src: Damian Priest explains why he turned on R-Truth. Since ending his partnership with Truth in September, Damian Priest has shown fans an entirety different side of his character. Speaking in a new interview with WWE Radio's Off The Ropes, Priest took a moment to explain his current mindset.
body: Since ending his partnership with Truth in September, Damian Priest has shown fans an entirety different side of his character. Speaking in a new interview with WWE Radio’s Off The Ropes , Priest took a moment to explain his current mindset. “It’s one of those things that I’m just looking around, looking and reading the room and I seeing everybody or a lot of others achieve things that I want and progressing. What are they doing? What am I not doing? Everybody’s just doing what they gotta do and I’m over here playing with my friends. That’s the difference. Am I doing a job or am I pretending to do a job? I was pretending, I was playing. I was trying to appease other people instead of, you know, worrying about myself. You might be in a tag team for a minute, but at the end of the day, this is an individual business. This is not a team sport. You gotta start thinking about yourself, because when I sign a contract, I’m not signing a contract with the Judgment Day. I’m not signing a contract with R-Truth. I’m signing a contract for Damian Priest. So, Damian Priest needs to be the priority. Once I put that into focus and kind of started — I had to go back home and remember how I started this journey and what got me here. Once I started doing that and then focusing on, on me, I already feel — I haven’t even done what I’m setting out to do yet, but I already feel good about it. It’s just a whole different vibe, a whole different feel. I’m in a really good place now.” Check out the current lineup for the October 23 episode of SmackDown by clicking here. title: TNA Legend Sends Message to Fans Divided Over WWE and AEW
raw_title: TNA Legend Sends Message to Fans Divided Over WWE and AEW
body: 0 Former TNA star Christopher Daniels believes professional wrestling fans should support the entire industry rather than focus on rivalries between promotions. WWE remains one of the industry’s longest-established promotions, while AEW has built its own audience since launching in 2019. The company continues to present weekly programming featuring established names and emerging talent. Daniels also encouraged fans who enjoy professional wrestling to give AEW a chance, noting that the promotion continues to attract new viewers. “Listen, if you’re a professional wrestling fan, I think you should support all professional wrestling. And, you know, WWE is the oldest game in the game. They’re the oldest group in the game, but AEW is coming along strong. AEW is great, and hopefully, if you like professional wrestling, AEW presents tremendous professional wrestling week in and week out. “So, if you’re against that, I don’t know what to tell you. Go watch something else. That’s fine. But we’ve got plenty of fans, and we’re bringing more fans along the way, and I look forward to showing them professional wrestling each and every week,” Daniels said. Daniels began his professional wrestling career in 1993 and went on to compete for several major promotions, including WWE, WCW, and ECW. He made televised appearances for WWE as an enhancement talent but never signed a full-time contract. Daniels later established himself as a prominent figure in TNA Wrestling, where he became a three-time X Division Champion and earned recognition for his work in the company’s X Division. After leaving TNA in 2014, Daniels joined Ring of Honor, where he continued wrestling and eventually captured the ROH World Championship. In 2019, he signed with AEW alongside Frankie Kazarian and Scorpio Sky as part of SoCal Uncensored. Daniels also served as AEW’s head of talent relations, contributing to the promotion’s development behind the scenes. The 32-year veteran officially retired from in-ring competition on January 18, 2025, following a Texas Death Match against “Hangman” Adam Page on AEW Collision. How can something once so right go so wrong? Gunther is one of the best technical wrestlers in the world. Of that there is no doubt. Whether it be under his slimmed down current name or as Walter, Gunther is an old-school master technician who can sell a story like few others. Triple H, newly in charge of creative, saw how great the Ring General was and turned him into the greatest Intercontinental Champion of all-time. After that came a King of the Ring crown and two runs with the World Heavyweight Championship. Then he found the ultimate way to keep going when out of the title scene. Gunther became a career killer, retiring a trifecta of legends in Goldberg, John Cena, and AJ Styles. title: TNA Signs Hall of Famer to New Deal After Bound For Glory Title Win — Report
raw_title: TNA Signs Hall of Famer to New Deal After Bound For Glory Title Win — Report
body: 0 Amazing Red has reportedly signed a new contract with TNA following his return at Bound For Glory 2026. Red’s return to TNA initially appeared to centre on his Hall of Fame induction at the October 11 event. However, he surprised fans by announcing during his induction speech that he would compete for the vacant X-Division Championship later that night. The veteran wrestler bested BDE, Rich Swann, KC Navarro, Fabian Aichner, Cedric Alexander, and Ryan Nemeth in a seven-man scramble to capture the title. He secured the victory by hitting KC Navarro with the Code Red, earning his fourth reign with the championship. “TNA Hall of Famer The Amazing Red, who won the X-Division Championship at Bound for Glory earlier this month, has officially signed with the promotion, PWInsiderElite.com can confirm. The promotion has yet to officially announce the deal, but we can confirm it is done and Red has committed to the promotion,” the report stated. Red previously held the X-Division Championship in 2010. His latest victory ended a gap of more than 16 years between reigns and added another milestone to his TNA career. The 44-year-old is also the founder of House of Glory Wrestling, an independent promotion based in New York. Red helped establish himself as one of the X-Division’s influential performers during his earlier TNA runs between 2002 and 2004 and 2009 and 2011. The title had become vacant after Leon Slater exercised Option C to challenge for the TNA World Championship. Slater subsequently won the world title , defeating Nic Nemeth in the Bound For Glory main event. Fans can revisit WrestleZone’s full coverage of the event here . title: U.S. Embassy Orders Staff Exit From Saudi Arabia
raw_title: Report: U.S. Embassy orders ‘non-emergency’ staff to leave Saudi Arabia
summary_src: "Non-essential" U.S. Embassy staffers in Saudi Arabia, which is scheduled to host Crown Jewel next month, have been ordered to leave.
body: U.S. Embassy staffers are being pulled out of Saudi Arabia, per a new report. “Non-essential” U.S. Embassy staff and their families were ordered to leave the country on Wednesday, per a report from AFP. Reuters was told that others in the Gulf region could be ordered to leave soon as well. The order highlights ongoing caution in the country following numerous attacks from the Iran-backed Houthis. The group most notably struck Riyadh International Airport earlier this month, an attack which left 13 dead and over 300 injured. The airport remained highly restricted as of early this week, Bloomberg reported. Many commercial airlines have temporarily suspended their service to Riyadh International, the largest travel hub in the country. An upcoming boxing match between Canelo Alvarez and Christian Mbilli remains scheduled to take place in Riyadh 10 days from now. On November 7, just a week later, WWE is expected to visit the city for Crown Jewel. Business conferences, a major annual tennis tournament, and an international golf stop set to take place in Riyadh have all been postponed due to the attacks.
summary: Non-essential U.S. Embassy personnel and their families were directed to depart Saudi Arabia on Wednesday amid security concerns following Houthi attacks, including a recent strike on Riyadh International Airport that killed 13 and injured over 300. Several commercial flights to the airport have been suspended and multiple sporting and business events in Riyadh postponed. WWE's Crown Jewel event remains scheduled for November 7 in the city.

title: Match Made: Roman Reigns vs Sami Zayn- 5 Things WWE Fans Need to Know Before Crown Jewel
raw_title: Roman Reigns vs Sami Zayn- 5 Things WWE Fans Need to Know Before Crown Jewel
body: Roman Reigns and Sami Zayn are headed for a collision in Riyadh, and this time both men are holding championship. At WWE Crown Jewel 2026, World Heavyweight Champion Reigns will face Undisputed WWE Champion Zayn in a Champion vs Champion match for the Men’s Crown Jewel Championship. Fans have wanted this rematch for years, and it comes with plenty of history attached. Here is what you need to know about Roman Reigns vs Sami Zayn before the bell rings. This is a clash of the two brands. Reigns represents Raw as World Heavyweight Champion, while Zayn arrives as the Undisputed WWE Champion from SmackDown. The winner takes home the Crown Jewel Championship, a special title WWE has attached to the Saudi Arabia event in recent years. Seth Rollins won the men’s version last year in Perth, so the bar for a memorable main event is already set. Longtime fans know this story. Zayn became the Honorary Uce of The Bloodline, earning his place beside The Tribal Chief before turning on Reigns at Royal Rumble 2023. This led to their Elimination Chamber 2023 showdown in Montreal, where Roman Reigns retained the WWE Universal Championship in front of a suprised crowd. It remains one of the most emotional WWE storylines of the last decade, and this match is a long-awaited sequel. The Head of the Table is back on top. He beat CM Punk at WrestleMania to win the World Heavyweight Championship, then retained against LA Knight at Money in the Bank with a Spear. That marked his fifth successful title defense. WWE has also leaned into a new Reigns, who is fighting his battles without his family interfering at ringside. That makes him look more dangerous and more self-reliant than ever. Zayn’s rise to WWE Champion came as a surprise when he beat Punk. According to many experts, WWE made the title change with a Crown Jewel main event in mind. Whether thatreport is fully accurate or not, the timing certainly fits. Zayn is the ultimate fan favorite, and a Riyadh crowd should give him a warm welcome. He has also won multiple world titles since he last stood across from Reigns, which gives him a different kind of confidence this time. The question everyone is asking is who wins. Many analysts expect Reigns to come out on top and move on to the men’s WarGames match, but WWE loves a curveball. If Zayn pulls off the upset, it would instantly become one of the biggest WWE title moments of the year. Keep an eye on possible Bloodline callbacks and interference too, because Crown Jewel is rarely predictable. Roman Reigns vs Sami Zayn works because it has everything a premium live event needs: two world champions, a personal backstory, and a stadium crowd ready to explode. It’s a rare case where the story and the stakes both feel earned. Whether you’re a fan of The Original Tribal Chief or a believer in Zayn finally getting his redemption, this is the match to watch at WWE Crown Jewel 2026. Dragunov did not compete at WrestleDream. He is scheduled to have his first match in the promotion on the upcoming episode of Dynamite.

In a recent interview, Dragunov addressed his contract negotiations with WWE. He chose not to criticize the company and instead provided measured comments about the discussions and his decision not to renew his deal.
WWE reduces its roster following WrestleMania each year. This year the company requested that multiple talents accept a 50 percent pay reduction to remain under contract.
Several performers who declined the pay cut were released from WWE. Among them, the group formerly known as New Day in WWE rejected the offer and were subsequently let go.
That group debuted in AEW at the All In event held in Wembley Stadium. They captured the AEW World Trios Championships on the same day in partnership with Swerve Strickland.

title: On the Record: Tama Tonga Speaks On Controversy Over Ilja Dragunov Post After His AEW Debut
raw_title: Tama Tonga Addresses Controversy Over Ilja Dragunov Post After His AEW Debut
summary_src: Tama Tonga has officially responded after Dave Meltzer questioned the timing of his recent Ilja Dragunov post. The WWE star says there wasn’t some old-school wrestling playbook behind it — he simply thought it was a good clip to post.
body: The whole thing started when Tonga recently uploaded footage from Dragunov’s WWE run showing him no-selling Dragunov’s chops on SmackDown. The timing immediately got people talking because the post came only days after Dragunov made his AEW debut. “He did a post of Ilja, and he showed Jey chopping him and basically no-selling him. I don’t know if he was trying to get brownie points or someone told him to do it — I couldn’t tell you.” Meltzer found the whole thing interesting because it reminded him of an old-school promotional tactic. He compared it to something promoters such as Bill Watts and Ole Anderson would do when wrestlers left their territories for WWE. “But I saw that post and was like, ‘That’s an interesting shot.’ It’s like I haven’t seen that one used — that’s like out of the Bill Watts, Ole Anderson playbook of the ’80s.” According to Meltzer, those promoters would sometimes dig up footage of departing wrestlers getting beaten up and put it back in front of fans. He saw at least some similarity between that tactic and Tonga suddenly posting the Dragunov clip. “They would take stars of WWE who used to work in their territory and show clips of them getting beaten up.” “Hey, I seen Dave Meltzer talk about my post yesterday. I put out a post on Dragunov. Boy, it started stirring some s***.” Tonga then questioned why everyone was reading so much into the clip in the first place. As far as he’s concerned, it was simply a good post. Then came Tonga’s response to Meltzer comparing the move to an old wrestling playbook. He jokingly dubbed Meltzer “Great Uncle Dave” before making it clear he wasn’t following anybody’s blueprint. “Great Uncle Dave over here said I took it from a playbook. I don’t even read a playbook, bruh.” Subhojeet Mukherjee Subhojeet Mukherjee has covered pro wrestling for over 20 years, delivering trusted news and backstage updates to fans around the world.

llm_long: NJPW has revealed the first matches for Tanahashi Jam 2, an event produced by President Hiroshi Tanahashi that features talent from multiple promotions. The card includes cross-promotional bouts involving stars from DDT and Pro Wrestling NOAH alongside NJPW wrestlers.

A six-man tag match will pit Zack Sabre Jr. and Kosei Fujita teaming with DDT's Takeshi Masada against Hartley Jackson, Ryohei Oiwa and NOAH's Kaito Kiyomiya. Sabre Jr. maintains strong ties to DDT, while Fujita and Masada share a history of teaming together. Oiwa and Kiyomiya also have a close connection from Oiwa's time in NOAH.

Shun Skywalker will make his first defense of the NJPW World Television Title against Toru Yano. The two have been feuding since Skywalker captured the championship from Konosuke Takeshita in late September.

An eight-man tag team match will see the House of Torture's SHO, SANADA, Yujiro Takahashi and Yoshinobu Kanemaru face Yuya Uemura, Aaron Wolf, Tatsumi Fujinami and DDT's Kaisei Takechi. Takechi previously competed against the House of Torture at last year's Purge Night of Torture event and teamed with Uemura earlier this year at Wrestle Kingdom.
Shota Umino will face Taiwanese wrestler Axe Wang in a singles match. Wang previously appeared at NJPW's Taiwan event in 2024 and trained at the New Japan Dojo, making this an international showdown.
The event will also include a Monster Rambo match, though no participants have been announced yet.

body: The reigning X-Division Champion Amazing Red is reportedly now signed to the TNA banner. title: Swerve Strickland Says WWE-AEW Co-Promotion Will Never Happen
raw_title: Swerve Strickland Explains Why Cross-Promotional Event Between WWE & AEW Won't Happen
summary_src: Swerve Strickland explained why he doesn't believe a WWE and AEW co-promoted event will ever happen in his lifetime.
body: While stars have jumped between the companies since AEW's inception in 2019, there have never been any co-promoted events between them. According to former AEW World Champion Swerve Strickland, who recently spoke with Billboard , that's never going to happen, at least not in his lifetime. Strickland said it's all about control and marketing. "It's like the NFL, WWE has to protect their shield," Strickland told the outlet. "There's no way they'd allow any of our wrestlers to look better and be better [than them]. Obi Femi is a world beater. You gotta protect that and make sure he keeps looking good. Gunther, have to protect that. Roman [Reigns], have to protect that. Cody [Rhodes], have to protect, even more so because of AEW." Strickland said it's even more difficult when it comes to WWE's women, like Rhea Ripley, being protected. Many fans want to see Seth Rollins and AEW World Champion Will Ospreay wrestle a match , in part, thanks to previous heat between them on social media , but Strickland questioned once again who would be protected. "Us in the locker room, we just wanna have these matches," he said. "I'm good friends with Carmelo [Hayes], Jevon [Evans] and Oba. Those are my boys. I love those guys. I don't care who wins. Double DQs. I don't care." Like AEW and NJPW, WWE currently has a partnership with TNA Wrestling , established at the beginning of 2025. Ahead of WrestleMania 41, the company announced it had acquired AAA .

He explained to Billboard that WWE prioritizes protecting its top stars and image above all else. Strickland cited examples including Gunther, Roman Reigns, Cody Rhodes, Rhea Ripley and noted the difficulty in determining protection for a potential Seth Rollins versus Will Ospreay match.

Swerve Strickland expressed doubt that cross-promotional events between the two companies will occur during his lifetime. He cited control and marketing as the primary reasons preventing such collaborations.

According to Strickland, WWE prioritizes protecting its image and ensuring its top stars maintain an advantage. He noted that talents like Obi Femi, Gunther, Roman Reigns, and Cody Rhodes are shielded to preserve their standings.
Strickland indicated he no longer seeks out specific opponents for fantasy matches. He now aims to position himself as the desired fantasy match for others.

title: On the Record: Penta Opens Up On Backstage Chaos Before WWE World Title Match Against Roman Reigns
raw_title: Penta Reveals Backstage Chaos Before WWE World Title Match Against Roman Reigns
summary_src: Penta’s first match against Roman Reigns looked huge on WWE television, but backstage it was apparently complete chaos.
body: “This is a good question, brother, because, oh man, now I’m relaxed. I cannot tell you what happened all day. But that day, bro, was too much stress for me because, you know, I had a lot of things in my brain.” The match itself was already a massive deal for Penta, but WWE had plenty more planned around it. His elaborate arrival involved a horse, and that quickly became another thing he had to worry about before even getting near the ring. “You know, the first thing is against Roman Reigns, first time ever, Mexico City, my family is there. So, hours before that, you saw my arrival shot in the arena with the horse. You saw that?” As cool as the entrance looked when everything came together, getting there apparently wasn’t easy. Penta revealed there were problems with the horse only a few hours before the match while he was simultaneously being pulled in several other directions. “Okay, two hours before my match, maybe three, so problems with the horse. It’s not here, maybe it’s delayed, maybe something. You need makeup, I need to go to the ring, you know, I practice. Oh, you have an interview. Oh, you have meet-and-greet.” Penta barely had a chance to think about the fact that he was about to wrestle Roman Reigns. Every time he finished one responsibility, somebody was apparently waiting to send him somewhere else. “In that moment, everything was on my brain. ‘Hey, Penta, you need an interview. Oh, Roman is here. Oh, the horse has come.’ You know, I became crazy, bro.” Then suddenly it was time to wrestle. Penta said everything moved so quickly that he essentially went from dealing with the backstage madness to being told he was next. “In that moment, when I opened my eyes, like, ‘You are next.’ Oh, okay. You know, everything was too fast.” It wasn’t until two days later that the magnitude of the night finally hit him. Penta found himself sitting alone in his garden when he was finally able to slow down and realize what he’d just experienced. “Bro, to be honest, two days later than my match, I started sitting in my garden, like, ‘Wow.’ Now, bro, I promise you, two days, two days later.” Despite all that chaos, Penta tried to enjoy whatever he could while it was happening. Even the people helping put together his presentation were rushing to make sure everything was ready in time. “But in the same moment, I tried to enjoy every moment, you know, every interview. The name in Mexico here is Pacho Okil, I used him for my presentation. So the guy is, ‘Hey, I’m going late. You come on.’ You know, everything was rushed.” “But in the end, the day was perfect. title: 5 Greatest WWE Golden Era Championship Reigns
raw_title: 5 Greatest WWE Golden Era Championship Reigns
body: October 21, 2026 By Daniel Sinasac WWE , History , Pro Wrestling , WWE Universe The WWE Golden Era was the start of something special for World Wrestling Entertainment. Before that era, WWE was in its territorial phase, happy to sell out arenas across the Northeastern United States . Then the boom happened, and WWE morphed into a national conglomerate and began its path into mainstream media. This path to greatness was started during the WWE Golden Era, not just for the company, but for the men and women who captured championship gold. This era produced the most impressive reigns the wrestling world has ever seen. These individual reigns have become legendary, establishing Hall of Fame careers that will live on forever. Each WWE Golden Era championship saw a great run, and below are the wrestlers with the single greatest championship reigns. WWE’s Women’s Championship was not a strong title during the WWE Golden Era. The Women’s division was not taken very seriously, and the list of credible contenders was short. Most fans can’t even remember any specific reigns with the championship, outside of one iconic stint that started at WrestleMania. Wendi Richter was a huge ally of the Rock N’ Wrestling Connection. She and Cyndi Lauper developed a strong partnership as MTV and WWE joined forces. It was this relationship that had a lot to do with WWE becoming a national sensation, and it was capped off with Richter capturing the WWE Women’s Championship at WrestleMania. It was a law of diminishing returns after WrestleMania, with Richter holding onto the championship for 238 days, but it was by far the most impressive reign of the WWE Golden Era. title: How WWE Can Correct Their Big Mistakes — Joe Hendry
raw_title: Joe Hendry: How WWE Can Correct Their Big Mistakes
body: October 21, 2026 By Josh Prost WWE , Pro Wrestling , Raw , WWE Universe Joe Hendry signed a contract with WWE in November 2025 after spending the previous year making appearances in the company, including a spot in both the 2025 Royal Rumble and on night two of WrestleMania 41 against Randy Orton. There are some wrestlers in WWE that benefit from being silly. Danhausen’s antics have made other wrestlers extremely mad, which has excited the fans. Otis has been a funny man for years, and his popularity has increased in recent years. Hendry has always had silly songs as part of his career, but his songs in WWE haven’t been popular with fans. Everyone disliked his concert with Danhausen , as their combined lyrics were strange and no one really knew what was going on with the dancers or Minihausens around the ring. His feud with McDonagh was also weird, as calling him a Funko Pop and having an actual person wear a Funko Pop on his head seemed very childish. He also lost the feud, which didn’t help him. Wrestlers can be silly, but being silly with a child’s sense of humor isn’t going to get him fans. He doesn’t have to be serious, but he needs to dial back the silliness to get everyone back on his side. Everyone knows that Hendry is great with a guitar and has a catchy singing voice. But since his main roster debut six months ago, that’s all he’s done. He’s just sung songs about McDonagh and Paul while not making much of an impact in the ring. Going back to championship pursuits will show fans that he can actually wrestle. He’s won several titles on the English independent circuit before being signed to a major company. When he was with TNA Wrestling, he was the Impact Digital Media Champion for 266 days and the TNA World Champion for 126 days. His NXT Championship run was for 60 days, as he defended it against Jackson Drake on the February 10 NXT and Ricky Saints at NXT Vengeance Day. There’s no question that he is capable of being a champion on the main roster. Having him just sing and lose matches is a waste of talent for a man who can actually have good matches in the ring. After Monday night’s loss, WWE has a choice to make with Hendry. He is very popular with his songs, but the results in the ring haven’t been what fans have wanted. The Danhausen concert didn’t turn out well; he lost in embarrassing fashion to Bron Breakker , and his feud with McDonagh was childish. This isn’t the same man that was entertaining in Ring of Honor and TNA Wrestling over the past few years. Things need to change for him to be successful on the main roster. He needs to be less silly to appeal to everyone watching WWE programming. Kids may like him, but adults have a problem with his presentation. He also needs to start challenging for titles. Six months in without a title opportunity for him isn’t a good look. He’s been a champion several times, and WWE needs to start treating him like one. title: Drew McIntyre Says He's In Best Shape Of His Life
raw_title: Drew McIntyre Talks Staying In Shape While Away From WWE: “I’m In The Best Shape Of My Life”
body: Drew McIntyre has not appeared on WWE programming since he lost an Unsanctioned Match to Jacob Fatu at Night 1 of WrestleMania 42 . During his time away from WWE, McIntyre has been filming several major acting projects, including the reboot of Highlander – where he plays the role of Angus, and the movie The Last Druid – which filmed in Barcelona, Spain. He also is starring in the digital series Agent of Shadows, which is produced by WWE and ReelShort. McIntyre was recently a guest on Insight with Chris Van Vliet , where he discussed staying in shape while being away from WWE, being even bigger now than the last time we saw him, and says that he is in the best shape of his life. CVV: I feel like you’ve gotten bigger since the last time I saw you! DM: “I have gotten bigger since the last time you saw me. I believe I was around 275 prior to Mania.” CVV: So, are you doing all this because you’re getting ready to return to WWE? DM: “No, I just like to look good. Obviously, I’m in the best shape of my life. I feel physically great. I’m sure you saw the clip that was out there when I was running the ropes. I was just rolling around the ring at Miro’s school, Rusev; you’re very welcome. It’s here in Nashville, and my buddy was like, I’ve never seen anybody hit the ropes so fast because he’s not seen Bron Breaker, the only other man that’s faster than me. He got a little clip, a 15-second clip, and it blew up online. I think over 8 million views, so people seem to be excited about the idea that I’m coming back to wrestling, but I’m just seeing what happens right now. I’m enjoying myself. Hollywood Drew is jumping from project to project, and when the time is right, WWE is home.” You can see the clip of Drew McIntyre talking about being in the best shape of his life on Insight with Chris Van Vliet below. You can check out the full episode of Insight with Chris Van Vliet featuring WWE Superstar Drew McIntyre below. We will keep you updated here at Bodyslam.net on any news or information regarding Drew McIntyre and his potential WWE return when it becomes known. title: “if you’re a professional wrestling fan, I think you should support all professional wrestling” — Christopher Daniels
raw_title: Christopher Daniels: “if you’re a professional wrestling fan, I think you should support all professional wrestling”
body: While speaking to Going Ringside , former AEW tag team champion Christopher Daniels was asked about tribalism in wrestling. Here is what Daniels had to say… “Listen, if you’re a professional wrestling fan, I think you should support all professional wrestling. WWE is the oldest game in the game. They’re the oldest group in the game, but AEW is coming along strong. AEW is great, and hopefully, if you like professional wrestling, AEW presents tremendous professional wrestling week in and week out. So, if you’re against that, I don’t know what to tell you. Go watch something else. That’s fine. But we’ve got plenty of fans, and we’re bringing more fans along the way. I look forward to showing them professional wrestling each and every week.”

title: Swerve Strickland explains WWE avoiding AEW crossover
raw_title: Swerve Strickland is right on the money about why WWE will never do a joint show with AEW
body: Link AEW Cain A. Knight is a hardcore number-cruncher who has analyzed and covered pro wrestling for Cageside Seats since 2014, and followed the sport as a fan going back to the 1980’s. In a new interview with Billboard , AEW star Swerve Strickland was asked if there will ever be a cross-promotional event between WWE and AEW in his lifetime. After answering “no,” Swerve said it’s because WWE will never allow any AEW stars to look better than theirs. It’s control. It’s all about marketing. It’s like the NFL, WWE has to protect their shield. There’s no way they’d allow any of our wrestlers to look better and be better [than them]. Obi Femi is a world beater. You gotta protect that and make sure he keeps looking good. Gunther, have to protect that. Roman [Reigns], have to protect that. Cody [Rhodes], have to protect, even more so because of AEW. There’s a lot of that happening. Swerve is correct, but one key point he fails to address is whether or not AEW would allow WWE stars to look better than theirs. Regardless, the decision-makers in suits may have a problem with putting over stars from another company, but the wrestlers want to wrestle each other, and Swerve doesn’t care who wins and loses. “Us in the locker room, we just wanna have these matches. I’m good friends with Carmelo [Hayes], Jevon [Evans] and Oba. Those are my boys. I love those guys. I don’t care who wins. Double DQs. I don’t care.” The fact that Strickland tweeted his support for Oba Femi during WWE’s Money in the Bank PLE earlier this month seems to back up his implication that the war between WWE and AEW is a front office thing much more than a locker room thing. body: AEW Dynamite is live tonight from the Watsco Center in Coral Gables, Florida, and will air on TBS and HBO Max. This week’s episode will feature the fallout from Saturday’s AEW WrestleDream in Orlando. Will Ospreay and Adam Copeland will team together on the show after Saturday’s Clockwork Carnage match came down to the wire between the two of them. Ospreay and Copeland will take on Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight on Dynamite, with Fletcher and Knight coming off a well-reviewed tag team match against the Young Bucks at WrestleDream. Also scheduled for Wednesday’s show, new AEW signee Ilja Dragunov will make his promotional in-ring debut. He’ll face Speedball Mike Bailey in singles competition. There will also be an AEW World Tag Team Championship eliminator match on the show as Matt and Nick Jackson, the Young Bucks (c), face Mark Davis and Jake Doyle of the Don Callis Family. A number one contender’s match for the TBS Championship is also scheduled as Maya World goes up against Queen Aminata. Dragunov did not compete at WrestleDream. He is scheduled to have his first match in the promotion on the upcoming episode of Dynamite.

In a recent interview, Dragunov addressed his contract negotiations with WWE. He chose not to criticize the company and instead provided measured comments about the discussions and his decision not to renew his deal.
WWE reduces its roster following WrestleMania each year. This year the company requested that multiple talents accept a 50 percent pay reduction to remain under contract.

That group debuted in AEW at the All In event held in Wembley Stadium. They captured the AEW World Trios Championships on the same day in partnership with Swerve Strickland.

title: Triple H Narrates Tyrese Haliburton NBA Return Video
raw_title: WWE's Triple H Narrates Video On Return Of Tyrese Haliburton As New NBA Season Begins
summary_src: Paul "Triple H" Levesque narrated a hype video for the return of Indiana Pacers star Tyrese Haliburton ahead of the beginning of the new NBA season.
body: Now that he's healthy, Haliburton is marking his return in a big way. Ahead of his first game back, he took to X (formerly Twitter) to release a hype video , narrated by Paul "Triple H" Levesque. "The brighter the lights. The higher the stakes. The more he shined," Levesque is heard saying in the video, which begins with Haliburton highlights. "He gave an entire city something to believe in. The world saw what he lost. Now, they get to see what he's found." The video then cuts to a few shots of Haliburton immediately after suffering the injury. It then shows his rehabilitation, in a doctor's office, as well as working out in the gym and back on the court. "The injury changed him," Levesque goes on. "Just not the way they hoped. Doubters are back. Unfortunately for him, so is he. Zero. Doubt." In addition to the return hype video, Fightful shared photos on X of Haliburton's arrival to the Pacer's home opener. The star dressed in Triple H's iconic leather-denim jacket combination from his 2002 return to "WWE Raw" in Madison Square Garden after being sidelined for nearly a year with a severe quad injury. Haliburton's most recent WWE appearance came during the July edition of Saturday Night's Main Event . He and Seth Rollins went face-to-face with World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns and New York Knicks star, and 2026 NBA Champion, Jalen Brunson.
summary: With the new NBA season underway, Indiana Pacers guard Tyrese Haliburton released a hype video for his return from injury. WWE's Paul "Triple H" Levesque provides the narration, emphasizing Haliburton's resilience after his setback, rehabilitation and comeback. Per Fightful, Haliburton arrived at the Pacers' home opener wearing Triple H's iconic leather and denim jacket from his 2002 WWE return.

raw_title: Report: Amazing Red Signs With TNA Wrestling
body: Mike Johnson at PWInsider reports that Red has signed a new deal with TNA Wrestling. Amazing Red was inducted into the TNA Hall of Fame at TNA Bound For Glory. An hour later, he won the vacant TNA X-Division Championship in a scramble match. Red competed in TNA from 2001 to 2005 and then again from 2009 to 2011. He is a four-time X-Division Champion. Prior to Bound For Glory, his last X-Division Title reign came in 2010. TNA has not officially announced Red signing with the company. They announced the signing of Shotzi Blackheart and the re-signing of Santino Marella this week.

title: If You Complained About How WWE Didn't Use Ilja Dragonuv, This Is Your Moment To Show Up And Support Him
raw_title: IF YOU COMPLAINED ABOUT HOW WWE DIDN'T USE ILJA DRAGONUV, THIS IS YOUR MOMENT TO SHOW UP AND SUPPORT HIM - PWInsider
body: DMFirst Veer Game odds uden om ROFUS Jalwa Game Goa Game Raja Game MaanWin IF YOU COMPLAINED ABOUT HOW WWE DIDN'T USE ILJA DRAGONUV, THIS IS YOUR MOMENT TO SHOW UP AND SUPPORT HIM By Mike Johnson on 2026-10-21 08:59:00 For months, the complaints were endless, loud and relentless. Every time Ilja Dragonuv wasn't utilized by World Wrestling Entertainment, the online discourse was the same - where is he? Why isn't he being utilized? Why isn't be on TV? Why isn't he getting pushed? The Russian-born German star, 33, has been beloved for his unhinged intensity, stiff striking, and emotionally charged physical storytelling for as long as he's been performing. The "Unbesiegbar" (Unbeatable) Mad Dragon, Dragunov gained international acclaim before signing with WWE, where captured the WWE NXT UK Championship by ending GUNTHER's insane 870-day reign with an instant classic. He moved to the United States, where he held the WWE NXT title and eventually, the main roster, where he won the WWE United States Championship. Recognized for his intense in-ring style, marked by his signature Torpedo Moskva flying headbutt and H-Bomb forearm strike, Dragonuv excels at believable, hard-hitting encounters and dramatic, resilient selling that position him as one of the most physical performers in modern professional wrestling. He was the exact style of performer that Paul Levesque's NXT popularized themselves utilizing, so it was was unthinkable that under Levesque's creative direction that Dragonuv wouldn't be a massive part of WWE, yet it didn't truly happen. An ACL tear hobbed his momentum for sure, but his return was well received, as was his U.S. title run. However, once 2026 began, other than being unceremoniously tossed from The Royal Rumble by Brock Lesnar, there was nothing truly memorable for Ilja creatively and then, he chose to exit the company. The outpouring of shock and anger over the exit was palpable, to the point I even received emailed accusing me of lying when PWInsider.com broke the news of his exit. No matter how you feel about Dragonuv's run in WWE, the one constant was that die-hard wrestling fans loved his work and loudly complained online when he wasn't utilized in a stronger manner. If they truly believe WWE whiffed the ball on Dragonuv, those same fans will get the chance to see him step up to bat tonight for All Elite Wrestling on Dynamite. As famously stated in Field of Dreams, "If you build it, they will come." Well, Tony Khan built his ballfield and now Dragonuv has been invited to join the team...but will the fans who championed him and blamed WWE for Dragonuv's main roster run falling flat actually take that negative feedback, flip the hourglass and go cheer on Ilja in his new environment? If they don't, every single person who lamented that the main roster machine was sanding down Dragonuv's violent edges should be ashamed of themselves. title: Saudi Airport Attack Kills One Ahead of WWE Crown Jewel
raw_title: Saudi government reports 1 dead, 8 injured following attack on Dammam airport
summary_src: An airport in Dammam was attacked on Wednesday night, Saudi Arabia's aviation authority confirmed in a statement.
body: King Fahd International Airport in Dammam was struck on Wednesday night, per an announcement by the country’s General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA). GACA confirmed that one death and eight injuries occurred due to the attack. Damage to airport property was mentioned as well. No further details are known at the moment. Dammam is an eastern city in Saudi Arabia, sitting on the coast of the Persian Gulf. It is the fifth-most populous region in the country. Saudi Arabia has suffered numerous attacks in recent weeks, many claimed by the Iran-backed Houthis. Riyadh International Airport has been heavily restricted recently after suffering a series of attacks, including one which left 13 dead and over 300 injured. Saudi Arabia remains under attack just days before the country is expected to host prominent combat sports and professional wrestling events. Canelo Alvarez is scheduled to box Christian Mbilli as part of a show in Riyadh on October 31. Just a week later, WWE will visit the city for its Crown Jewel Premium Live Event (PLE). Numerous outlets confirmed earlier today that “non-emergency” staff at the U.S. Embassy in Saudi Arabia were ordered to leave the country.

summary_src: Drew McIntyre used to carry around a giant sword named Angela back when he was the WWE champion circa 2020 / 2021. body: “You know how I had that sword for years, and everyone was like, ‘Is Drew ever gonna use the sword?’ And I didn’t? …I stuck it in the ring, and I stuck it in [Adam] Pearce’s table. But finally, I pitched to the big man himself. I [said] hey, you know Saving Private Ryan? And Vince had never seen Saving Private Ryan. He didn’t know what I was talking about, but also I speak fast when I’m excited. Half the time he’s like, ‘Uh, yeah. Yeah, sure Drew.’ I was like [in] Saving Private Ryan, they use actors, like amputees, etc. They lop off the limbs they’re actually missing. Very realistic. I think at ‘Mania or something, we should have a fight sequence. We end up backstage, then we hit the pre-tape where I swing the sword at somebody. Whoosh! Arm comes off. Finally, I use the sword. title: Tyrese Haliburton Pays Homage to WWE Legend at Pacers Season Opener
raw_title: Tyrese Haliburton Pays Homage to WWE Legend at Pacers Season Opener
body: Haliburton, who tore his ACL in Game 7 of the 2025 NBA Finals, will make his long-awaited return to the Pacers lineup on Oct. 21 after 486 days on the mend. To mark his return, the Olympic Gold medalist wore a custom recreation of the denim jacket Triple H wore in his WWE return in 2002. The Pacers shared a photo of the vintage jacket on Instagram, as shown below. As wrestling fans may recall, Triple H wore the same denim jacket when he returned from a quad injury at Madison Square Garden in 2002 after a year-long absence. The crowd pop during his dynamic return is widely regarded as one of the biggest pops in WWE history. Haliburton, a lifelong WWE fan who has appeared at SmackDown, SummerSlam and WrestleMania, honored one of his childhood icons, Triple H, with his pregame fit on Wednesday. The All-Star guard arrived at Smoothie King Center, which recently hosted Money in the Bank, wearing a near replica of Triple H’s famed 2002 gear. When pictures of the Triple H-inspired get-up went viral, the WWE Universe applauded the Pacers star’s fashion sense. A Pacers fan wrote: “I’ve been waiting 16 months for this moment.” The NBA on ESPN Instagram page also shared side-by-side clips of Haliburton and Triple H donning the denim attire. “Tyrese Haliburton arrives in Triple H style ahead of his first game in 486,” ESPN wrote. Tyrese Haliburton’s awesome pregame outfit was not the only WWE-inspired apparel he wore this week. During the Pacers’ final preseason game on Oct. 16, Haliburton rocked a pair of PUMA sneakers with a lime green colorway inspired by the legendary WWE faction DX. Haliburton’s new sneaker is the latest chapter of a growing list of shared moments between WWE and the NBA star. After several ringside appearances and a near in-ring clash with New York Knicks star Jalen Brunson, Haliburton became a playable character in WWE 2K25. Months later, the Pacers star teamed up with Seth Rollins at Saturday Night’s Main Event at Madison Square Garden. Now that he is healthy and moving well again, perhaps Haliburton will one day compete in the squared circle. For now, his focus remains on helping the Pacers return to the NBA playoffs. title: Comeback Watch: Hall Of Fame Legend Signs To Make Full Return In TNA Wrestling
raw_title: Hall Of Fame Legend Signs To Make Full Return In TNA Wrestling
body: TNA Wrestling Backstage News | Image Source: WrestlingHeadlines.com Share on Twitter --> Amazing Red is reportedly sticking around in TNA Wrestling. Following his TNA Hall of Fame induction and X-Division Championship victory at Bound For Glory 2026, a new report indicates that the veteran high-flyer has signed a contract with the promotion. Red enjoyed a memorable night at Bound For Glory, where he was inducted into the TNA Hall of Fame during the pre-show before going on to capture the vacant X-Division Championship later in the evening. The championship became vacant after Leon Slater exercised “Option C,” relinquishing the title in exchange for an opportunity at the TNA World Championship, which he ultimately captured. A pioneer of TNA’s original X-Division, Red is now enjoying his fourth reign with the championship and his first since 2010. His return also marks his first run with TNA since 2011, bringing him back to the promotion where he established himself as one of the division’s most influential performers. The reported signing comes amid a series of roster moves for TNA. Earlier this week, the company confirmed that Shotzi Blackheart had signed a contract, while Director of Authority Santino Marella also agreed to a new deal. Additional contract news is expected in the coming weeks as TNA continues addressing the futures of several talents whose current agreements are scheduled to expire before the end of 2026. The Judgment Day member picked up the win after Liv Morgan distracted Green at ringside. The finish gave Green a reason to question the loss, but Perez still walked away with a big victory over the reigning champion. She wasted little time in demanding a shot at the WWE Women’s Championship after the match. However, RAW General Manager Adam Pearce initially told Perez he needed approval from the SmackDown General Manager Nick Aldis before he could arrange a championship match. That issue has now been settled, with Pearce and Aldis agreeing to the contest. Green and Perez will face each other one-on-one, with the championship officially on the line. Aldis announced the match on social media . He confirmed that he had received approval from Pearce and WWE management. Both Green and Perez have also agreed to the match, making it official for Friday night. Green has already been announced to face the Women’s World Champion Liv Morgan in a Champion vs. Champion match at Crown Jewel on November 7. However, a defeat at this week’s SmackDown might change the picture, as Morgan might have to face her own Judgment Day member at the PLE. Moreover, Green could face even more competition in the coming weeks, as Nikki Bella has also been eyeing the title and has had some backstage confrontations with Green in the past few weeks. title: AEW announces ‘Clockwork Carnage’ match for World Championship at WrestleDream
raw_title: AEW announces ‘Clockwork Carnage’ match for World Championship at WrestleDream
body: The AEW World Championship will be defended in an eight-man ‘Clockwork Carnage’ match at WrestleDream on October 17. Tony Schiavone announced the stipulation during Saturday’s Collision, with AEW subsequently posting the match rules on social media. Two of the eight wrestlers are selected at random to begin the match. Another randomly selected competitor then enters every three minutes until the entire field has entered. During this first stage, a wrestler is eliminated if they are pinned or submitted. That means it is possible for fewer than eight competitors to remain by the time the final entrant arrives. Once the eighth wrestler has entered, the elimination portion ends and a 15-minute scoring period begins. From that point, competitors are no longer eliminated by pinfall or submission. Instead, every pinfall or submission earns one fall, with wrestlers able to score multiple times during the 15 minutes. When time expires, the wrestler with the most falls will win the match and the AEW World Championship. No participants beyond current champion Will Ospreay have been announced. The concept originated with Pro Wrestling EVE, which credited Ospreay with devising the format. EVE staged the first Clockwork Carnage match on Friday at its Global Thunder Queens Attack event in London. Kay Lee Ray won the match to earn a future EVE Championship opportunity, subsequently choosing EVE Champion Kris Statlander as her opponent. Ospreay’s participation as champion is subject to him retaining the title next week. He is scheduled to defend against Kazuchika Okada at Grand Slam France on Tuesday in Paris. Ospreay issued that challenge following his successful defense against Jon Moxley at All Out, with Tony Khan making the match official during the post-show press conference. WrestleDream takes place Saturday, October 17 at Addition Financial Arena in Orlando, Florida.

title: US State Dept Orders Diplomats Out Of Saudi Arabia Before Crown Jewel

summary_src: The US State Department has ordered diplomats to withdraw from Saudi Arabia just over two weeks away from WWE Crown Jewel in Riyadh.
body: Reuters has reported from US officials that the order came as at least one person was killed and eight were injured at King Fahd International Airport in Dammam. Two people have been killed in a drone attack on Saudi Aramco's Shaybah oil field. Per the report, diplomatic personnel have been pulled out of the region in recent months as Iran launched attacks on US facilities following the joint US-Israeli attack on Tehran in February. State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott said in a post on X that the department ordered the departure of non-emergency US government employees and their family members in Saudi Arabia, following sustained attacks by the Yemeni Houthis on civilian targets in the Kingdom. This is inaccurate. The U.S. Department of State issued an ordered departure for non-emergency U.S. government employees and their family members in Saudi Arabia only. Iranian-supported Houthis have increasingly engaged in hostilities against Saudi Arabia, including attacks on... https://t.co/yNrCwDcfIg Four US officials reportedly stated that US missions in other Gulf states would be ordering family members to leave. Pigott's post did not address changes to other missions outside Saudi Arabia. WWE's decision to move ahead with Crown Jewel on November 7 has come under increased scrutiny as the attacks continue. Programming has continued to build towards the event and its planned host, with Crown Jewel Championship matches scheduled pitting Roman Reigns against Sami Zayn and Liv Morgan against Chelsea Green for the title belts kept in Riyadh year-round. Dave Meltzer has reported that WWE is due to receive a payment of approximately $50-55 million for the November event, while WrestleMania 43 next year is also set to take place in Riyadh for approximately $150 million. The Saudi minister and Chairman of General Entertainment Authority, Turki Alalshikh, posted earlier this month that Canelo Alvarez still planned to fight Christian Mbilli in Riyadh on October 31, adding that "Hard times reveal true friends."
summary: The US State Department has ordered the departure of non-emergency government employees and their family members from Saudi Arabia. The move comes ahead of WWE's Crown Jewel event in the country.

body: 0 Aalyah Mysterio has made an appearance on WWE NXT following her recent signing as a recruit at the WWE Performance Center. Aalyah appeared during a backstage segment involving members of the NXT women’s locker room. While she didn’t speak or compete, her presence attracted attention after WWE confirmed her entry into the developmental system. The segment aired ahead of the singles match between Layla Diggs and Izzi Dame. The two women exchanged words backstage, with Aalyah among the other talent present as the confrontation unfolded. The segment eventually led to Dame facing Diggs in the ring. Izzi Dame picked up the victory. Aalyah, however, remained a presence in the background and did not become directly involved in the confrontation or the match. Aalyah’s latest appearance marks a small step as she begins learning the business from the inside. Her family name is already familiar to WWE fans, but developing her own identity in the ring will take time and training. For now, WWE has not announced a match or a larger on-screen role for Aalyah. Her NXT appearance puts her in the mix, but fans will have to wait to see when she takes the next step from the locker room to the squared circle.

title: AEW’s MJF Set for Surprise Referee Role at Independent Wrestling Event
raw_title: AEW’s MJF Set for Surprise Referee Role at Independent Wrestling Event
body: 0 AEW star MJF is preparing to step into an unfamiliar role at an upcoming independent wrestling event, trading his usual position in the ring for a job that requires him to keep others in line. The announcement comes as Create-A-Pro Wrestling prepares for its annual BaseBrawl event on October 24 in Long Island, New York. The promotion has added the former Create-A-Pro student to the show, where he’ll oversee a 10-man tag team match featuring a WWE Hall of Famer and one of the independent scene’s well-known managers. Create-A-Pro Wrestling announced that MJF will serve as the special guest referee when Team Road Dogg faces Team Sidney Bakabella at Saturday’s event. Road Dogg’s lineup includes Create-A-Pro co-owner Brian Myers, Anthony Greene, Aaron Rourke, Bobby Orlando, and Nick Robles. MJF has a history with Create-A-Pro, which served as his training ground before he established himself in professional wrestling. He originally trained under the promotion’s founders, Brian Myers and Pat Buck, and made his professional in-ring debut there in 2015. His appearance also follows the withdrawal of Billy Gunn, who had to cancel his scheduled bookings because of contractual obligations. Create-A-Pro announced MJF as a replacement attraction for the meet-and-greet portion of the event, while also adding AEW announcer Alicia Atout for fans. The promotion confirmed that attendees must purchase an event ticket to take part in the meet-and-greet sessions. The show will take place at Brookside Educational Center and serve as a fundraiser for Merrick Bellmore Little League. For MJF, the event offers a return to the promotion where his wrestling journey began, but this time he’ll be responsible for enforcing the rules rather than bending them. Whether the referee stripes bring out his fair side remains to be seen when BaseBrawl gets underway on Saturday. title: Comeback Watch: Steven Borden Returns to AEW Dynamite, Declares He’s Back for Blood & Guts
raw_title: Steven Borden Returns to AEW Dynamite, Declares He’s Back for Blood & Guts
body: 0 Steven Borden made his return to AEW on the October 21 episode of Dynamite and immediately announced his presence for Blood and Guts. The son of WWE Hall of Famer Sting had been out of action since suffering a concussion at All Out. Borden appeared alongside Darby Allin and The Young Bucks to help Adam Copeland and Will Ospreay fight off the Don Callis Family after their tag team match. Once the group cleared the ring, Borden grabbed a microphone and made his announcement, setting up a potential multi-man showdown at AEW’s upcoming special event. This week’s Dynamite featured a tag team match between Copeland and Ospreay and the Don Callis Family duo of Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight. Copeland and Ospreay came close to winning a few times. However, interference from the outside eventually cost them the match. Kazuchika Okada appeared at ringside and distracted Copeland with his AEW International Championship. When Will Ospreay tried to deal with Okada, Fletcher took advantage of the opening. He drove Adam Copeland face-first into the championship belt and hit a brainbuster to secure the victory. The Don Callis Family members continued attacking Copeland and Ospreay after the match, with Okada, Fletcher, and Knight eventually joined by Mark Davis, Jake Doyle, and Wardlow. The numbers became too much for Copeland and Ospreay. Ospreay tried to fight back, but the group continued to overwhelm him. Fletcher even hit Ospreay with the AEW World Championship belt and raised it in the air to celebrate. That’s when Darby Allin’s music hit. However, Allin didn’t come out alone. He introduced the returning Borden, who joined him and The Young Bucks in the fight. They managed to turn things around, clear the ring, and force the Don Callis Family to retreat. After that, Borden took the microphone and made it clear he wanted to take the fight to the Don Callis Family. AEW Blood and Guts is scheduled for Wednesday, November 4, 2026, in Jacksonville, Florida. title: The Young Bucks Suffer Shocking Squash Loss on AEW Dynamite
raw_title: The Young Bucks Suffer Shocking Squash Loss on AEW Dynamite
body: 0 The Young Bucks suffered one of the most shocking losses of their AEW careers on the October 21 episode of Dynamite . The Don Callis Family members Mark Davis and Jake Doyle completely dominated the reigning AEW World Tag Team Champions in a one-sided match. Matt and Nick Jackson entered the opening match fresh off a successful title defense at WrestleDream. However, the champions struggled to keep up with their opponents. The match lasted only a few minutes before Davis and Doyle secured a decisive victory. The contest was an AEW World Tag Team Championship Eliminator Match. This meant Davis and Doyle would earn a future title shot if they defeated the champions. Doyle sent Matt crashing into the barricade at ringside, while Davis targeted Nick and knocked him off the ring steps. The challengers gave the champions very few chances to fight back. The table spot left Nick in trouble, while Matt was left to deal with both challengers inside the ring. The Young Bucks struggled to turn things around as Davis and Doyle continued their attack. Davis tagged in Doyle, and the two men hit Matt with a double splash. Doyle also locked Nick in a bear hug. The final moments were just as one-sided. Davis hit Matt with multiple piledrivers before delivering his finishing move, Close Your Eyes and Count, to secure the pinfall victory. Davis and Doyle squashing the reigning champions in just a few minutes is not what many fans would have expected. Since it was an eliminator match, the Don Callis Family members earned a future opportunity to challenge for the AEW World Tag Team Championship. The 44-year old Amazing Red is currently in his third stint with TNA where he was integral part of ushering in the modern high-flying, modern-era cruiserweight wrestling. body: AEW didn’t waste any time in making several title matches for next month’s AEW Full Gear from Phoenix, Arizona, during Wednesday’s Dynamite . While celebrating her successful title defense over Thekla at WrestleDream, AEW Women’s World Champion Mercedes Mone wondered who was next for her, leading to Marina Shafir coming out and issuing her own challenge for the title. As of this writing, the match has not been made official. Both sets of tag titles will be on the line as World Tag Team Champions Young Bucks will defend against Mark Davis & Jake Doyle after the challengers defeated the champions in a title eliminator Wednesday that turned into a squash. On the other side, Women’s World Tag Team Champions The Brawling Birds will defend against number one contenders Wrathlander. The news comes as a bit of a surprise as AEW head Tony Khan said this past Saturday that Jamie Hayter suffered a “major” injury at last month’s All Out while also saying he hopes to see her in a few weeks. Also on the show, Swerve Strickland challenged new AEW World Trios Champions Hangman Page and Brodido to not just a rematch with himself and the New Level at the pay-per-view but a Texas Death Match in honor of the Strickland-Page match two years ago at Full Gear. title: Steven Borden Returns On AEW Dynamite

body: Steven Borden is back, making his return with Darby Allin on AEW Dynamite to save Will Ospreay and Adam Copeland from a Don Callis Family beatdown. Borden made his return on Wednesday’s show after Ospreay and Copeland teamed to battle the DCF’s Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight. Fletcher and Knight picked up the win after Kazuchika Okada got involved, but was pulled to the floor by Ospreay. Copeland took out both Fletcher and Knight with a Killswitch and Spear respectively, but a second spear attempt to Fletcher was missed and Okada was able to clock Copeland with the AEW International Championship. Fletcher then hit a brainbuster for the pin. After the match, the DCF attacked Copeland and Ospreay. Allin then showed up with Borden and they cleared out the ring. Borden said he was back for Blood and Guts, setting up the teams for the stipulation match. You can see clips from the AEW Dynamite match and post-match below. Borden has been out of action since taking a nasty bump at AEW All Out. AEW Blood and Guts will take place on November 4th at Veterans Memorial Arena in Jacksonville, Florida. body: Ruby Soho and Serena Deeb haven’t been seen on AEW/ROH TV in a while, but the two are still reportedly under contract. The latest Fightful Select featured questions asking about the status of both women. Soho hasn’t been seen since April 2024 when she announecd that she and Angelo Parker were expecting. Sean Ross Sapp said that she is still under contract. As As noted in August, Soho was backstage at AEW’s Cincinnati tapings in June getting cleared for a potential in-ring return. Sapp notes that there were creative pitches for her but they didn’t end up happening. It was also noted that Angelo Parker’s deal was previously said to be close to coming up, but there’s no word on the status of that. As for Deeb, she hasn’t competed in AEW or ROH since a loss in the ROH Women’s Pure Title Tournament Quarterfinals back in November of last year. Deeb is also still under contract and has only wrestled one match at all in 2026, a singles bout at HAW Rise From The Ashes IV in March. No word as of now on when Ruby Soho or Serena Deeb may end up returning to AEW or ROH TV.
summary: Ruby Soho has been absent from AEW and ROH television since announcing her pregnancy with Angelo Parker in April 2024. Per Fightful Select, she remains signed to the company, was cleared medically in June, and received creative pitches that did not materialize. title: On the Record: Ilja Dragunov Explains Why He Turned Down WWE’s Offer
