summary_src: Joe Hendry addressed the social media posts teasing him portraying Joe in Street Fighter given the same first name and his popularity among wrestling fans.
body: Joe Hendry addressed the social media posts teasing him portraying Joe in Street Fighter given the same first name and his popularity among wrestling fans. In an exclusive interview with TV Insider , Hendry acknowledged seeing fans suggest the idea on social media but explained that he is still developing his skills outside professional wrestling. Hendry also praised Cody Rhodes and Roman Reigns for successfully expanding their careers beyond the wrestling ring. “I did see some tweets like that, but the thing is Cody and Roman as two examples who have conquered the world of professional wrestling. They’re so skilled at all things professional wrestling that they are now able to explore these avenues. I’m still building those skills. So I’m very excited to be part of this micro-drama, and that is allowing me to kind of build those skills. But yeah, those guys are on another level, and never say never, but like who knows.” Hendry discussed his role in WWE’s collaborated microdrama with ReelShorts titled Agent of Shadows, and WWE’s latest venture into short-form storytelling. “I had never heard of microdramas before, but I think that the concept is smart. Throughout the history of media, the way people consume content has always depended on storytelling. I think that WWE has often been at the forefront of how that’s done. If you look at the first WrestleMania, for example, the distribution for that, and then the emergence of the WWE Network. WWE has made some real innovations in media. And so to see them cross over into micro-dramas and this format early to me is exciting. It makes a lot of sense to me. When I arrive at an airport, and I see everyone scrolling on their phones, this looks like a useful way for people to consume our storytelling in a way that is convenient and is digestible for them, and keeps them engaged.” The microdrama also features WWE stars Drew McIntyre, Nikkita Lyons, Ethan Page and Jacob Fatu. This is not Hendry’s first venture as he released an exclusive WWE album ‘ Beyond Belief ’ which released on October 10. summary_src: Sol Ruca and Tyler Bate have been one of WWE’s most well-known couples for years, but something definitely looks different now.
body: Ruca and Bate started dating in September 2023 after meeting through WWE’s NXT division. They weren’t exactly shy about their relationship either, with fans getting plenty of glimpses of the couple together over the years. Fast-forward to October 23, and Ruca’s social media looks very different. She uploaded photos featuring Smokes as the two hung out together, while the photos she previously had with Bate appear to be gone. Bate’s account seems to tell a similar story, with photos of Ruca no longer appearing there either. Neither of them has announced a breakup, but when a longtime wrestling couple suddenly scrubs each other from social media, people are obviously going to notice. Then there’s Smokes. On one of Ruca’s recent posts from Hawaii , he dropped a comment that wasn’t exactly subtle: “Mahalo baby.” Ruca’s response didn’t do much to cool down the speculation, as she said, “;) hi bb” Calling someone “baby” and getting a flirty “hi bb” back is going to get people talking. Throw in Ruca posting Smokes while her photos with Bate have disappeared, and it’s pretty easy to see why fans might wonder whether something has changed in her personal life. That said, nobody involved has actually confirmed anything yet. Ruca and Bate haven’t publicly announced that they’ve broken up, and Ruca hasn’t said she’s dating Smokes, so it would be jumping the gun to officially declare either one. Still, there’s clearly enough happening on social media to raise some eyebrows. After nearly three years of Ruca and Bate being together, the disappearing photos and her cozy exchange with Smokes certainly make this one worth keeping an eye on. title: Match Made: Ranking WWE and AEW's Hottest Storylines From Roman Reigns vs. 946, Sami Zayn to New Level's Rise
raw_title: Ranking WWE and AEW's Hottest Storylines From Roman Reigns vs. 946, Sami Zayn to New Level's Rise
body: Let's face it. Many of us watch a lot of wrestling, and we can't wait to tell anyone who will listen how much we know about our favorite pastime. Some of the best characters know how to break the fourth wall and appeal to savvy fans for the maximum reaction. That's what makes someone like Kevin Owens so relatable or adds background to a rivalry years in the making. It makes us want to discover more about our favorite wrestlers and be a part of the communal experience. With that in mind, these are the hottest storylines in WWE and All Elite Wrestling right now. Jay White's shocking heel turn was the reset that AEW Dynamite needed following WrestleDream. The Bang Bang Gang has been wildly popular since the New Zealand wrestler returned at Forbidden Door. However, the stable has lacked a clear direction for months, and White has struggled to regain momentum as a singles competitor. Conversely, The Death Riders have become fan favorites after Pac's tragic passing and Jon Moxley's touching performance at his tribute show. The group needed a foil, and the newest iteration of The Bang Bang Gang makes perfect sense. This also gives David Finlay and Clark Connors something interesting to do and makes Gabe Kidd an exclusive member of The Death Riders. The three were floundering as a trio, and Kidd fits much better with Mox and his pupils. There's so much potential here. Finlay has a long history with White dating back to their time with New Japan Pro Wrestling, and their Bullet Club lore could eventually lead to a conflict with The Elite. The company capitalized on Owens' long-awaited return at SummerSlam and pivoted to the matchup fans have clamored for since 2023. 20 years of pent-up animosity between the two has set the stage for memorable segments that masterfully blurred the lines between fiction and reality. This entry would rank higher, but the rivalry has admittedly cooled off a little since their Undisputed Championship match and the build to Money in the Bank. Nevertheless, it's still an integral part of SmackDown's world title scene that will likely culminate in a triple threat match with Sami Zayn. Most weeks, their interactions are the best thing on the blue brand. There's still plenty of interest in another one-on-one match or a long-overdue Owens' world title run. "The Honorary Uce" has been linked to The Tribal Chief and The Bloodline since 2022. As such, many fans were disappointed when they never crossed paths after Zayn's first WWE title win at Night of Champions. Fortunately, their upcoming match at Crown Jewel offers a rewarding new chapter to their turbulent friendship. This time, the dynamic has flipped because the Canadian star has carved his own lane as a heel champion, and Reigns refuses to acknowledge his accomplishments. Zayn has been on fire on the microphone since he regained the title, and he held his own in their first war of words. Still, the OTC got the last word in a segment that perfectly encapsulated their history toget

title: On the Record: Sol Ruca Says She’d Love To Turn Heel In WWE Despite Being Told It May Never Happen
raw_title: Sol Ruca Says She’d Love To Turn Heel In WWE Despite Being Told It May Never Happen
body: After WrestleMania 42, Sol Ruca was announced as the newest member of the WWE Raw roster. She wrestled her first match on Raw on the April 20 edition of the show, defeating Liv Morgan. Since then, Ruca has become one of the most popular names on the roster. She’s also had a Women’s Intercontinental Championship reign that lasted 57 days. Ruca made her wrestling debut in 2022 and has worked as a babyface since then. She recently talked about a potential heel turn in the future. During an interview with KRON 4 , Sol Ruca was asked about the possibility of turning heel in the future. Ruca said that she would love to play the role of a heel, but was previously told that she may never get to do so. “I have no idea. I think I would love to be able to try that. I have been told in the past that I most likely will not be heel ever because of just how I am naturally. I am quite a bubbly and liked person.” Ruca says that it would take a “very special person” to bring this side out of her. “So I don’t know. I feel like it’s gonna take a very special person to really get that side out of me, but I guess we’re just gonna have to wait and see.” There have been numerous wrestlers in the past who never turned heel because they were just too over with the fans. But there’s always a chance that WWE could choose to switch things up and eventually introduce a new version of Ruca on television. body: Joe Hendry expanded on his future WWE plans and his focus on cementing himself as the next needle mover in the company. The Raw star told TV Insider that he is always looking to better himself in the ring, and has a firm belief that he can be the next top guy in WWE. Hendry reflected on the numbers and data since his NXT debut, WrestleMania match against Randy Orton and contributions with his WWE album. “I’m just always looking to get better at what I do. I know in my heart that I can be a top draw for WWE. I know people have things to say about that, but the truth is I know that I can be a top guy, I know that I can be an asset to the professional wrestling business because I have the metrics to prove it. And those are facts, you know? I had the most viewed clip in all of wrestling in 2024. I wrestled Randy Orton at WrestleMania, which did insane numbers on social media. My WrestleMania shirt was a bestseller. I won the NXT Championship. I have the metrics to prove that I can draw in the professional wrestling business, and my goal is to be somebody who can deliver for the company.” Hendry also discussed WWE’s expectations for its talent, recalling an interview in which Nick Khan outlined the qualities the company looks for in its performers. The WWE star expressed confidence in his ability to make an immediate or near-future impact, pointing to past metrics as evidence of his potential to become a top star. “I saw in an interview that Nick Khan was asked what WWE is looking for from talent. It is someone that can move the needle for the company immediately or in the near future. I believe that I’m somebody who can do that. I’ve had metrics in the past to prove that I think I can be a top guy for WWE. So I’m looking to acquire the skills to do that as quickly as I can.” Rosanne Raphael Rosanne Raphael is a wrestling writer with over three and a half years of experience covering all things related to the industry. title: Killer Kross Recalls WWE Merger Promise For Acting Opportunities
raw_title: Former WWE Star Killer Kross Recalls Failed Entertainment Industry Promise From TKO
summary_src: Former WWE star Killer Kross (previously known as Karrion Kross) had inquired about getting more involved in Hollywood after a company-wide meeting.
body: Killer Kross' love for film has been something fans have been exposed to through his promos and social media posts, as well as his short film. However, while he's since become an independent filmmaker and actor, Kross claims there was an opportunity to open this door from within WWE. "A couple of years ago, we had this in-house meeting at WWE where, you know, the bosses were there and they were talking about how the merger with TKO was going to provide some sort of transitionary connective tissue into getting into different types of lanes of entertainment," he claimed during an interview on " The Wrestling Classic ." Kross further detailed the meeting, recalling that it was akin to a university lecture, and suggesting that WWE took the topic seriously. He then said that he followed up with WWE after the meeting, making it clear that he didn't want to leave wrestling, but he was interested in branching out into acting. "I have a background in theater and such, and I went into all that and I just said, 'What's the right way to go about doing this?'" Kross stated. Essentially, he wanted to take WWE up on the offer and become an ambassador for the promotion in film, much like Cody Rhodes and Roman Reigns have been doing lately. "I was told to follow up in October, and I'd be flown into Los Angeles and they'd introduce me to all these people, ... and I followed up and none of that ever happened," Kross claimed. After following up a second time, he became frustrated with WWE, and went out on his own, producing his own short film in the process and has since continued to expand in film, teasing unreleased projects, as well as another film, "Godshot" that's slated for release soon.
summary: Killer Kross recalled a meeting held inside WWE a couple of years ago where executives discussed how the upcoming merger with TKO would create pathways into other areas of the entertainment industry. He described the session as similar to a university lecture and said the company appeared to take the subject seriously. Kross later followed up with WWE about his theater background and interest in acting while making it clear he did not want to stop wrestling.

summary_src: SmackDown airs tonight (Oct. 23) with a live show emanating from Toyota Arena in Ontario, California. This is the second episode of SmackDown during the four week build to Crown Jewel, which takes place on November 7 and is somehow still scheduled for Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
body: Link WWE Cain A. Knight is a hardcore number-cruncher who has analyzed and covered pro wrestling for Cageside Seats since 2014, and followed the sport as a fan going back to the 1980’s. SmackDown airs tonight (Oct. 23) with a live show emanating from Toyota Arena in Ontario, California. This is the second episode of SmackDown during the four week build to Crown Jewel, which takes place on November 7 and is somehow still scheduled for Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. I guess that’s because TKO/WWE prioritizes profits and stock price over wrestler safety. WWE typically isn’t afraid to book more than one women’s match on a two hour wrestling television show. In fact, three bouts in the women’s division are currently scheduled for tonight’s episode of SmackDown. First up is Raw star Roxanne Perez challenging WWE Women’s Champion Chelsea Green for the gold. Roxanne recently beat Chelsea in a non-title match thanks to a minor assist from Women’s World Champion Liv Morgan. Will Liv and the rest of the Judgment Day show up tonight to ensure Roxanne wins the title, thus changing the Crown Jewel women’s match to Morgan vs. Perez? Does Money in the Bank contract holder Tiffany Stratton plan to be at ringside to neutralize any of that interference and/or cash in so she can take Chelsea’s title herself? The next women’s title match on tonight’s card features WWE Women’s Tag Team Champions Alexa Bliss & Tatum Paxley making their first title defense against Michin and B-Fab. It will be a pretty big surprise if Jade Cargill’s Baddies bring home the gold, especially if Charlotte Flair is around to beat the shit out of them and/or Jade for attacking her a couple of weeks ago. Will former tag champs Fatal Influence make a statement to the new champs after the match is over? Last but not least is Giulia vs. Blake Monroe in a Street Fight. This is only The Glamour’s second televised match since she joined the main roster back in April. Will Giulia get her win back from their first bout earlier this month, or can Monroe find the right weapons under the ring to finish off The Beautiful Madness and end their feud? If women’s wrestling is your thing, then it looks like WWE has you covered on tonight’s SmackDown. Bakusai vs. WWE Tag Team Champions MFT is scheduled for tonight in a non-title match. Shinsuke Nakamura and Kyoki pretty much have to win this one if they want to remain viable contenders for the gold. Then again, there aren’t really any other babyface teams on the blue brand, so maybe it doesn’t even matter if they lose. - It isn’t fair to Charlotte Flair that she doesn’t have a championship around her waist. Does The Queen plan to do something about that by challenging Women’s United States Champion Jacy Jayne? - Finn Balor wasn’t around last week, so we got more hi-jinks between Danhausen and Gooner. Will Balor return tonight to smash that shit-eating grin off the Ring General’s face? - GM Nick Aldis says there will definitely be a rematch between CM Punk and Kevin Owens

title: WWE Proceeds With Saudi Arabia Crown Jewel Plans
raw_title: Backstage Update On WWE Taping And Travel Plans Ahead Of Crown Jewel In Saudi Arabia
summary_src: WWE is going ahead with its plan to host Crown Jewel in Saudi Arabia on November 7, but one show ahead of the PLE will likely be taped in advance.
body: WWE WWE is going ahead with its decision to travel to Saudi Arabia for Crown Jewel, and a report has revealed its plans ahead of the show. Although Saudi Arabia is currently in conflict with the Houthis, with several infrastructure sites, including the airport, reportedly being bombed, WWE remains intent on hosting Crown Jewel in the country on November 7. " PWInsider " has confirmed that the plan is to hold the show in the Middle Eastern country despite the US government issuing a Level 3 travel advisory. The report also noted that a Level 4 advisory would prohibit Americans from traveling to the country. Recently, the US State Department had ordered its diplomats and their family members to leave the country due to the conflict. " Fightful Select " also has an update on Crown Jewel, with its report revealing that WWE plans to tape the "WWE SmackDown" before Crown Jewel on the same day as "WWE Raw" airs from the Barclays Center in New York. According to "Fightful Select," the November 2 episode of "Raw" will air at 6 p.m. ET. WWE will then return to the United States for the following week's "Raw," which will take place on November 9 at the Bon Secours Wellness Arena in Greenville, South Carolina. Many are curious as to why WWE is going to such great lengths to host the PLE in Saudi Arabia, considering the risks its personnel may face. According to Dave Meltzer , WWE's decision to go ahead with the event is likely financially motivated. Meltzer believes TKO will bring in between $70 million and $90 million from the three shows it has scheduled in Saudi Arabia — two UFC events and Crown Jewel — and that the absence of these events could put a dent in the company's quarterly profits.
summary: WWE will travel to Saudi Arabia for the November 7 Crown Jewel event despite the ongoing conflict with the Houthis and a US State Department Level 3 travel advisory. Per PWInsider, the promotion intends to hold the show as scheduled. title: Three Women's Matches Set for SmackDown
raw_title: Women’s wrestling is taking over WWE SmackDown
body: Link WWE Cain A. Knight is a hardcore number-cruncher who has analyzed and covered pro wrestling for Cageside Seats since 2014, and followed the sport as a fan going back to the 1980’s. SmackDown airs tonight (Oct. 23) with a live show emanating from Toyota Arena in Ontario, California. This is the second episode of SmackDown during the four week build to Crown Jewel, which takes place on November 7 and is somehow still scheduled for Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. I guess that’s because TKO/WWE prioritizes profits and stock price over wrestler safety. WWE typically isn’t afraid to book more than one women’s match on a two hour wrestling television show. In fact, three bouts in the women’s division are currently scheduled for tonight’s episode of SmackDown. First up is Raw star Roxanne Perez challenging WWE Women’s Champion Chelsea Green for the gold. Roxanne recently beat Chelsea in a non-title match thanks to a minor assist from Women’s World Champion Liv Morgan. Will Liv and the rest of the Judgment Day show up tonight to ensure Roxanne wins the title, thus changing the Crown Jewel women’s match to Morgan vs. Perez? Does Money in the Bank contract holder Tiffany Stratton plan to be at ringside to neutralize any of that interference and/or cash in so she can take Chelsea’s title herself? The next women’s title match on tonight’s card features WWE Women’s Tag Team Champions Alexa Bliss & Tatum Paxley making their first title defense against Michin and B-Fab. It will be a pretty big surprise if Jade Cargill’s Baddies bring home the gold, especially if Charlotte Flair is around to beat the shit out of them and/or Jade for attacking her a couple of weeks ago. Will former tag champs Fatal Influence make a statement to the new champs after the match is over? Last but not least is Giulia vs. Blake Monroe in a Street Fight. This is only The Glamour’s second televised match since she joined the main roster back in April. Will Giulia get her win back from their first bout earlier this month, or can Monroe find the right weapons under the ring to finish off The Beautiful Madness and end their feud? If women’s wrestling is your thing, then it looks like WWE has you covered on tonight’s SmackDown. Bakusai vs. WWE Tag Team Champions MFT is scheduled for tonight in a non-title match. Shinsuke Nakamura and Kyoki pretty much have to win this one if they want to remain viable contenders for the gold. Then again, there aren’t really any other babyface teams on the blue brand, so maybe it doesn’t even matter if they lose. - It isn’t fair to Charlotte Flair that she doesn’t have a championship around her waist. Does The Queen plan to do something about that by challenging Women’s United States Champion Jacy Jayne? - Finn Balor wasn’t around last week, so we got more hi-jinks between Danhausen and Gooner. Will Balor return tonight to smash that shit-eating grin off the Ring General’s face? - GM Nick Aldis says there will definitely be a rematch between CM Punk and Kevin Owens

title: Results Recap: How to Assess Digital PR Campaign for Wrestling Brands
raw_title: How to Assess Digital PR Campaign Results for Wrestling Brands
body: DMFirst Veer Game odds uden om ROFUS Jalwa Game Goa Game Raja Game MaanWin How to Assess Digital PR Campaign Results for Wrestling Brands By Kendall Jenkins on 2026-10-20 10:39:00 For a wrestling promotion, a busy news cycle can make a campaign look successful before anyone checks what it achieved. A press release may be picked up, a new show may trend locally, or a talent announcement may circulate across social media. Those signals matter, but how to assess digital PR campaign results depends on connecting attention to a goal: selling tickets, growing an audience, strengthening a brand, or making a new venture credible. Before a campaign begins, decide what it is meant to change. Promoting a live event calls for different measures than announcing a streaming partnership or introducing a new wrestling brand. If the objective is ticket sales, track visits to the event page, ticket referrals and purchases during the campaign period. If the aim is awareness, look at relevant audience reach, branded searches and meaningful coverage in outlets that wrestling fans actually read. Set a baseline as well. Compare results with a similar period, a previous event or the normal level of traffic and engagement. Without that context, a rise in mentions may simply reflect a major show, a viral moment or a news story unrelated to the PR work. Where possible, use tagged campaign links and dedicated landing pages so that referral activity can be distinguished from general traffic. Coverage volume is easy to report, but it is not the same as influence. A list of placements can include duplicate syndication, brief mentions and stories that reach audiences with little interest in the promotion. Review the quality of coverage: Was the key announcement accurately described? Did the story include the information fans need? Was the outlet relevant to the intended audience? Did coverage lead readers to take a next step? For wrestling, context matters. A profile of a rising performer, an interview about a promotion’s community work and a calendar listing for an upcoming event serve different purposes. They should not all be judged by the same standard. A calendar listing might help with local discovery; a thoughtful profile may build a talent’s reputation over time. Record both the placement and its likely role in the broader campaign. A useful report combines a few types of evidence instead of treating one metric as proof of success: Reach: relevant outlets, estimated audience, social sharing and search visibility. Action: ticket purchases, registrations, merchandise activity or inquiries, when these can be attributed responsibly. Reputation: accuracy of coverage, message inclusion, sentiment and the quality of conversations around the announcement. Keep the measurement proportional. body: DMFirst Veer Game odds uden om ROFUS Jalwa Game Goa Game Raja Game MaanWin WWE'S FIRST-EVER MICRODRAMA 'AGENT OF SHADOWS' IS NOW STREAMING, FULL DETAILS ON STORY AND FORMAT By Mike Johnson on 2026-10-23 09:19:00 WWE's first-ever Microdrama Agent of Shadows is now streaming on Reelshort. For the uninitiated, a microdrama is a short-form scripted drama designed to tell a story in very small chunks, usually through bite-sized episodes that last anywhere from 1 to 3 minutes. The idea is basically to appeal to the younger Tik Tok/social media type audience. The format has gained a lot of steam internationally in recent years, particularly in China. For Agent of Shadows , there are 72 episodes. The plot - "The world's greatest secret agent must protect and care for his six-year-old daughter while posing as her nanny. Now, without revealing his true identity, he must win his daughter's (and her mother's) trust, while secretly thwarting corrupt suitors, mafioso strongmen, and even a megalomaniacal billionaire who's using his family to get to him." Michael Hayes, Drew McIntyre, Jacob Fatu, Nikkita Lyons, Joe Hendry, Ethan Page and Booker T are among those appearing over the course of the story. We are told that those on both the Reelshort and WWE sides worked hard to slip easter eggs in for the WWE audience, including Booker T's crown from his King Booker run and Drew using one of his actual swords from his ring entrance. body: Michael Hayes recalled a conversation with Triple H where he was informed to mentor Bobby Roode to take over his spot. Hayes told Stephanie McMahon on What’s Your Story? Podcast about his stance to be positioned as the heel in WWE. And how Triple H approached him to train Roode as the next ‘Michael Hayes’. “But yeah, I just made up my mind that this is your new path, and go for it. And I’ll tell you, Trips came up to me one day and he goes, ‘So Michael, you know you’re not gonna be around forever.’ You’re our Pat Patterson. I need you to make Bobby Roode ‘Michael.’” “And I said, ‘Okay, that’s a really good point, because I’m not gonna be here forever.’ And boy, has he come along. No, I see great things for him. He’s just gotta get out of the stuff where, I don’t know how to really categorize it. This stuff happens in this industry that’s just out of your control, and it’s just gonna happen. And you just gotta kind of let it go and say, ‘Okay.’” Roode currently works as a backstage producer for WWE, having transitioned into the role after a neck injury in 2022 forced him to step away from in-ring competition. title: Ilja Dragunov Credits Kofi and Austin Creed for AEW Move
raw_title: Ilja Dragunov Says AEW Success Of Ex-WWE Stars The New Level Caught His Attention
summary_src: Ilja Dragunov has discussed the role The New Level, the duo of Kofi and Austin Creed, played in convincing him to join AEW after leaving WWE.
body: AEW Ilja Dragunov is a man with a new sense of freedom after joining AEW, and he has some old friends in WWE, Kofi and Austin Creed, to thank for his decision to switch promotions. Dragunov is the latest star to leave WWE for AEW, debuting in the promotion at WrestleDream , just two months after his WWE exit. The former NXT Champion stated that the success Creed and Kofi, who also debuted in AEW a few months ago, enjoyed immediately after joining the promotion convinced him that signing with Tony Khan's company would be the right move for his career. "I mean, it would be a lie if it wouldn't, right? [That the New Level's success attracted him to AEW] You see people perform in a way that they didn't perform in a while anymore. I can tell, hopefully, or just feel, or can try to imagine a certain happiness if I watch them, what they're doing, and just reconnecting with these people that you shared some time with. You can just tell that it's definitely a new place and something they appreciate [being] a part of," explained Dragunov in his interview with " The Takedown on SI ." The New Level's AEW debut got off to a strong start, as they teamed up with Swerve Strickland to win the Trios Championship on their first night at All In, before losing the titles at WrestleDream. Dragunov's AEW run has had a similar start. Although he didn't win a title, he main-evented " AEW Dynamite " in his in-ring debut, defeating "Speedball" Mike Bailey on the October 21 episode. Dragunov and The New Level were rumored to have left WWE due to contract issues, with The New Level reportedly being asked to take a pay cut of more than 50%.
summary: Ilja Dragunov joined AEW two months after leaving WWE and debuted at WrestleDream. He told The Takedown on SI that the immediate success and renewed performances of his former WWE colleagues Kofi and Austin Creed, known as The New Level, convinced him that AEW was the right destination for his career. Dragunov described feeling their happiness and reconnection in the new environment.

title: Backstage Buzz: TNA Changed Original Creative Plans for October 15 Impact Show
raw_title: TNA Changed Original Creative Plans for October 15 Impact Show
summary_src: Matt Hardy and Jeff Hardy were given some real creative control over the October 15 episode of TNA Impact, but they didn’t get everything exactly the way Matt wanted it.
body: Speaking on The Extreme Life of Matt Hardy , Matt explained that he specifically wanted a tables match as part of the Hardys’ 35th anniversary celebration. Considering how closely he and Jeff have been associated with tables throughout their careers, it felt like an obvious addition. “But in my mind, too, I also wanted to see a tables match. I feel like a tables match is something that, you know, the Hardys are very famous for in this day and age. Obviously, tables, ladders, and chairs — we’re very closely associated with all that.” Once Matt started thinking about who should actually be in the match, he landed on two teams that had caused plenty of problems for the Hardys. His thinking was pretty simple — let their enemies beat the hell out of each other. “And I was like, ‘Huh, who would we put? Who would I put if I was legitimately booking the show?’ I feel like I’d probably book two of our most hated rivals, you know, The Righteous and The Sicks, and maybe they can destroy one another. They’ll do us a favor by just sticking them together in a match.” That’s how The Righteous and The Sicks ended up in the tables match, but Matt’s original vision didn’t stop with simply picking the participants. “And we put those guys in a tables match. And in reality, if I would have formatted the show, I would have put that match before the Ryan and Nic segment, I think, because I really like, if you have an opening segment, have a hot match that people are invested in after that. And I would have probably done The Sicks.” Matt confirmed that was how he’d hoped the episode would actually play out. Instead, Nic Nemeth vs. Ryan Nemeth came immediately after the opening segment, while the tables match happened later in the show. “That’s what I was, yeah. Whenever I was thinking about it, that is kind of how I was hoping to roll it out.” Matt didn’t seem upset that TNA changed things around, though. He figured there may have simply been a production reason for the switch, especially since the tables match needed more time than the Nemeth segment. “But, you know, I don’t know if there was even a difference in the format where they needed a little more time, and the reason it might have been a shorter segment is why they did it.” Matt Hardy also acknowledged that putting the tables match later may have actually given everyone more room to work with. “Because the Ryan and Nic segment wasn’t that long, and we needed more time for that tables match, and they may have had more time if they did it following that.” The Hardys clearly had legitimate input when it came to putting together their anniversary episode, but that didn’t mean they were handed complete control over every minute of Impact. Matt had his preferred running order, while TNA ultimately made some adjustments when it came time to put the final show together. title: Comeback Watch: WWE Rumor Claims Sin Cara Character Could Return: 8 Current Stars Who Could Don the Mask, Including Axiom
raw_title: WWE Rumor Claims Sin Cara Character Could Return: 8 Current Stars Who Could Don the Mask, Including Axiom
body: Now, according to PW Insider, there has been a recent push backstage to bring back the character Sin Cara . Mexican star Mistico was under the mask when the character debuted in 2011. Then, when he had creative differences with management, he was replaced by Hunico. The character never really took off with fans, but it is still owned by WWE and can be used by any performer. If WWE does decide to bring the character back, we take a look at seven stars who could be the next Sin Cara. As a tag team, Cruz Del Toro and Joaquin Wilde have showcased some impressive athleticism and skill. However, during stints in Legado del Fantasma and the LWO, they never built a fanbase. Both are still under contract with the company because WWE clearly sees value in them and has used their talents in AAA. If Sin Cars returns, it would not be a surprise if either man were under the mask. NXT star Romeo Moreno is an exciting young talent with potential. The company could continue his development on the black and gold brand over the next couple of years. However, on a pure athleticism level, he would be a good fit to be the new Sin Cara. And because he is only 24, he could work under the mask for the next two decades. A case can be made that Fraxiom is the best tag team on any brand in WWE. However, promoting their tag division continues to be a weakness for the company. So it means that both Axiom and Nathan Frazer will always be in danger of being in the next round of roster cuts unless the company gives them a serious long-term creative push. If that push doesn’t come — and it really should — either man would make a ton of sense as the new Sin Cara. While the assumption would be that that character would be a native of Mexico, the Spanish and English stars’ skill sets are a great fit for the character. Development talent Kale Dixon has been off NXT TV for months due to a rumored injury and after his tag team with Uriah Connors was dissolved. While he is bigger than the two men who previously donned the mantle, he has a ton of athletic talent, is young, and is in creative limbo. Returning to the ring as a very different version of the character makes some sense. French independent star Elio LeFleur saw his debut run in the company curtailed due to a shoulder injury earlier this year. It would make sense to bring him back as the character fans previously saw to give French wrestling fans a favorite star. However, if WWE coaches feel his character was not connecting with the audience, he certainly has the athleticism and wrestling style to be a fun option as the next Sin Cara. One last option to be the new Sin Cara could be Noam Dar. The long-time NXT talent has stuck with the company because he is a reliable veteran talent and teacher. However, he has never gotten an extended opportunity on the main roster. Donning the mask might be his best route, as he would offer the company a performer they can trust to take over the character.
summary: Per PW Insider, now there has been a recent push backstage to bring back the character Sin Cara . If WWE does decide to bring the character back, we take a look at seven stars who could be the next Sin Cara.

title: On the Record: Shayna Baszler Says WWE Door Remains Open Despite Her TNA Wrestling Run
raw_title: Shayna Baszler Says WWE Door Remains Open Despite Her TNA Wrestling Run
summary_src: Shayna Baszler may be collecting championship gold in TNA Wrestling, but that doesn’t mean she’s completely done with WWE.
body: Baszler addressed the situation during a recent interview with Denice Salcedo , where she opened up about her coaching work with WWE following her departure in 2025. While her in-ring career has taken her to TNA, she admitted that helping younger wrestlers develop has become something she genuinely loves. “There’s been some thought because word got out somehow. I’ve been coaching, producing part-time at NXT and Evolve and all that. That is something that I found that I have fallen in love with, watching these young athletes grow and learn to love pro wrestling.” Baszler isn’t looking to give up wrestling just yet, though. She recently joined forces with Zoey Serrano in TNA, making her debut at Bound For Glory earlier this month. The move has given her another opportunity to compete, but she doesn’t believe it necessarily closes the door on her coaching responsibilities in WWE. “TNA is the perfect place for me right now. Thankfully, there’s a good relationship so I can still coach when I’m available. I’m obviously not as available as I was, but that door I guess is still there.” And when it comes to choosing between coaching and getting physical inside the ring, Baszler made it pretty clear where her priorities are right now. She figures she’ll have plenty of time to help younger talent when her wrestling days are behind her. “I can coach when I need a cane and have to sit in a chair. Beating people up right now is what I’m able to do right now, and let’s just ride it till the wheels fall off.” Things got even more interesting when Salcedo asked Baszler directly whether WWE would still allow her to coach if her TNA schedule permitted it. Rather than claiming she had some special arrangement worked out, Baszler gave a simple answer, saying, “Nobody’s told me no.” Baszler also revealed that she didn’t just show up in TNA without considering how WWE might react. Before agreeing to work alongside Serrano, she actually reached out to people whose opinions mattered to her and made sure the move wouldn’t create problems. “To be fair, I did ask people that mattered, ‘Hey, I’m thinking about helping Zoey out. Are there any issues with that?’ Nobody told me not to do it and that I wouldn’t be welcomed back.” That doesn’t mean everything has been officially settled. Baszler acknowledged that her increased responsibilities in TNA could eventually force both sides to revisit how much time she can dedicate to WWE. However, she made it clear that maintaining a positive relationship with the company is important to her. “Now again, there’s maybe some discussion to be had about my availability and all that, and we might have to revisit some of that at some point. I’m not someone that’s going to burn bridges either. I’m very thankful to WWE and everything they did for me and the platform they gave me.” Baszler and Serrano captured the TNA Knockouts World Tag Team Championships at Bound For Glory, giving Baszler a fresh start in the ring. summary_src: In the new issue of the Wrestling Observer Newsletter, Dave Meltzer provided an update on where the WWE WrestleMania 43 plans stand six months out. There is still plenty of time for things to change between now and April 2027, but Roman Reigns vs.
body: There is still plenty of time for things to change between now and April 2027, but Roman Reigns vs. Oba Femi has pretty consistently looked like the direction for one of the WrestleMania 43 main events. Meltzer confirmed that is the case. However, while Cody Rhodes vs. CM Punk would make sense for the other headliner of the two-night event, Meltzer says that is not the current plan. title: On the Record: Joe Hendry Discusses First WWE Microdrama ‘Agent of Shadows’ & Top Guy Aspirations
raw_title: Joe Hendry Talks First WWE Microdrama ‘Agent of Shadows’ & Top Guy Aspirations
body: Say his name, and he appears. Joe Hendry not only can be found Mondays on WWE Raw via Netflix , but in the company’s first ever microdrama Agent of Shadows . The short-form vertical series premieres October 23 under the ReelShort platform. At the center of the story is secret agent Adam Hawke, portrayed by microdrama regular Chase Mattson. Adam goes undercover as a nanny to protect his estranged daughter from a criminal syndicate. Former WWE Champion Drew McIntyre plays Roscoe, his right-hand man and tech expert. Hendry is among the cavalcade of pro wrestling superstars and legends featured including Jacob Fatu, Nikkita Lyons, Michael Hayes, and Booker T . For Hendry, this is another opportunity that has come within a whirlwind year. The viral performer caught fire in TNA Wrestling before securing an official WWE contract. He quickly ascended up the ranks from NXT , looking to reach new heights. We caught up with the Scottish entertainer to talk about what he has been up to and where the entertainer sees himself going. Micro-dramas have really exploded in popularity. What were your first thoughts about WWE collaborating with ReelShort for Agent of Shadows ? Joe Hendry: I had never heard of microdramas before, but I think that the concept is smart. Throughout the history of media, the way people consume content has always depended on storytelling. I think that WWE has often been at the forefront of how that’s done. If you look at the firs t WrestleMania , for example, the distribution for that, and then the emergence of the WWE Network. WWE has made some real innovations in media. And so to see them cross over into micro-dramas and this format early to me is exciting. It makes a lot of sense to me. When I arrive at an airport, and I see everyone scrolling on their phones, this looks like a useful way for people to consume our storytelling in a way that is convenient and is digestible for them, and keeps them engaged. Well, I have the best character. I had to really challenge myself to embrace this role. I, Joe Hendry, play Joe Hendry, the greatest character in all of media. So, yeah, I had fun with it. It looks like a crazy time on set with such a hodgepodge of WWE superstars and legends involved. Take me through what that was like. I’m excited to see Michael Hayes in it because he is a super charismatic person, so it’s cool to see him there. He’s so involved in our shows, it’s cool to see him on this side of the camera again. So I’m excited. That’s the role I’m probably most excited to see as a viewer. But, it was cool to be on set with Drew. Someone from Scotland who I look up to, who I’ve worked with a lot over the years before I came to WWE. Now to see him and what he’s doing and all that, you know, the high-level movie projects that he’s involved with, it’s cool to be on the same screen as him For me, I’ve had a few focuses in my professional life. I am passionate about all things business. That was my degree. That’s what I went to university

title: Bully Ray Picks LA Knight For 946
raw_title: Bully Ray Says One WWE Name Works Best As Next Member Of 946, Dismisses Drew McIntyre
summary_src: 946 need one more member to compete in a WarGames match against The Bloodline at WWE Survivor Series, but Bully Ray argues that it shouldn't be Drew McIntyre.
body: WWE WWE legend Bully Ray has named the wrestler who would be a perfect fit in the 946 faction. It seems that 946 and The Bloodline are on a collision course for a Survivor Series match next month , with the former still needing one more member. Fans have discussed several potential candidates, including Drew McIntyre, whom Ray dismissed as a suitable option. Instead, the Hall of Famer suggested LA Knight as the right pick. "Drew McIntyre is a complete disconnect for 946," Ray began on " Busted Open ." "The real answer is because that's logical, and sometimes people just want to come up with these ideas, like suggesting Drew McIntyre so they can say, 'I suggested Drew McIntyre' if it was ever Drew McIntyre. That feels very, very forced, just as if people say, 'Oh, well, Roman Reigns is going to be with 946.' There's one name that works best — LA Knight. Why? Because it makes sense in the story. And what was the last thing we heard in this story?" The Hall of Famer explained how Knight had stuck with Solo Sikoa on the belief that the latter wouldn't go back to The Bloodline. With Sikoa now once again pledging allegiance to his family , Knight would be aggrieved, which would make sense for him to join 946. "Solo after guaranteeing to LA Knight that he was not going to go back to the Bloodline, said, 'Are we cool?' LA Knight said, 'Yeah,' and then Solo last night went back to the Bloodline, which leads me to believe that LA Knight is not going to be cool, and now LA Knight is going to have to do something about it," he said. Ray proposed a storyline in which Knight would likely have to turn heel if he joined 946, but argued that it wouldn't have to be a definitive heel turn like John Cena's betrayal of Cody Rhodes. He suggested that Knight could argue that Sikoa had forced him to join 946.

title: Backstage Buzz: WWE’s WrestleMania 43 Main Event Plans Revealed
raw_title: WWE’s WrestleMania 43 Main Event Plans Revealed
summary_src: WWE already has a major WrestleMania 43 match in mind, but fans expecting Cody Rhodes vs. CM Punk might be disappointed. While Roman Reigns vs.
body: “There has been a lot of talk this week that the two main events for WrestleMania in 2027 would be Rhodes vs. Punk on night one and Reigns vs. Femi on night two. From what we were told, the latter is accurate but the former is not the current plan.” Meltzer explained that Rhodes vs. Punk would make sense considering both stars are on SmackDown and WWE has largely kept them apart since their August 1 SummerSlam championship match. That still doesn’t mean the company is planning to pull the trigger. “Rhodes vs. Punk would make sense and I could see the argument for it as they are the two top stars on the Smackdown brand and have been kept apart aside from their 8/1 SummerSlam title match. But right now that is not the plan.” Of course, WWE still has six months before WrestleMania 43, and Meltzer made it clear that nothing is set in stone. Plans have changed plenty of times before, and there’s no guarantee the current direction will stick. “We’re only in October and historically these plans will change multiple times anyway, whether due to injuries or other situations.” Reigns is currently holding the World Heavyweight Championship on RAW, while Sami Zayn is the Undisputed WWE Champion on SmackDown. That leaves plenty of possibilities for how WWE could get to Reigns vs. Femi, especially if the company wants to put a championship on the line. There’s also still no word on what WWE has planned for the other main event. Meltzer didn’t name a replacement for Rhodes vs. Punk, so that part of the WrestleMania card remains a mystery. WrestleMania 43 is expected to take place April 10 and 11, 2027, in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. WWE is also scheduled to return to Saudi Arabia for Crown Jewel on November 7, although ongoing tensions in the Middle East could complicate those plans. WWE and TKO officials have maintained that the event is still moving forward. For now, Reigns vs. Femi appears to be the match WWE wants, while Rhodes vs. Punk is off the table under the current plans. With six months left before WrestleMania, there’s still plenty of time for WWE to change its mind. summary_src: Ric Flair is dealing with another serious health issue, and this one is forcing him to cut back on travel. The WWE Hall of Famer revealed that he currently has a blood clot in his leg and will undergo a procedure after doctors warned him to limit how long he spends traveling. Flair shared the ...
body: Flair shared the news on Twitter while apologizing for canceling his scheduled appearance at Washington State Horror Con in Seattle. He said doctors have restricted him to trips lasting no longer than three to four hours, putting Seattle out of reach for the time being. “I Want To Sincerely Apologize To My Agent, Steve Solomon, Washington State Horror Con @wahorrorcon, @bigeventny, And Especially All My Fans In Seattle For Having To Cancel My Scheduled Appearance. “Unfortunately, I Am Dealing With A Blood Clot In My Leg, And My Doctors Have Limited My Travel To 3–4 Hours. Seattle Falls Outside That Range, And As Disappointed As I Am, I Have To Put My Health And Recovery First.” Flair isn’t downplaying the situation either. The Nature Boy acknowledged that blood clots can become life-threatening and made it clear he’s taking his doctors’ advice seriously. “Blood Clots Are Extremely Serious And Can Be Life-Threatening. We Have Seen This Recently With Jalen Hurts And The Complications Involving Blood Clots In His Lungs. It Is A Reminder That This Is Not Something To Take Lightly, And I Must Follow Medical Advice.” The good news is that Flair already has a treatment plan in place. He revealed that he’s scheduled for a procedure on the affected vein, which his doctors believe could eventually allow him to travel more freely again. “I’m Scheduled To Have A Procedure To Strip The Affected Vein, Which My Doctors Expect Will Allow Me To Be Cleared For More Travel Afterward.” Flair finished by apologizing again to the fans who were expecting to see him in Seattle. Despite his disappointment over having to cancel, he’s putting his recovery ahead of his appearance schedule. “Please Know This Decision Was Not Made Lightly. I Am Truly Sorry For The Inconvenience And Disappointment, And I Am Incredibly Grateful For Your Patience, Understanding, And Continued Support. “I Look Forward To Getting Healthy And Seeing You All Down The Road. Thank You For The Love And Support. Much Love, Ric Flair” This isn’t Flair’s first serious health concern in recent years. In 2025, he revealed that he was battling melanoma and later dealt with a torn rotator cuff that forced him to leave an AEW Dynamite taping before appearing on the broadcast . For now, Flair’s focus is once again on his health rather than keeping every appearance on his schedule. He’s already got a procedure lined up, and he’s hoping that taking care of the blood clot will eventually get him cleared to hit the road again. title: Who Made the Call to Load Up WWE NXT Against AEW Blood & Guts
raw_title: Who Made the Call to Load Up WWE NXT Against AEW Blood & Guts
summary_src: WWE is apparently making sure NXT doesn’t walk into its November 4 fight with AEW empty-handed. The show has already been told to load up for its head-to-head battle with Blood & Guts, and now it’s been revealed who allegedly made that call.
body: “NXT would have to load up given they are on an unfamiliar night. Nick Khan allegedly already made that call.” Still, once WWE knew where NXT was landing, apparently nobody wanted to just throw a normal episode out there. Meltzer expects a major angle at Halloween Havoc to help set up the Wednesday show, while AEW already has plenty planned with two Blood & Guts matches. “Besides going head-to-head with AEW, it would also go head-to-head with Main Event and with Evolve. I’d expect a major angle at Halloween Havoc to build to that show, and also expect AEW to load up its show, although it’s already one of AEW’s biggest TV shows of the year with the two Blood & Guts matches.” NXT could still have a tough night in the ratings regardless of what WWE throws at the show. Moving to an unfamiliar night is already a challenge, and going directly against Blood & Guts certainly isn’t going to make things easier. “One would expect NXT to be hurt significantly from the unfamiliar night and competition, but it’s better than being pre-empted in many markets. AEW will be hurt by the competition.” That adds some extra context to Bryan Alvarez’s earlier report that WWE had been told to make the November 4 episode something special. At the time, Alvarez confirmed the head-to-head battle and said NXT had been instructed to bring plenty to the table . “Confirmed that November 4th NXT and AEW are going head-to-head. That’s the Blood and Guts show and NXT was told to load it up.” WWE will actually have three shows running that night, with NXT, EVOLVE and Main Event all overlapping with AEW. That’s a lot of wrestling fighting for attention, but the real battle is obviously going to be NXT walking onto Wednesday night against Blood & Guts. The move may have happened because of election coverage, but WWE clearly isn’t treating November 4 like some throwaway schedule change. Now the big question is just how far the company is willing to go when it comes time to actually load up NXT. summary: I’d expect a major angle at Halloween Havoc to build to that show, and additionally expect AEW to load up its show. That’s the Blood and Guts show and NXT was told to load it up. WWE will actually have three shows running that night.

title: Austin Creed and Kofi Ink Five-Year AEW Deals
raw_title: Deeper Look At Austin Creed & Kofi's AEW Deals
summary_src: Austin Creed and Kofi, who debuted in AEW at All In, look set to remain with the promotion for a long time, as details of their contract lengths emerge.
body: AEW Austin Creed and Kofi seem to be planning to stay in AEW for the long run as new details emerge about the length of their contracts. Creed and Kofi debuted in AEW at All In and got off to a strong start, winning the Trios Championship alongside Swerve Strickland. A few weeks into their AEW run, " Fightful Select " reported that the duo had signed five-year deals with Tony Khan's promotion. Strickland reportedly played a significant role in bringing them to AEW, with Khan initially reluctant to approach the celebrated tag team duo while they were still under contract with WWE. Teaming with Strickland was also one of the first ideas that they were pitched before their AEW debut. The trio, who lost the Trios Championship to "Hangman" Adam Page and Brodido at the recent WrestleDream pay-per-view, weren't scheduled to hold the titles for long, as per the same report. It's well known that Khan doesn't skimp on purchasing music rights for his wrestlers' entrances, despite the high costs . He did the same for The New Level, who used A$AP Ferg's "New Level" as their entrance theme, with the aforementioned report stating that the song was approved on the day of All In. The report claimed that the delay was due to waiting for approval from Sony, which owns RCA Records, the label that released the song. Creed had revealed in an interview that they had less than a week to secure the rights to use the song, and had to speak to someone who knew A$AP Ferg's manager to get the deal over the line.
summary: Per Fightful Select, Austin Creed and Kofi signed five-year contracts with AEW. Swerve Strickland played a key role in recruiting the duo from WWE, and teaming with him was one of the first concepts presented to them. The group won the Trios Championship at All In but lost the titles to Hangman Adam Page and the Briscoes at WrestleDream, as they were not planned to hold the belts long-term.

title: Booker T Gets Irked When Wrestlers Say They Didn’t Speak Up For Fear Of Being Fired
raw_title: Booker T Gets Irked When Wrestlers Say They Didn’t Speak Up For Fear Of Being Fired
body: On Wrestlers Being Afraid Of Getting Heat: “It was like that around there. The guys were really scared about the thing called ‘getting heat.’ If you got heat, you could really start getting it from the boys. And I never really thought about that.” On Wrestlers Who Didn’t Speak Up For Fear Of Getting Fired: “Well some of the guys, it’s like anything, man. A bully will keep messing with you if you don’t fight back. And that’s why when I hear a lot of these stories from these guys that worked in the business, and they talk about what happened back then. And they weren’t willing to say anything because they didn’t want to get fired — God, man, it irks me. It really irks me. It really does, because I guess I’ve been willing to get fired a lot of times as far as the business goes. “The only thing I always said is, ‘The only thing you can do is fire me.’ And when I hear guys talk like that, man, it really hurts me. ‘I couldn’t stand up because that guy had more stroke than I did, and I could get fired.’ You end up getting fired anyway. So why not tell somebody to go take a hike or go jump in the lake? When I really want to get my point across, I say go jump in a lake.”

title: WWE Crown Jewel 2026 Still Set for Riyadh
raw_title: WWE Crown Jewel 2026 Is Confirmed For Riyadh (For Now)
body: WWE now finds itself between a rock and a hard place with tensions increasing in the middle east less than a month before the promotion is set to travel to Saudi Arabia for Crown Jewel. There was no mention of the PLE during WWE Money in the Bank earlier this month, but recent updates suggest WWE will still make the trip. "Right now, everything is still set. This weekend coming up in Abu Dhabi, we have a UFC fight. We have in the middle of November a Frieze art show. So far so good. Nothing's been cancelled," said TKO CEO Ari Emanuel during a Fox News appearance (h/t Cagesideseats.com. ) "We have a whole team kind of working on this, and if that doesn't happen, where we can move it. It's a daily monitoring." Turki Alalshikh, chairman of Saudi's General Entertainment Authority and co-founder of Zuffa Boxing with WWE parent company TKO, recently tweeted "Hard times reveal true friends," seemingly putting the pressure on promotions like WWE to move forward with current plans to travel to Riyadh. On the morning of October 13, 2026, WWE Chief Content Officer Paul Levesque took to X to post a Crown Jewel poster, confirming the event was to commence live from Riyadh on November 7, 2026. This week, the United States ordered diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia amid fears of escalating attacks. Where to Watch/Stream: WWE Crown Jewel 2026 is available on ESPN Unlimited in the United States. Crown Jewel can be viewed internationally through Netflix. Though WWE is still planning its trip to Saudi Arabia, backup plans have reportedly made as was confirmed by Emanuel. As of this writing, the backup city is undisclosed. "They're going to cancel when they feel there's no hope," said Dave Meltzer on Wrestling Observer Radio. (h/t Yahoo! ) "Nobody wants to go, I mean let's be serious, nobody wants to go right now. Everyone knows the situation, it's high alert for people, no one is advised to go there right now. Most likely, the show will be moved but they're not going to say anything until there's no hope and whatever, and that may be this week. I mean they may look at that and go 'There's no hope.' But they'll fight it until whenever they make the decision, but I mean yeah, it ain't looking good, it ain't looking good at all but they're not going to say anything. They're not going to say anything until the day they say it isn't happening. Could be any day now, they may hold out later." WWE's partnership with Saudi Arabia, while never short of controversy and strife , is one of its most lucrative partnerships with the industry leading promotion getting an estimated $50 million from Saudi Arabia per show as part of a 10-year agreement signed in 2018. WWE Royal Rumble 2026 was held in Saudi earlier this year at a staggering price of $100 million , while WrestleMania 43 is currently planned for 2027 as part of an reported $250 million deal. WWE has not yet announced a date for WrestleMania 43, which is rare given the promotion typically announces its WrestleMania date a y
summary: WWE remains scheduled to hold Crown Jewel in Riyadh amid rising Middle East tensions. TKO CEO Ari Emanuel confirmed that the November event is currently proceeding as planned while a team monitors the situation daily. Saudi General Entertainment Authority chairman Turki Alalshikh posted a message seemingly urging partners including WWE to follow through with commitments.

title: World X Cup and Dual Ultimate X Bouts Set for TNA Destination X
raw_title: World X Cup and Ultimate X matches added to TNA Destination X
summary_src: A World X-Cup Tournament and two Ultimate X matches are among the additions to TNA’s Destination X event next month.
body: A World X-Cup Tournament and two Ultimate X matches are among the additions to TNA’s Destination X event next month. On Thursday’s edition of Impact, TNA revealed that the World X-Cup would take place at the November 15 event and feature eight wrestlers from various countries. The eight will be divided into pairs for fatal four-way matches, with the two winners meeting later in the night. The X Cup concept has appeared in various forms since 2003, when it debuted as the Super X Cup and was won by Chris Sabin. The inaugural World X Cup was held the following year with a Team U.S. vs. Team Canada theme, with follow-ups in 2006 and 2008. Two Ultimate X matches will take place at Destination X. The men’s match will determine the next contender for the X Division championship held by Amazing Red. The Knockouts’ version will determine the next contender for the Knockouts Championship belonging to Indi Hartwell.
summary: TNA announced on Impact that its November 15 Destination X event will include a World X-Cup Tournament featuring eight international wrestlers split into fatal four-way matches with the victors clashing in the final. Two Ultimate X matches were also added, with the men's bout crowning the next X Division title challenger to Amazing Red and the Knockouts version determining the next challenger to Indi Hartwell's Knockouts Championship. The X Cup format dates back to 2003 and has been held in various iterations since.

llm_long: TNA Wrestling will hold its 2026 Destination X event on November 15 at the Edmonton EXPO Centre in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada.
During the October 22 episode of Thursday Night iMPACT, the promotion announced that two Ultimate X matches will take place at the show.

One Ultimate X match will be for men and the other for women. The men's winner will earn a future shot at the X Division Championship, while the women's winner will receive a future shot at the Knockouts World Championship.
The World X-Cup tournament is also returning for Destination X and will include wrestlers from around the globe.
The tournament format consists of two Fatal 4-Way matches, with the winners of those bouts advancing to meet in the World X-Cup final later that night.

title: WWE Survivor Series WarGames To Feature 5v5 Teams
raw_title: Backstage News On Number Of Participants For WWE Survivor Series Men's WarGames Match
summary_src: The WWE WarGames match will once again feature five wrestlers per team at Survivor Series, with a report revealing the potential lineups.
body: WWE This year's Survivor Series will feature a WarGames match, with five wrestlers from each team set to compete against each other. With the 2026 Survivor Series fast approaching, speculation is mounting about the WarGames match and who could be involved. " Fightful Select " reports that this year's WarGames match will feature five wrestlers on each team, with The Bloodline likely to face off against the 946 faction, led by Royce Keys. So far, only four wrestlers from each group have been involved in the storyline between the two factions. The Keys-led faction consists of Keys himself, OTM, and Carmelo Hayes. Meanwhile, The Bloodline comprises Roman Reigns, the group's de facto leader, The Usos, and Solo Sikoa, who recently reunited with his family. Jacob Fatu could likely join the four stars, while Sami Zayn — who recently featured alongside Reigns — could be another option. There is no indication yet as to who will be the fifth member of 946. Since being introduced to the main roster in 2022, The Bloodline have featured prominently in the WarGames match, competing at Survivor Series 2022 and Survivor Series 2024, emerging victorious on both occasions. Last year's men's WarGames match saw The Vision get the better of a team that included The Usos and Reigns, as well as Cody Rhodes and CM Punk. Survivor Series 2026 will take place in Houston, Texas, on November 28, and no matches have been announced for the show yet.
summary: This year's WWE Survivor Series will include a men's WarGames match with five wrestlers on each side. Per Fightful Select, The Bloodline is expected to battle a faction led by Royce Keys known as 946. So far only four members from each group have been active in the storyline, with Jacob Fatu and Sami Zayn among the possible additions for The Bloodline while the fifth man for 946 remains unclear.

title: Ari Emanuel Weighs In On the Status of WWE Crown Jewel 2026
raw_title: Ari Emanuel Comments on the Status of WWE Crown Jewel 2026
body: TKO Executive Chairman Ari Emanuel recently commented on the status of WWE Crown Jewel. There has been a lot of speculation around the status of WWE Crown Jewel due to heightened tensions in the Middle East. Earlier this week, the US State Department cautioned Americans in the Middle East to “exercise heightened vigilance.” On Thursday, another security alert was issued, this time by the US Embassy in Riyadh, urging Americans to take extreme caution when using airports in Saudi Arabia. TKO boss Ari Emanuel was asked about the status of WWE Crown Jewel during his recent appearance on Fox News . Emanuel said nothing’s canceled as of now. “Right now, everything is still set. This weekend, coming up in Abu Dhabi, we have a UFC fight. We have, in the middle of November, a Freeze Art Show. So far, it’s good. Nothing has been canceled.” When asked if TKO and WWE were getting briefed by the US government and whether the show would be canceled in any circumstance, Emanuel said: “Yeah, we have a whole team working on this, and kind of when, if that doesn’t happen, where we can move it. It’s a daily monitoring.” As things stand, Crown Jewel is scheduled to take place on November 7. 411Mania will provide the latest updates on its status when they are available.
summary: There has been a lot of speculation around the status of WWE Crown Jewel due to heightened tensions in the Middle East. TKO boss Ari Emanuel was asked about the status of WWE Crown Jewel during his recent appearance on Fox News .

title: Conrad Thompson Targets Podcasts With Heyman and Hayes
raw_title: Conrad Thompson Wants To Do Podcasts With Paul Heyman And Michael Hayes
body: Conrad Thompson wants to reshape the way people think about Michael Hayes. Thompson’s podcast network is already loaded with huge names like Jeff Jarrett, Tony Schiavone, Eric Bischoff, Jim Ross, and JBL. As it turns out, there are two white whales that Thompson is still chasing. “ Obviously Paul Heyman would be a big white whale for me, as would Michael Hayes.” Conrad Thompson told Fightful in a new interview. “Michael Hayes would not only give you the territory stuff, but he could give you the WCW stuff, look at this really long uninterrupted run behind the scenes in WWE. He’s not very online and, obviously, that’s by design. So if you could actually hear him in his natural state, just talking wrestling, there’s a reason he’s been so successful and been with WWE for so long. I think that the narrative out there maybe doesn’t give him full credit for that. So I would love to reshape the way people think about Michael Hayes one day.” Continuing his praise of Hayes, Thompson highlighted his involvement in some of the most pivotal moments in wrestling history. “That’s unprecedented and the idea that he was behind the scenes in a major way, in on a lot of really critical moments in history, he’s in the room where it’s being discussed for the first time. I think he could be tremendous and clearly he’s a natural entertainer. He knows how to spice it up. So I think the genre will welcome him whenever he’s ready.” Also, head over to our YouTube channel to check out more of our recent interviews.
summary: Conrad Thompson told Fightful he is still pursuing two major podcast guests: Paul Heyman and Michael Hayes. Thompson, whose network already features Jeff Jarrett, Tony Schiavone, Eric Bischoff, Jim Ross and JBL, believes a conversation with Hayes would highlight his long behind-the-scenes contributions in WCW and WWE while reshaping public perception of him. He noted Hayes is rarely online by design and praised the executive's unprecedented involvement in key wrestling history.

title: Results Recap: STARDOM To The World 2026 : Suzu Suzuki retains in No DQ war, Triangle of Madness defend trios titles
raw_title: STARDOM To The World 2026 Results: Suzu Suzuki retains in No DQ war, Triangle of Madness defend trios titles
body: Suzu Suzuki walked through a bloody, weapon-heavy path to retain her World of STARDOM Championship on Saturday night. Going 23 minutes against HATE faction leader Natsuko Tora, Suzuki was able to retain her world title in the main event of STARDOM To The World 2026, which took place at the Yokohama Budokan. Suzuki, known for her background in deathmatch wrestling, was able to fight within her own wheelhouse this weekend, facing Tora in a no disqualification matchup. However, it didn’t feel like a one-on-one bout at times, as Tora was able to lean on run-in attacks and assistance from HATE teammates to help her regain control of the bout. The lengthy main event included tons of plunder. Both women were cut open around the forehead early on following the use of a barbed wire baseball bat. Suzuki and Tora took turns using a staple gun on each other at one point, and Suzuki had to battle through a blinding blue mist to the eyes. Chairs, tables and ladders were all utilized as well. Tora looked as though she was closing in on a huge win late, connecting with a huge Death Valley Driver then wrapping chain around her hand for a lariat. But Suzuki countered the move, connected with her Tequila Shot, then a pair of Bridging German Suplexes. The champ arranged a pile of chairs in the ring and landed a third Bridging German Suplex, finally earning her the pinfall victory. Tora, who had a brief 34-day run with the title in 2024, was looking to join a short list of wrestlers to have carried the STARDOM world title twice. Tam Nakano, Mayu Iwatani, and Io Shirai remain the only names who have achieved such an accomplishment. Saturday was Suzuki’s first time defending the title since STARDOM wrapped up its 5Star Grand Prix tour this summer. Between her showing this week, plus outings against Sayaka Kurara and Utami Hayashishita in June, Suzuki has delivered big performances as champ. The champ took quite the beating early on from Sohrei, who had a hot start to the fight. Hanan would often find an opening and connect with a big move, only to have that momentum thwarted by Sohrei moments later. The match became much closer in the second half and, by the end, went the way of the champ. After kicking out at one from a powerbomb, Hanan went on a huge run of moves to retain: A bridging fallaway slam, busaiku knee, then a trio of bridging backdrop suplexes for the pinfall victory. Saturday’s co-main event felt like the best championship showing from Hanan since she captured the belt in April by beating Konami. Previous title matchups included wins over Saya Iida and Bea Priestley. After the match, Hanan was challenged by HATE’s Ruaka. title: Conrad Thompson Denies AEW Ties or Clickbait in Roman Reigns Critique
raw_title: Conrad Thompson denies his Roman Reigns criticism driven by AEW or clicks
summary_src: Conrad Thompson appeared on the Fightful Wrestling podcast this week, and the conversation inevitably turned to his ongoing beef with Roman Reigns.
body: The mortgage broker and podcaster was asked by Fightful ’s Sean Ross Sapp about Reigns saying during a recent appearance on the Club Shay Shay podcast that Thompson was using his name to get views for his shows. The WWE World Heavyweight Champion also insinuated Conrad was attacking him because of ties he may have to AEW. According to Thompson, he wasn’t looking to increase his ratings nor does he have any allegiance to AEW. As he pointed out, he’s friends with multiple people employed by WWE, including his sister-in-law, Charlotte Flair. Thompson’s critiques of Reigns caused a stir among wrestling fans in early August when he called the champ “the most overrated main eventer in WWE history” during an episode of 83 Weeks , the podcast he co-hosts with Eric Bischoff. He continued defending his position on his various podcasts, including on the September 25th episode of Something to Wrestle , which he hosts with John Bradshaw Layfield. During that show, he once again called Reigns overrated, before stating: “It’s also true that never have I ever seen a Roman Reigns T-shirt out in the wild. Not once.” Thompson later appeared on The Ariel Helwani Show and broke down why he feels Reigns is an “ industry plant .” “They [WWE] forced him to be on top and to always win over and over and over,” Thompson said to Helwani. “I give you the longest entrance. I let you go on last. You’re always the main event, and you always win. Well, I think that formula would work for pretty much anybody.” Conrad also said on Helwani’s show: “AEW is making wrestling for fans, and I think WWE is making wrestling for investors.” During the October 14 episode of Club Shay Shay , host Shannon Sharpe asked Reigns if he was bothered by Thompson’s attacks. “No, because the truth is, are there a lot of people watching that guy’s show? So, you’re gonna say stuff,” Reigns replied. “You already know I’m a metric mover. They know I give views and all that stuff. So, it’s fine. It is what it is.” The OTC then seemingly insinuated Thompson’s motivation was related to connections he has elsewhere. “If you look at the guy’s background, you already know where his support system — You know what I mean? All you got to do is scroll a little bit, and you see who he’s a fan of and stuff like that, and who he’s connected to,” Reigns said. “But no, if they want to use my name to get views, that’s the industry right now.” Though Reigns didn’t outright say it, Thompson has been linked to AEW in the past. His Starrcast fan conventions have been aligned with AEW events, and he co-hosts podcasts with AEW personalities Jim Ross and Tony Schiavone. However, Conrad has previously denied having any official deal with Tony Khan’s promotion. Thompson told Sapp that he’s been surprised by all the attention he’s received for his comments. “I shared my opinion about Roman — that I was ready for something new. And then everyone else started talking about it. And that’s what I kind of found so silly is if my opinio

title: WrestleMania 43 Main Event Plans in Doubt
raw_title: Expected WWE WrestleMania 43 Main Event May Not Happen After All
body: Though WWE is roughly half a year from WrestleMania 43, there have been strong indications across Raw and SmackDown that Oba Femi will challenge Roman Reigns for the World Heavyweight Championship while Punk would battle Rhodes, presumably for SmackDown's WWE Championship. Cody Rhodes Admits WWE Fans Have 'Cody Fatigue'—Here's Why He Should Turn Heel After Reigns recently defeated both LA Knight and Penta in separate marquee world title defenses, Reigns vs. Femi, barring an injury, appears to be a virtual lock for WrestleMania 43 next April in Saudi Arabia. There are, however, plenty of indications that Punk vs. Rhodes isn't a lock at all. Despite multiple recent teases of Rhodes vs. Punk II on both Raw and SmackDown, the WWE Championship scene on the blue brand is much more complicated than what's going on with Reigns. Namely, current WWE Champion Sami Zayn seems to have a smorgasbord of challengers lined up, all of which could drastically alter the WWE title picture. Among the key ones? His longtime nemesis Kevin Owens, Randy Orton, Gunther and Penta, the current holder of the Money in the Bank briefcase. Penta is the real wild card here. The former AEW star has taken WWE by storm in recent months after a stellar world title match against Reigns in Mexico City. That bout propelled Penta to winning the coveted MITB match, which he was not originally slated to win. Even more, Penta's virtual overnight success has WWE rethinking its plans for some of its Mexican-born stars and even considering bringing back the old Sin Cara character to capitalize on Penta's recent success. There is certainly a world in which Penta cashes in prior to WrestleMania 43, defeats Zayn, wins the WWE title and then defends it in the Mania event. There is also the potential for Penta to "call his shot" and challenge for the title at WrestleMania itself, where he could potentially win it in the show's headliner. While virtually no match will be bigger than Reigns vs. Femi on the SmackDown side, there are so many moving pieces in the blue brand's world title picture that Punk vs. Rhodes is far from a certainty, as should be the case. Perhaps Zayn holds onto the title and battles his friend-turned-foe Owens one more time in the WrestleMania Saturday main event. Maybe the Royal Rumble winner chooses to face SmackDown's WWE Champion and ends up main-eventing Night One of WrestleMania. Maybe a wild card like Orton becomes WWE Champion prior to WrestleMania. Although Femi vs. Reigns is the best and most obvious direction on Raw, there's no need to rush into Punk vs. Rhodes, which just happened at SummerSlam anyway, if there's not an intriguing story to tell. And if WWE refuses to turn Rhodes heel, then there's no reason to run back Punk vs. Rhodes, no matter how big it sounds on paper.
summary: WWE appears set for Roman Reigns to defend the World Heavyweight Championship against Oba Femi at WrestleMania 43. However the expected Cody Rhodes versus CM Punk match for the WWE Championship is far from certain with Sami Zayn facing a crowded field of potential challengers including Kevin Owens, Randy Orton, Gunther and Penta.
