title: US Intel Memo Raises Security Fears for WWE Crown Jewel
raw_title: New United States intellegence warning rasies security concerns ahead of WWE Crown Jewel
summary_src: A new memo highlights increasing security concerns in the Middle East as WWE is moving forward with plans for Crown Jewel in Saudi Arabia.
body: A new memo highlights increasing security concerns in the Middle East as WWE is moving forward with plans for Crown Jewel in Saudi Arabia. The memo, which was issued on Friday by director of national intelligence Jay Clayton, informed Secretary of State Marco Rubio that agencies have “received intelligence that Iran has substantially increased efforts to target U.S. personnel. The lethal plotting efforts by the Iranians against U.S. citizens have reached advanced stages in both the Middle East and certain other countries.” According to the New York Times, the Trump administration confirmed the memo’s existence on Friday night through a U.S. official. Security concerns for WWE’s next premium live event have been mounting in recent days as Saudi Arabia has faced increased attacks from the Iranian-backed Houthi rebel group. Despite this, executive chairman and CEO of TKO Ari Emanuel told Fox News that plans for the event on November 7 in Riyadh are still in place. “Right now, everything is still set. This weekend coming up in Abu Dhabi, we have a UFC fight. We have in the middle of November a Frieze art show. So far so good. Nothing’s been cancelled,” he said. “We have a whole team kind of working on this, and if that doesn’t happen, where we can move it. It’s a daily monitoring.” On Wednesday, the United States ordered nonessential diplomatic personnel and family members to leave the country . This comes as Saudi Arabia has seen heightened attacks from Iranian-backed Houthi rebels, increasing worries ahead of WWE's Crown Jewel scheduled for November 7 in Riyadh. TKO executive chairman and CEO Ari Emanuel confirmed to Fox News that the event remains on track despite the concerns, noting upcoming UFC plans in Abu Dhabi.

Nevertheless, a break could allow him to explore further treatment options. “It’s just that nagging, you know, just he’s had this bulging [disc] that’s just been bugging him,” Matt said. “It’s been a year now since he’s had this bulging [disc], and he’s going to, you know, I think he’s done everything he can to do in his power.” Matt added that Jeff may take some time away to explore solutions and correct the problem as much as possible. We Have Seen This Recently With Jalen Hurts And The Complications Involving Blood Clots In His Lungs. It Is A Reminder That This Is Not Something To Take Lightly, And I Must Follow Medical Advice.” Flair added that he would be undergoing a procedure to treat the blood clots which he hoped could allow him to resume his traveling. “I’m Scheduled To Have A Procedure To Strip The Affected Vein, Which My Doctors Expect Will Allow Me To Be Cleared For More Travel Afterward,” he said.

summary_src: Michin and B-Fab are the new champions. The October 24th edition of Friday Night SmackDown saw Michin and B-Fab defeat Tatum Paxley and Alexa Bliss to become the new WWE Women's Tag Team Champions. After their victory, Michin and B-Fab took to X to write about winning the belts.
body: The October 24th edition of Friday Night SmackDown saw Michin and B-Fab defeat Tatum Paxley and Alexa Bliss to become the new WWE Women’s Tag Team Champions. After their victory, Michin and B-Fab took to X to write about winning the belts. Michin wrote: “So thankful to achieve this in my hometown. It’s still so surreal omg.. being able to have my family witness this live in the stands… thank you, oppa for wrestling me when we were kids. You planted this nugget of an insane dream. I love you, 909. Fontana’s Finest 💙 “Wow what a journey really.. no one knows your story and path like you so when you have moments of glory and moments you felt like you overcame it means the world. When people don’t believe in you have to believe in yourself and keep going. Push even when you don’t think you can. You will thank yourself later! ❤️❤️ You did it B!!” So thankful to achieve this in my hometown. The title win is both Michin and B-Fab’s first championships in WWE. Bliss and Paxley held the belts for 14 days.

summary_src: Lucha Libre AAA will air another live show on FOX this week and this time it’s the special Heroes Inmortales event, which is why the company has booked a stacked card in order to guarantee fans have a great time from start to finish. AAA Mega Championship: El Grande Americano (c) vs.
body: Dominik Mysterio wants the AAA Mega Championship back, and this time he’s bringing some serious backup. Dominik earned another shot at El Grande Americano after his team defeated Americano and Rey Mysterio on the October 3 episode of AAA. That puts him back in position to reclaim the championship he previously lost to Americano. There’s another problem for the champion tonight. Dominik will have Omos and Dorian Roldán in his corner, giving Americano a lot more to worry about than just the man standing across the ring from him. Americano has already proven he can beat Dominik . Doing it again with Omos and Roldán hanging around ringside could be a very different challenge. Rey Fenix has another challenger waiting for his Cruiserweight Championship. Mini Vikingo gets a direct one-on-one opportunity at the title tonight after recently competing in the Fatal Four-Way No. 1 Contender’s Match at Worlds Collide. Fenix has been busy defending the championship since winning it, including surviving a Fatal Four-Way defense at TripleMania 34 Night 2. This time there aren’t three other challengers involved. It’s just Fenix and Vikingo, with one of AAA’s championships going home with the winner. Los Perros del Mal have three very different challengers coming after their titles. The AAA World Trios Champions defend against La Parka, Mr. Iguana and Niño Hamburguesa, putting another one of AAA’s major championships on the line. La Parka and Mr. Iguana have both become regular parts of AAA’s current WWE partnership, while Niño Hamburguesa gives the team another completely different element. Los Perros del Mal have the advantage of being the established championship unit. Their challengers will have to figure out whether their very different styles can work together well enough to take the titles. La Catalina will defend the AAA Reina de Reinas Championship against Flammer and La Hiedra. In another match, El Fiscal squares off agaist Abismo Negro Jr. Finally, Marisela Peña will be inducted into the AAA Hall of Fame. AAA Heroes Inmortales 2026 promises to deliver high drama and storylines that will keep fans on the edge of their seats. With appearances from Dominik Mysterio and more, it’s bound to be a show you won’t want to miss. Be sure to tune in live and follow along with Ringside News for full play-by-play coverage. AAA Heroes Inmortales 2026 will air live from Gimnasio Olímpico Juan de la Barrera in Mexico City and the show will begin at 10 PM ET. Fans in Latin America can watch the show on FOX, while those in the US and outside the US can watch the show on YouTube . title: On the Record: Drew McIntyre Opens Up On Awkward Encounter With Robert Downey Jr. That He Still Regrets
raw_title: Drew McIntyre Reveals Awkward Encounter With Robert Downey Jr. That He Still Regrets
summary_src: Drew McIntyre has met plenty of celebrities during his wrestling career, but one awkward run-in with Robert Downey Jr. still bugs him. McIntyre had the perfect chance to chat with the Hollywood star and accidentally walked away from it because he was trying to be polite.
body: Speaking with Sidewalks Entertainment while promoting Agent of Shadows, McIntyre explained that he doesn’t usually get starstruck around famous people. He’d rather have a normal conversation and learn something from them, but that approach backfired when he unexpectedly found himself standing next to Downey outside a Los Angeles restaurant. “Yeah, I don’t really get that excited about that. I’m excited to talk and learn from a lot of people. Like, I remember one time, I got out of an L.A. restaurant, I turned around to get in my car, and Robert Downey Jr. was there. And I was like, ‘Oh, hey man, I’m a fan of your work.’” McIntyre immediately started walking away after introducing himself because he knows what it’s like when strangers invade your personal space. There was only one problem — he quickly realized Downey apparently wasn’t done talking. “And I started turning away because I know what it’s like when people are kind of up in your business. And I realized as I turned away, he wanted to keep talking, but I committed to turning, so I kept turning.” Instead of just turning back around, McIntyre decided he’d already committed too hard to the exit and kept going. That left him regretting the decision almost immediately while he and Downey awkwardly waited around for their cars. “I was like, ‘Damn it, he wanted to keep talking,’ and I’m turning. We’re both awkwardly waiting for our cars. So, I kind of wish I continued that conversation because I am a fan, but I also know what it’s like when people are up on you and asking too many questions.” McIntyre apparently gets much more excited when he runs into someone connected to the movies he loved growing up. One of those moments came at a signing in Knoxville, Tennessee, when he spotted Sam J. Jones, the actor who played Flash Gordon. “Somebody I really was excited to meet—it’s usually cult figures. I did a signing once in Knoxville, Tennessee, and Flash Gordon was there, the actor that played him. I can’t remember the name, Sam, off the top of my head. But I was leaving, and I was like, ‘Ah, my brother loves him,’ and, you know, I’m a big fan of Flash Gordon as well. My brother’s obsessed.” McIntyre was preparing to leave when he suddenly heard Jones calling his name. The whole thing immediately reminded him of a scene from Ted, complete with the Flash Gordon theme playing in his head. “And then I heard my name getting shouted, just ‘Drew!’ in a big, booming voice, and I knew he was right there. And as I turned, it was like a scene from the movie Ted. I just heard the Flash Gordon theme. He was motioning me over, and I went over, and I did exactly say the line from the teddy bear movie where he says, ‘Thanks for saving every one of us.’” That encounter went considerably smoother than the Robert Downey Jr. one. Jones signed something for McIntyre’s brother, and Drew walked away with a much better celebrity story to tell. “He was lovely. Signed a picture for my brother. My brother proudly has it on

title: Fans Accuse WWE of Pointless Booking After Michin and B-Fab’s Women’s Tag Team Title Win
raw_title: Fans Accuse WWE of Pointless Booking After Michin and B-Fab’s Women’s Tag Team Title Win
summary_src: WWE fans are not happy about Alexa Bliss and Tatum Paxley’s ridiculously short run as Women’s Tag Team Champions. The two dropped the belts to Michin and B-Fab on the October 23 episode of SmackDown, and it didn’t take long for social media to start ripping into the decision.
body: Bliss and Paxley had only been champions for about two weeks, and Friday’s match was supposed to be their first successful defense. Instead, Jade Cargill got involved behind the referee’s back, punching Paxley and setting her up for Michin to hit a Styles Clash for the win. The quick title change immediately had fans asking why WWE bothered putting the belts on Bliss and Paxley in the first place. One fan took to Twitter and made it clear that they felt WWE pulled the plug on the team way too quickly. “Way too soon, Tatum and Alexa should’ve had them for longer.” Another fan was confused by the entire point of the short reign. Bliss and Paxley didn’t even get one successful defense before WWE moved the championships over to Michin and B-Fab. “So like….what was the point of Alexa and Tatum winning the belts if they couldn’t get a successful defense Others took aim at WWE’s handling of the Women’s Tag Team Championship scene as a whole. One fan didn’t bother sugarcoating their feelings about the division. Another fan argued that cutting Bliss and Paxley’s run short isn’t going to help WWE build up its women’s roster. They questioned what the company was thinking by ending the reign so quickly. The frustration got even stronger from there. One fan called the title change the “worst decision in history” and even blamed TKO for seemingly trying to get a reaction out of viewers. “Worst decision in history. I think TKO is literally just wanting to piss people off at this point.” Bliss and Paxley didn’t exactly lose clean either. Paxley was setting up Cemetery Drive on Michin when Cargill punched her behind the referee’s back, allowing Michin to capitalize and score the pin to win the championships with B-Fab. That interference gives WWE somewhere to go with Paxley and Cargill, but it hasn’t stopped fans from questioning why Bliss and Paxley needed to lose the belts so quickly. Their reign barely had time to get started before WWE pulled the trigger on another title change. Whether WWE has a bigger plan behind the switch remains to be seen, but fans certainly aren’t waiting around to hear the explanation. After just two weeks and zero successful defenses, Bliss and Paxley’s title reign is already over, and plenty of viewers clearly aren’t thrilled about it. title: Backstage Buzz: AEW Has Discussed Plans for WrestleMania 43 Weekend
raw_title: AEW Has Discussed Plans for WrestleMania 43 Weekend
summary_src: AEW has already started talking about what it could do during WrestleMania 43 weekend in 2027. With WWE taking WrestleMania to Saudi Arabia that year, the company could have a pretty big opening to run something of its own in the United States.
body: Speaking on The Certified Mark Show , AEW referee and travel department manager Bryce Remsburg was asked whether the company has considered taking advantage of WrestleMania being overseas. Remsburg confirmed that conversations are happening, although nothing has been announced yet. “Yeah, I think I can say that conversations are being had around what we might do that weekend. How about that?” Bryce Remsburg didn’t reveal exactly what AEW has discussed. He did note that there are still outside factors that could play a role in whatever the company ultimately decides to do. “And there are some factors out of our control that would contribute to our decisions. So we’ll kind of see what happens, and then we’ll see what happens.” The update comes after Tony Khan already showed interest in doing something big around that period . Back in 2025, Khan discussed the possibility of running a major AEW show in the spring of 2027 around the time WrestleMania 43 takes place. WrestleMania weekends in the United States traditionally attract plenty of independent wrestling shows alongside WWE’s events. With WrestleMania 43 taking place in Saudi Arabia instead, that usual setup will be very different in 2027. Nothing is official from AEW yet, but Remsburg’s comments confirm the company has at least discussed its options for that weekend. Exactly what AEW decides to do will depend on how those remaining factors play out. Steve Carrier Steve Carrier is the founder of Ringside News and has been reporting on pro wrestling since 1997. His stories have been featured on TMZ, Forbes, Bleacher Report, and more.

body: DMFirst Veer Game odds uden om ROFUS Jalwa Game Goa Game Raja Game MaanWin WWE'S FIRST-EVER MICRODRAMA 'AGENT OF SHADOWS' IS NOW STREAMING, FULL DETAILS ON STORY AND FORMAT By Mike Johnson on 2026-10-23 09:19:00 WWE's first-ever Microdrama Agent of Shadows is now streaming on Reelshort. For the uninitiated, a microdrama is a short-form scripted drama designed to tell a story in very small chunks, usually through bite-sized episodes that last anywhere from 1 to 3 minutes. The idea is basically to appeal to the younger Tik Tok/social media type audience. The format has gained a lot of steam internationally in recent years, particularly in China. For Agent of Shadows , there are 72 episodes. The plot - "The world's greatest secret agent must protect and care for his six-year-old daughter while posing as her nanny. Now, without revealing his true identity, he must win his daughter's (and her mother's) trust, while secretly thwarting corrupt suitors, mafioso strongmen, and even a megalomaniacal billionaire who's using his family to get to him." Michael Hayes, Drew McIntyre, Jacob Fatu, Nikkita Lyons, Joe Hendry, Ethan Page and Booker T are among those appearing over the course of the story. We are told that those on both the Reelshort and WWE sides worked hard to slip easter eggs in for the WWE audience, including Booker T's crown from his King Booker run and Drew using one of his actual swords from his ring entrance. title: Michin and B-Fab React to Winning WWE Women’s Tag Team Titles on SmackDown
raw_title: Michin and B-Fab React to Winning WWE Women’s Tag Team Titles on SmackDown
summary_src: Michin and B-Fab are officially WWE Women’s Tag Team Champions, and they’re still trying to process what just happened. After pulling off a major title win on SmackDown, both women took to social media to celebrate the moment.
body: Michin and B-Fab defeated Alexa Bliss and Tatum Paxley during the October 23, 2026 episode of WWE SmackDown to capture the WWE Women’s Tag Team Championships. The victory came after Jade Cargill interfered in the match, punching Paxley while the referee wasn’t looking. Michin then connected with a Styles Clash to secure the pinfall and end Bliss and Paxley’s title reign in their first defense. After the show, Michin took to X to celebrate winning the championships in her hometown area. She admitted that the moment still didn’t feel real, especially because her family was in attendance. She also thanked her brother for helping spark her wrestling dreams when they were children. “So thankful to achieve this in my hometown. It’s still so surreal omg.. being able to have my family witness this live in the stands… thank you, oppa for wrestling me when we were kids. You planted this nugget of an insane dream. I love you, 909. Fontana’s Finest 💙 B-Fab had plenty to say about the victory as well. She reflected on everything she went through to reach this point in her career and sent a message about believing in yourself even when other people don’t. “Wow what a journey really.. no one knows your story and path like you so when you have moments of glory and moments you felt like you overcame it means the world. When people don’t believe in you have to believe in yourself and keep going. Push even when you don’t think you can. You will thank yourself later! ❤️❤️ You did it B!!” The championship victory is a major moment for both women, but it didn’t come without controversy. Jade Cargill’s interference played a direct role in the finish, leaving Bliss and Paxley with a legitimate reason to be furious about how they lost their titles. Still, Michin and B-Fab aren’t letting that take away from their celebration. Both women have spent years working toward an opportunity like this, and now they finally have championship gold around their waists. With their emotional reactions making it clear how much the victory means to them, the next challenge will be proving they can hold onto those titles. title: In Memoriam: Latest Latest On Investigation Into Death Of Former AEW & WWE Star Pac
raw_title: Latest Update On Investigation Into Death Of Former AEW & WWE Star Pac
body: Meltzer spoke to a source who works closely with the office, who stated that when additional studies have been ordered, it usually indicates that the person who passed away didn't have a "natural death" such as a stroke, a heart attack, or an aneurysm, as all of these would be apparent in the initial autopsy. The source did note that they aren't entirely familiar with Pac's case but understands that it is a high-profile one, which Meltzer believes is also a reason why no information has been released at this time as the office will want to make sure their findings are conclusive, and doing extra studies and research, a more concrete answer can be provided whenever the time comes. Essentially, by not announcing anything now, Meltzer stated that the office simply doesn't have enough information to make a ruling. In his update, Meltzer also provided details about the minutes and hours before Pac passed away. It had already been made public that he was found dead at the wheel of his rental car just after 4PM CT on September 27, with saliva on the front of his shirt and undisclosed medication in his car. Since then, Meltzer noted that while officers were at the scene of his death, a woman called Pac's cell phone and officers answered it, with the officers finding out that Pac had told the woman who remains nameless at this time that he was on the way to the airport, but stopped off at CAVA's Mediterranean restaurant across the street to have some lunch, which Meltzer stated was a decision he made as his flight back to Newcastle on that day was delayed. However, Pac never got out of the car once he parked up, and since he reportedly never complained about any pains or aches before he set off means that he didn't pull over because he felt something as he was driving, something must have happened between his last call and his sudden passing. When Pac was found, there were no signs of an inadvertent injuries or foul play, another detail that has made the mission to find out the cause of death take a little longer than usual. The wrestling world has paid tribute to Pac in more ways than one since his passing. The September 30 episode of "AEW Dynamite" was entirely dedicated to Pac and his career, which included a number of tributes from the AEW roster. Those tributes that didn't make it to air due to time constraints were complied and released on AEW's YouTube channel . WWE also released a compilation of tributes from those who knew Pac best, and companies he had previously worked for such as RevPro and Dragon Gate honored him with a ten-bell salute.

title: Ego Pro Wrestling The Champ Is Here results
raw_title: Ego Pro Wrestling "The Champ Is Here!!!" results: Vetter's review of Eddie Kingston vs. Kody Lane, JTG and Trip Jordy vs. The Premier, Joe Alonzo vs. Victor Iniestra
body: By Chris Vetter , ProWrestling.net Contributor ( @chrisvetter73 ) Ego Pro Wrestling “The Champ Is Here!!!” October 3, 2026, in Shorewood, Illinois, at Papa Magoo Available for streaming via Pro Wrasslin Shoots YouTube This venue is an inflatable, indoor Teflon dome — think the old Metrodome in Minneapolis. The lighting is good, and the crowd was maybe 300. Tyler Volz and Zack Thomas were the commentators; one of them laughed nonstop to the point I found him annoying. The commentators said it was sold out. That might be an exaggeration, but it’s a BIG crowd for this space. The ground is green turf, like at a mini golf course. Google Maps shows that Shorewood is on the far southwest corner of the Chicago metro, near Joliet. WOW, this promotion has the largest on-screen graphics I’ve ever seen, filling the whole screen. (I wish more promotions had graphics, but I think I know most of the wrestlers on this show.) * This is the promotion of Robert “Ego” Anthony, who is a two-decade pro — he’s faced every top guy in Chicago from CM Punk to Colt Cabana. I’ve seen him wrestle in AEW, notably against Stu Grayson in what I believe was Stu’s final AEW match. Just about everyone on this show wrestles regularly at Chicago Style Wrestling. 1. Danny Orion vs. Rafael Quintero. These guys are both really talented; this could be the main event. I rank Texas-based Orion as a top 10 indy talent. Danny attacked Quintero as he entered the ring, then he dove onto Quintero. Quintero hit his own dive to the floor! Danny hit a flip dive to the floor, so Quintero hit his own flip dive to the floor! In the ring, Orion dropped him gut-first across the top rope at 1:30, and he hit a Swanton Bomb onto Quintero’s back for a nearfall. Orion hit a suplex, posed, and got booed. The commentators talked about how Orion won a prior matchup. Danny hit a dropkick for a nearfall at 3:30. They traded chops on the floor. Back in the ring, Orion stomped on Quintero and kept him grounded. They fought in the corner, and Quintero knocked him to the mat, then hit a top-rope crossbody block at 7:00. Quintero hit a running knee to the side of the head for a nearfall. Orion hit a huracanrana and a Flatliner, then a German Suplex. He hit a slingshot twisting splash, then a Lionsault for a nearfall at 8:30. Quintero hit a Death Valley Driver on the ring apron! Orion hit a second-rope German Suplex into the ring; Quintero rotated and landed stomach-first. Quintero ducked a kick and nailed a Poison Rana. Orion nailed a Canadian Destroyer, and they were both down at 11:00. They got to their knees and traded forearm strikes, then more while standing. Orion hit a Pele Kick. He did a double backflip and hit a DDT for a nearfall at 13:00. This has been really sharp! Orion nailed a spin kick to the head for a nearfall. Quintero hit a Frankensteiner. He scooped up Orion and hit a sit-out powerbomb for the pin. Awesome. This series is tied 1-1, and I want a rubber match. 2. Victor Iniestra (w/Lili La Pescadi
summary: Ego Pro Wrestling held its The Champ Is Here event on October 3 2026 inside an inflatable dome in Shorewood Illinois. The show featured Eddie Kingston facing Kody Lane along with tag team action pitting JTG and Trip Jordy against The Premier and a singles bout between Joe Alonzo and Victor Iniestra. llm_long: Ego Pro Wrestling held its The Champ Is Here event on October 3 2026 in Shorewood Illinois at Papa Magoo. The show took place inside an inflatable indoor Teflon dome with green turf flooring and drew a crowd of around 300 fans. It is available for streaming on the Pro Wrasslin Shoots YouTube channel.

The promotion is run by Robert Ego Anthony a veteran wrestler with two decades of experience who has competed against top names in the Chicago area. Most wrestlers on the card regularly appear for Chicago Style Wrestling. The venue is located on the far southwest edge of the Chicago metro area near Joliet.

Tyler Volz and Zack Thomas provided commentary for the show. The promotion used large on-screen graphics that filled the entire screen. The commentators noted the event was sold out though the attendance appeared large for the space.

The opening match featured Danny Orion against Rafael Quintero. Orion attacked Quintero during his entrance and followed with a dive to the floor. Quintero responded with his own dive and later matched Orion with a flip dive to the floor as well.

In the ring Orion dropped Quintero gut-first across the top rope and followed with a Swanton Bomb onto his back for a nearfall. Orion also delivered a suplex and a dropkick. The wrestlers traded chops on the floor before Orion kept Quintero grounded with stomps.
Quintero fought back with a top-rope crossbody block and a running knee to the side of the head for a nearfall. Orion answered with a huracanrana and a Flatliner.

body: Barring one of them losing their championships, WWE World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns and Undisputed WWE Champion Sami Zayn are set to meet for the Crown Jewel Championship at WWE Crown Jewel on November 7, 2026. This is scheduled to be their third singles match against each other on WWE programming and their eighth when you include non-televised house show events. Reigns has won all seven previous singles matches between the two. According to Cagematch , the first match between the two was at a WWE house show on September 20, 2019, at the Smart Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City, Philippines. Reigns defeated Zayn that night on a show that also included Kofi Kingston defending the WWE Championship against Daniel Bryan and The Revival defending the WWE SmackDown Tag Team titles against Big E and Xavier Woods. Zayn and Reigns wrestled again the next night at a show from the Mercedes-Benz Arena in Shanghai, China. The show had largely the same lineup as the one in the Philippines, and Reigns again defeated Zayn. Then, on September 22, 2019, Reigns again defeated Zayn at a house show held at the Neal S. Blaisdell Center in Honolulu, Hawaii. Then came their first match on WWE programming . Although this is a match between the two on record, it only lasted 15 seconds. Before the match could begin, Zayn cut a promo about how he was going to beat Reigns for the title and then move on to wrestle Brock Lesnar at the WWE Day 1 PLE. However, this just led to Lesnar attacking Zayn, and then as soon as the bell rang to start the match, Reigns hit a spear and made him tap out to the guillotine, and that was that. Their second singles match on WWE programming took place at the Bell Centre in Zayn’s hometown of Montreal, Quebec, Canada. In a bout Dave Meltzer rated four and three-quarter stars, Roman Reigns retained the WWE and Universal Championships against Sami Zayn thanks to interference from the Bloodline. WWE then scheduled a rematch between the two a few weeks later at a house show at the Coca-Cola Coliseum in Toronto. Finally, the last time the two met was at a WWE live event on October 14, 2023, at the T-Mobile Center in Kansas City, where Reigns again defeated Sami Zayn, marking his seventh straight singles victory over him. Zayn and Reigns have met in several tag team matches as well. At the Night of Champions pay-per-view on May 27, 2023, Kevin Owens and Zayn successfully defended the WWE Raw and SmackDown Tag Team titles against Reigns and Solo Sikoa. Reigns and Zayn have tagged together on multiple occasions as well, including the 2022 and 2024 WarGames matches. In 2022 , the Bloodline defeated Drew McIntyre, Owens, and the Brawling Brutes. In 2024 , CM Punk, The Usos, Reigns, and Zayn defeated Bronson Reed, Jacob Fatu, Sikoa, Tama Tonga, and Tonga Loa. Their next meeting will see both men enter as world champions, each seeking his first Crown Jewel Championship. Zayn will also be looking to score his first singles victory over Reigns. Ian Carey
summary: Roman Reigns holds a perfect 7-0 record over Sami Zayn in prior singles encounters according to Cagematch. Their first two meetings took place on non-televised house shows in September 2019 in the Philippines and China where Reigns won both nights. The upcoming Crown Jewel Championship bout on November 7 2026 would mark their third televised singles match and eighth overall.

body: The former WWE ring announcer is approaching the end of her two-year non-compete agreement, and news that AEW has discussed using her on television has now caught her attention. title: Tommaso Ciampa Praises Andrade's Current AEW Run
raw_title: Tommaso Ciampa says Andrade is at his best in AEW
summary_src: Tommaso Ciampa believes AEW National Champion Andrade El Idolo is performing at the highest level of his career, despite the ongoing rivalry between the two wrestlers.
body: Tommaso Ciampa believes AEW National Champion Andrade El Idolo is performing at the highest level of his career, despite the ongoing rivalry between the two wrestlers. In an interview prior to AEW WrestleDream with James Dator of SB Nation, Ciampa praised Andrade’s current AEW run and the reactions he has been receiving from fans. “Right now we’re seeing the very best Andrade we’ve ever seen,” Ciampa said. “I was in a three-way with him in Mexico at Arena Mexico, him and Komander, and the response when his music hit was just insane.” Ciampa was referring to their three-way match with Komander at AEW Grand Slam Mexico on August 5. Andrade won the match to secure the first entry in the All In Casino Gauntlet. Ciampa also discussed the similarities between their careers and what makes their rivalry compelling. “It’s a fun mesh of two guys who are just hungry, have chips on their shoulders, and have a lot to prove to themselves — probably even more so than to others. But our paths have kind of been parallel at times, and right now it’s a fun place for them to intertwine,” he said. Andrade ultimately retained his championship against Ciampa at WrestleDream, winning the match with The DM. Ciampa and Andrade previously crossed paths in WWE, including a singles match at a 2016 NXT live event. Their rivalry continued in AEW, where Ciampa was announced as the challenger for Andrade’s National Championship at WrestleDream on October 17. title: Michael Hayes Needs Additional Surgeries
raw_title: Michael Hayes Shares That He Needs To Undergo More Surgeries
summary_src: More surgeries on the horizon for Michael Hayes. The latest episode of Stephanie McMahon's What's Your Story? podcast featured an extensive chat with WWE producer Michael Hayes. Hayes went over the surgeries he's undergone and went on to share that he needs more.
body: Hayes went over the surgeries he’s undergone and went on to share that he needs more. “I had the hip replaced in ‘20, I had this replaced in ‘22, I had this replaced in ‘24. I’m so sick of surgeries, and I need more.” He continued, “I’m really sick of the recoveries. The recoveries are the sh*ts.” Hayes added, “You know what’s funny? I would never take pain medication when I had all those surgeries. I was never a pill guy. I liked cocaine. The only reason I liked cocaine was so I could keep drinking. I hated cocaine without drinking.” Hayes needing more surgeries was brought back up, and he replied, “Oh, I do. Yeah. This shoulder’s really bad.” Hayes would add that Diamond Dallas Page’s DDP Yoga program has been helpful with the recovery processes he’s gone through. Continuing on the subject of his surgeries, Hayes said he may need another operation on his surgically repaired left hip. “So I got on Wegovy about a year and two months ago, and I started doing DDP Yoga, and man, I’ve dropped 50 pounds, and my mobility is so much better now. So much better. It’s not the hardest thing in the world to do but you get results from it. It’s hard at first. It’s very hard at first. But once you get into the routine… Dallas has made me my own workouts.” Hayes continued, “My shoulders are horrible. Even the one that got fixed ain’t great. It’s better than it was. I think my expectation level was way too high for all my surgeries. The only one that really worked for me was my hip, because it’s a lot better, yet I feel the left one starting to do the little twinges so that’s probably another thing that I got to look forward to in a couple of years.” Hayes is 67 years of age. Elsewhere during the chat, Hayes said that Chief Content Officer Paul ‘Triple H’ Levesque wants to make Bobby Roode his successor in the producer role.
summary: Michael Hayes detailed his past hip replacement in 2020, another procedure in 2022 and one in 2024. He stated he requires further operations, specifically noting his shoulder and possibly his left hip, while expressing frustration with the recovery process. Hayes credited DDP Yoga and Wegovy for helping him lose 50 pounds and improve his mobility during recoveries.

title: Gunther Puts Danhausen on Notice in Unaired WWE SmackDown Footage
raw_title: Gunther Puts Danhausen on Notice in Unaired WWE SmackDown Footage
summary_src: Gunther isn’t happy about Danhausen getting his own special edition of WWE SmackDown, and he’s already promising to do something about it. WWE is advertising next week’s show as Danhausen’s Very Nice, Very Evil SmackDown, but Gunther thinks the whole thing is ridiculous.
body: Although Gunther didn’t appear on the October 23, 2026 episode of WWE SmackDown , WWE released an exclusive backstage interview with Cathy Kelley that didn’t air during the broadcast. That’s where Gunther made his feelings about Danhausen very clear. Kelley brought up the announcement of Danhausen’s Halloween-themed SmackDown special, but Gunther immediately interrupted her and demanded to know what it was supposed to be. Once Kelley explained that it likely had something to do with Halloween, Gunther wasn’t impressed. “Okay, yeah, sure. I get what we’re doing. Well, first of all, I hate Halloween.” Gunther then turned his attention directly to Danhausen, mocking WWE for giving him a special night and suggesting that the company was only doing it to make him feel included. “And secondly, I get what we’re doing. Special night for the underprivileged weirdo. Everybody get together, make him feel like he belongs in a space where he doesn’t belong. I mean, that’s what we do, it’s what we are, right? WWE family. Make him feel special. But nobody cares about that.” Gunther wasn’t finished. Before ending the interview, he made it clear that he intends to show up next Friday and personally get involved in Danhausen’s big night. “You know what, Cathy? I’m going to be there next week and I’m going to make sure it’s going to be a very special night for a very special boy.” That sounded like a pretty direct warning, especially considering Gunther’s attitude toward Danhausen throughout the interview. He didn’t explain exactly what he plans to do, but he certainly doesn’t sound interested in letting Danhausen enjoy his Halloween special. WWE has already announced two championship matches for the October 30 show, with Sami Zayn defending the Undisputed WWE Championship against Trick Williams and Chelsea Green defending the WWE Women’s Championship against Nikki Bella. Now Gunther has confirmed he’ll be there too, and his comments suggest Danhausen could have another problem waiting for him. title: Michael Hayes Opens Up On He Needs More Surgeries After Multiple Operations
raw_title: Michael Hayes Reveals He Needs More Surgeries After Multiple Operations
summary_src: Michael Hayes has already been through several major surgeries, and the WWE producer isn’t done yet. The 67-year-old wrestling veteran revealed that he needs more operations after undergoing multiple joint replacements over the past few years.
body: Speaking on Stephanie McMahon’s What’s Your Story? podcast, Hayes opened up about his ongoing health problems and the surgeries he’s undergone since 2020. He explained that he’s had several joints replaced, but those procedures haven’t completely solved his problems. “I had the hip replaced in ‘20, I had this replaced in ‘22, I had this replaced in ‘24. I’m so sick of surgeries, and I need more.” Hayes admitted that the operations themselves aren’t even his biggest complaint anymore. It’s everything that comes afterward that has worn him down. “I’m really sick of the recoveries. The recoveries are the sh *ts.”* The conversation then took an unexpected turn when Hayes discussed his history with drugs and alcohol. He said he never relied on pain medication after his surgeries, explaining that prescription pills were never something he enjoyed taking. “You know what’s funny? I would never take pain medication when I had all those surgeries. I was never a pill guy. I liked cocaine. The only reason I liked cocaine was so I could keep drinking. I hated cocaine without drinking.” When Stephanie brought up the fact that he still needs additional surgery, Hayes confirmed that one of his shoulders is causing him serious problems. Despite everything he’s been dealing with, Hayes has made some major changes to improve his health. He revealed that he started taking Wegovy and using Diamond Dallas Page’s DDP Yoga program, which helped him lose 50 pounds and improve his mobility. “So I got on Wegovy about a year and two months ago, and I started doing DDP Yoga, and man, I’ve dropped 50 pounds, and my mobility is so much better now. So much better. It’s not the hardest thing in the world to do but you get results from it. It’s hard at first. It’s very hard at first. But once you get into the routine… Dallas has made me my own workouts.” Unfortunately, losing weight and improving his mobility haven’t eliminated his joint problems. Hayes admitted that even his previously repaired shoulder still isn’t where he wants it to be. He also revealed that his left hip, which was replaced in 2020, has started giving him trouble again. “My shoulders are horrible. Even the one that got fixed ain’t great. It’s better than it was. I think my expectation level was way too high for all my surgeries. The only one that really worked for me was my hip, because it’s a lot better, yet I feel the left one starting to do the little twinges so that’s probably another thing that I got to look forward to in a couple of years.” Hayes has spent decades in professional wrestling, first as a member of The Fabulous Freebirds and later working behind the scenes in WWE. While he continues contributing to the company as a producer, his latest comments make it clear that his physical health remains an ongoing concern. For now, Hayes is doing what he can to stay active and avoid letting his physical problems slow him down. Dropping 50 pounds has made a difference, but with another shoulder operation

title: JBL Explains Why Vince McMahon Refused To Turn John Cena Heel
raw_title: JBL: Vince McMahon Never Turned John Cena Heel In WWE Due To Previous Lesson Learned
summary_src: JBL believes that it was the botched heel turn of another WWE star that kept Vince McMahon from ever turning Cena.
body: WWE John Cena was the biggest babyface of his generation and is one of the most recognized names from WWE outside of the wrestling industry today, especially after transitioning his career into Hollywood. However, even at the peak of his popularity, many fans criticized his booking, calling for him to either be booked less or turn heel to switch things up. In spite of the fans calling for Cena's heel turn, it would never happen again under Vince McMahon, and fans would only see a heel Cena during TKO's WWE regime. According to John 'Bradshaw' Layfield, the reason McMahon was so against this was after seeing the audience reaction years prior to Cena. "You wonder why they never turned Cena? 'Cause they turned [Stone Cold Steve] Austin, and Austin was, the merch that Austin – Steve – was selling was ridiculous, and Vince learned his lesson," JBL claimed during an episode of " Something To Wrestle ." He further claimed that he sat through many meetings where people brought up Cena turning heel, but McMahon would always immediately dismiss it. Austin's first heel turn at WrestleMania X-Seven was already controversial, but his WCW Invasion heel turn has been criticized over the years, as many noted it made no sense for him to side with WCW while others have recalled that the fans simply didn't accept him as a heel and continued to cheer him. However, as JBL explained, the real reason that WWE walked the decision back was the insane amounts of merch that Austin sold, which would likely have been the same situation with Cena at the height of his fame. 'The Rattlesnake' himself has commented on his WrestleMania X-Seven heel turn in the past, taking ownership of the idea while admitting that it was the worst call he's ever made.
summary: John Bradshaw Layfield said Vince McMahon refused to turn John Cena heel because he had previously turned Stone Cold Steve Austin heel and watched Austin's merchandise sales suffer as a result. JBL recalled sitting in multiple meetings where the idea of Cena turning heel was raised only for McMahon to immediately reject it. Cena remained WWE's top babyface throughout McMahon's tenure and only worked as a heel after TKO took over.

body: WWE and ReelShort collaborated to put out a film titled ‘Agent of Shadows.’ The cast includes Chase Mattson, Drew McIntyre, Marc Herrman, Jacob Fatu, Joe Hendry, Ethan Page, Royce Keys, Booker T, and Michael Hayes, among others. Hayes reflected on his experience filming for the movie while he was chatting with Stephanie McMahon on What’s Your Story? . “I didn’t get a lot of direction but they were very understanding and they let me ad-lib a lot, and I was very thankful and grateful for that. It was quite the experience,” he laughed. “Probably for them more than me.” Hayes spoke about the Assistant Director and how he was not aware that part of that job requires yelling. Hayes initially stated that he was going to start yelling back at the Assistant Director. “It was a good time. It really was. It happened quick. I found out something too. The Assistant Director, they yell a lot, and it got to a point where I go, ‘You know, if you yell at me one more time, I’m gonna f*cking yell back at ya…’ Then somebody explained to me, ‘No, that’s his job,’ and I went, ‘Okay. But if he yells at me one more time…” Hayes laughed.
summary: WWE and ReelShort produced the film Agent of Shadows featuring Drew McIntyre, Jacob Fatu, Joe Hendry, Ethan Page, Booker T and Michael Hayes. While appearing on Stephanie McMahon's What's Your Story? podcast, Hayes said the crew gave him freedom to ad-lib his scenes and described the project as a positive if unusual experience. title: No Imminent AEW Move for Sheamus
raw_title: Backstage update on Sheamus potentially joining AEW
summary_src: There reportedly isn’t a “huge urgency” to bring former WWE star Sheamus into AEW.
body: There reportedly isn’t a “huge urgency” to bring former WWE star Sheamus into AEW. Fightful Select reported on Friday that despite AEW wrestlers such as Claudio Castagnoli and Adam Copeland making it clear they would like to see Sheamus come into the company, it does not appear he will be joining AEW imminently. When asked recently about Sheamus, Fightful’s Sean Ross Sapp said : “There doesn’t seem to be a huge urgency in bringing him in, but there are some heavy hitters like Claudio Castagnoli and Adam Copeland that have made it clear that they would like him there. Sheamus has had talks with other companies. I don’t know if he’s had direct talks with All Elite Wrestling, but nothing seems imminent.” It was previously reported that TNA had reached out to Sheamus about possibly being Moose’s mystery opponent at TNA Bound for Glory. Sheamus’ departure from WWE was announced this summer, with his profile having been moved from WWE’s official roster page to its alumni page in July. Sheamus also posted a farewell message to the company, and his contract expired on October 1. He had been with WWE almost 20 years. During his time in the company, Sheamus was a three-time WWE Champion and a one-time World Heavyweight Champion. title: Indi Hartwell Aims To Inspire Australian Wrestlers As TNA Knockouts Champion
raw_title: Indi Hartwell Looks Forward To Inspiring Aspiring Australian Professional Wrestlers As TNA Knockouts World Champion
summary_src: Indi Hartwell says she looks forward to inspiring Australian professional wrestlers as TNA Knockouts Champion in the future.
body: Indi Hartwell says she looks forward to inspiring Australian professional wrestlers as TNA Knockouts Champion in the future. On October 11th, Indi would challenge for the TNA Knockouts Championship and walked away with the victory at TNA Bound For Glory, capturing the title for the first time in her run in TNA. While speaking to Joey Karni in a new interview, Indi Hartwell spoke about the ups and downs she went through on her way to capturing the TNA Knockouts Championship. “I think a lot of people’s wrestling journeys are roller coasters. There’s a lot of ups. There’s a lot of downs. I had a lot of downs in the past few years, especially from the last Bound For Glory up until now, just working my way back to getting an opportunity like this to finally win the Knockouts title, and I just kind of think that everything happens for a reason. All the bad days come for good, good reasons, you know? So yeah, Everything has been a learning experience. I think it’s coming up on two years since I’ve been gone from WWE, and I’m really happy with everything that I’ve done and everything that I’ve achieved, and, you know, I’m just growing and learning more every day.” Indi would then speak about how important it is to her to capture the Knockouts Championship as an Australian pro wrestler. “It’s pretty crazy to think about because when I talk about my journey in wrestling and when I try to inspire people that they can do what they set out to achieve. I’m a girl from Australia who made it all the way over here, and now I’m the first TNA Knockouts world champion. Like it’s crazy to think about, and I’m so proud of all the Australians because when I was younger watching wrestling, watching WWE and TNA, there weren’t any Australians on TV,, and now we have so many, we have so many Australian champions. title: Ilja Dragunov Explains Choice of Debut Entrance Music
raw_title: Ilja Dragunov explains why he brought back his original entrance music in AEW
summary_src: Ilja Dragunov says the entrance music he used for his AEW debut at WrestleDream brought back memories of the earliest years of his professional wrestling career.
body: Ilja Dragunov says the entrance music he used for his AEW debut at WrestleDream brought back memories of the earliest years of his professional wrestling career. Dragunov made his AEW debut on October 17 with a new entrance presentation featuring “Soviet March,” the same music he used while wrestling on the German independent circuit. Speaking to Ariel Helwani , the former WWE United States Champion explained why the music was so important to him and how it reflects his wrestling persona. “Because it’s putting together so many layers of my persona. I’m Russian-born but German-raised, and I have a lot of roots through to my German side of culture, but also to my family Russian side. And in the beginning, of course, when you try to find your own persona in professional wrestling, everybody was portraying me, of course, when I started, like, okay, you’re the Russian, so we need Russian music,” he said. “But I love classical music, so it has this classical vibe, but it also has this other vibe, and it’s also very heavy. And it also just fits so perfectly with my over-the-top, artsy, orchestra-composer-like persona. It fits just all the boxes. So if you hear this music, it exactly tells you how I perform,” he added. Dragunov said the entrance presentation was developed collaboratively with AEW, with both sides contributing ideas. “That is the best part about this, that since the work has begun, it has been always a collaboration. It has been always working together. So all the ideas that came from the company side and all the ideas that I had in my mind creatively were just flowing so well into one another,” he said. “That was such a beautiful procedure to work. And even just to get one little detail, that was one that touched my heart the most, is that even the entrance music, that it was possible to get this specific entrance music,” Dragunov added. The song accompanied Dragunov during his early career in Germany and remained an important part of his journey through European wrestling before he joined WWE. “This guided me through the youngest, youngest years to my biggest moments that put me on the platform in Europe, got me to the United Kingdom, got me to the States. So much of my career is based on that music. And when I heard this music and did my entrance on Saturday at WrestleDream, I felt like a child again in the business,” he shared. “And I was craving this feeling for a very, very long time.” Following his appearance at WrestleDream, Dragunov made his AEW in-ring debut on the October 21 episode of Dynamite, where he defeated “Speedball” Mike Bailey in the main event. title: JBL Recalls Curt Hennig Drugging Drinks on Plane Ride From Hell
raw_title: JBL Recalls WWE HOFer Spiking Drinks During Infamous 'Plane Ride From Hell'
summary_src: JBL recalled a fellow WWE Hall of Famer drugging others' drinks during the infamous "Plane Ride from Hell" in 2002.
body: WWE The professional wrestling world was quite different behind-the-scenes throughout the 1990s into the early 2000s, with the "Plane Ride from Hell" perhaps the most infamous incident highlighting the culture at the time . Numerous wrestlers caused many, serious issues for flight staff and one another, and WWE Hall of Famer John Bradshaw Layfield recently spoke about the flight on an episode of " Something to Wrestle ." JBL described once getting his drink spiked at a bar in New Orleans, which led to him explaining that it was common for other wrestlers at the time to drug one another's drinks, which he referred to as "gimmicking" the beverage, as a joke. He said it happened on the infamous plane ride, and said it came at the hand of "Mr. Perfect" Curt Hennig. "I saw it, yes. Yeah, absolutely, Plane Ride from Hell," he said. "[Hennig] gimmicked [Jim Ross] and he gimmicked [Gerald] Brisco. JR was passed out a lot of the flight because Curt had stuck the gimmick in his drink. Then, Gerry Brisco, he got Brisco, as well... It was just a matter of guys would get gimmicked and it'd just knock you out. Again, you're drugging people, it's not good, but that's what guys did. Guys would be like, 'Oh my God, I've been gimmicked' and they'd just laugh about it. You almost blamed yourself, because you'd think, 'I didn't take care of my beer bottle.'" He said that unfortunately, the behavior was par for the course at the time. JBL said that the reason a lot of stars from his generation are no longer living could be in part due to the pills and partying that went on during the era.
summary: On an episode of "Something to Wrestle," John Bradshaw Layfield discussed the wild culture of the 1990s and early 2000s wrestling scene. He revealed that spiking drinks, referred to as "gimmicking," was a common prank among wrestlers at the time and occurred during the infamous Plane Ride from Hell. JBL specifically stated that Curt Hennig drugged the drinks of Jim Ross and Gerald Brisco, causing JR to pass out for much of the flight.

kind.quote: I saw it, yes. Yeah, absolutely, Plane Ride from Hell. [Hennig] gimmicked [Jim Ross] and he gimmicked [Gerald] Brisco.

title: Major NFL Stadium Could Host Future AEW All In
raw_title: Major NFL Stadium Could Host Future AEW All In
summary_src: AEW running All In at the home of the Philadelphia Eagles isn’t just some wild fan idea. Bryce Remsburg says Lincoln Financial Field could absolutely be considered for a future All In, and he made a point of saying he’s got some actual insider knowledge behind that answer.
body: Speaking on The Certified Mark Show , the AEW referee and travel department manager was asked whether there’s any hope of the company eventually running the Linc. Remsburg immediately pointed to two things working in Philadelphia’s favor — the stadium already knows how to handle a massive wrestling event, and Philly has been one of AEW’s strongest markets. “I will say the fact they’ve hosted wrestling before, which is WrestleMania, is a positive. That means they know what they’re doing. They know what to do. And I will say Philadelphia has been one of the best AEW markets since it started. So, if we were looking for a domestic stadium to host an All In at, I do think the Linc would be in the conversation.” Fans probably shouldn’t start buying Eagles jerseys for All In just yet, though. Remsburg doesn’t expect AEW to run the stadium next year and admitted he’s not sure the company currently has the demand needed for a building that big. “I don’t think it’s going to happen next year or maybe after that. I’m not sure we have demand for a Linc show. I think [a smaller venue] would be more likely at this point because it’s a little smaller, but never, ever, ever say never. I’ll say that.” That’s already enough to leave the door cracked open, but Remsburg wasn’t finished. When the interviewer said he’d at least given Philadelphia fans some hope, Remsburg doubled down and made it clear this wasn’t just him throwing out a random possibility. “No, I will—there’s no way I could say, ‘No way it’s ever happening.’ Definitely not. It’s absolutely—I’m saying this with actual insider knowledge. It is possible. It’s definitely possible.” That’s obviously a long way from AEW actually booking Lincoln Financial Field. Remsburg himself doesn’t think the timing is right yet, but if AEW goes looking for another U.S. stadium to host All In in the future, Philadelphia could be sitting on the shortlist. For now, the Linc remains a possibility rather than an actual plan. But Remsburg saying it’s “definitely possible” with insider knowledge makes the idea a little more real than simple fan fantasy. title: AEW Dynamite Viewership Drops To 661,000
raw_title: AEW Dynamite Viewership & Ratings Report, 10/21/2026
summary_src: After an action packed WrestleDream pay-per-view, the October 21 episode of "AEW Dynamite" had an interesting week in the TV ratings.
body: AEW/Speedy Ruiz With AEW WrestleDream 2026 in the rear-view mirror, the stars of All Elite Wrestling traveled to Coral Gables, Florida for the October 21 episode of "AEW Dynamite." Ilja Dragunov made a successful in-ring debut against "Speedball" Mike Bailey. Mark Davis and Jake Doyle earned themselves a shot at the AEW World Tag Team Championships, and Queen Aminata also earned herself a shot at Persephone's AEW TBS Championship with a win over the returning Maya World. Despite all of that action, it ended up being a mixed bag in the television ratings department. According to Wrestlenomics , the October 21 episode of "Dynamite" averaged a total of 661,000 viewers, marking a 8% drop from the 715,000 viewers which the first two hours of the three-hour block of programming that aired on October 14 averaged . The show also dropped 12% below the trailing four week average of 752,000 viewers, though the averages for October 2026 and the third quarter of 2026 are above the same periods from last year by 42% and 39% respectively. As always with AEW shows, none of these figures factor in those who streamed the show live on HBO MAX. In the key demographics, there was some positive news for AEW. This past week's "Dynamite" posted a 0.15 number, a 7% increase on the 0.14 number posted seven days earlier, and puts the show back in line with the trailing four week average of 0.15. The average for October 2026 and the third quarter of 2026 also currently sits at a 0.15 number, 67% higher than the same periods last year. As far as where "Dynamite" ranked, only the NBA on ESPN and the WNBA playoffs on the USA Network ranked higher in the 18-49 demo. According to Dave Meltzer, the show also posted a 0.23 number in the 25-54 demographic, also being beaten by the NBA and WNBA games, though he noted that the main event between Dragunov and Bailey which took place after 10PM ET placed second in the demo behind the NBA for that hour.
summary: The October 21 episode of AEW Dynamite from Coral Gables, Florida drew an average of 661,000 viewers according to Wrestlenomics. That total represented an 8 percent decline from the prior week's first two hours and a 12 percent drop from the trailing four-week average. Year-over-year comparisons for October 2026 and Q3 2026 remain up 42 and 39 percent respectively.

title: Royce Keys Blames Jacob Fatu For Creating 946
raw_title: WWE's Royce Keys Explains How Jacob Fatu Is Responsible For The Formation Of 946
summary_src: WWE star Royce Keys says it wasn't his doing to establish 946, but Jacob Fatu's.
body: WWE In Royce Keys' eyes, the blood is all on Jacob Fatu's hands. With the establishment of 946 (Bronco Nima, Lucien Price, Jaida Parker, and the newly recruited Carmelo Hayes ) that forced Fatu to get hit by a car and to be out indefinitely (storyline wise), it appears Keys sees this all as Fatu's doing and not his. On "Notsam Wrestling," the leader of 946 explains their deeply tied background, and how Fatu drove this madness to a head. "I went back to what I used to be. You know, that's all before the positive things. Like, I left Oakland, East Palo Alto. I left all that behind. And you know, there's something that triggered where I had to bring it back...It might have been when Jacob turned his back on me," Keys said. "That might have [been] that instance that made me realize I need to be who I used to be in order to be successful." After the heinous suffering he felt at the hands of Fatu in their street fight match on the August 3 edition of "WWE Raw," Keys said that seeing and tasting his own blood triggered something in him. And now, with feral tendencies on his mind, Keys wants to act on those unconscious impulses once Fatu returns to the ring. "The history's there. People know that I've known Jacob 14, 15 years, right? And when we go at it, there's only one thing that has to be done. Somebody can't get up. 'Cause if you get up, then you know, I didn't do my job...I believe when you're going at it with somebody, you got to put them down...And, you're going to get put down," he concluded.
summary: Royce Keys claims Jacob Fatu is fully responsible for the creation of the 946 faction consisting of Bronco Nima, Lucien Price, Jaida Parker and Carmelo Hayes. Keys told "Notsam Wrestling" that Fatu turning his back on him forced him to revert to his old self from Oakland and East Palo Alto. He added that tasting his own blood after their street fight on the August 3 edition of WWE Raw triggered his current feral mindset.

body: Indi Hartwell is open to reuniting InDex now that she and Shaw share a roster once again in TNA. While Indi Hartwell and Samuel Shaw (then working under the Dexter Lumis ring name) shared a roster in WWE NXT, they would be paired up as part of ‘The Way,’ with the two being married on an episode of WWE NXT. Now, the pair are both on the TNA roster, sparking fan intrigue about a potential future reunion. While speaking to Joey Karni in a new interview, Indi Hartwell spoke about potentially reuniting with Shaw in TNA. “I honestly, I think it’s something that a lot of people want to see with like, anytime I’m at a signing or a convention or a show, someone will bring up how they loved index. It’s even years later, it’s something that is always brought up and like, honestly, for me, it’s probably the most fun I’ve had in my career, and I’m so proud of that storyline. We’re both open to doing something again because I feel like we never really got closure on it. It’s still open. So yeah, I’m interested in doing more with that.” If you use any of the quotes above, please credit and link to the original source with a h/t and link back to Fightful for the transcription.

title: AEW Talent Accused of Ignoring Referee Instructions During Matches
raw_title: AEW Talent Accused of Ignoring Referee Instructions During Matches
summary_src: AEW referees have plenty to worry about during live television, but apparently getting wrestlers to actually listen to them can sometimes be part of the problem.
body: Speaking on The Certified Mark Show , Remsburg explained that referees are constantly receiving instructions through their earpieces during AEW television. Tony Khan is one of several people who can speak directly to him while he’s working a match. “Sure. So I have—there are, I believe, four people that can talk to me. Tony Khan, boss, booker. He’s timing the show. He’s head of creative. Everything he sees and wants is on him.” The show’s director is also feeding Remsburg information about commercial breaks, replays and other production cues. Meanwhile, the match producer and ringside medical staff have their own lines of communication with the referee. “I have the director of the show basically telling us when we’re going to commercial break, telling us when we’re coming out of commercial break, tells me when to hold a belt up to the camera, tells me when I can take the belt down from the camera, tells me when we’re going into replay, all that good stuff.” “I have the coach of the match, which is the producer, coach, whatever you want to call it. They kind of are the conduit between the wrestlers and the television product. They’re telling you what to look out for. They can talk to the camera guys, and then I can talk to the doctor or medical professional that’s at ringside.” Most of what Remsburg then passes along to the wrestlers involves timing, but that’s not all. Referees can also tell talent to adjust their positioning or appearance so everything comes across properly on television. “Most are time-related. But sometimes it’s, you know, ‘Hey, we can’t see your face. Your hair is in your face. Your tag is out on your tights.’ If they’re turned sideways, tell them to turn so hard cam can see that because ultimately what we’re doing is a television product.” Remsburg explained that keeping everything on track is especially important because one match running long can screw with the rest of the show. If the opening match goes several minutes over, everyone scheduled afterwards could end up paying for it. “If the first match goes four or five minutes over time, that’s an egregious sin. You’ve now taken time away from the rest of the show, and that’s not—you know, the wrestlers don’t want to be responsible for that, and the referee doesn’t want to be responsible for the one that’s giving poor messaging. So we’re all just doing our best to keep the ship on track.” That’s where things can occasionally get tricky. Remsburg said Tony Khan and AEW’s coaches understand that referees are doing their best to relay those instructions, but that doesn’t necessarily mean every wrestler is going to listen. “I think that the coach and Tony look out for the referees, definitely. He sees us hustling. He sees what we’re trying to do. The coach understands that, you know, while we are sometimes doing our best to relay messages and make people go on time, some matches are going to go over time. Some wrestlers are going to do their best to listen to the referee. Som

title: Ric Flair Hospitalized After Fall in Tampa
raw_title: WWE Legend Ric Flair Hospitalized After Falling Outside Restaurant, While ‘Dealing’ with Blood Clot in His Leg
body: His daughter Charlotte Flair said in a social media post that the WWE legend is "going to be ok" Flair, 77, had canceled a Seattle appearance hours before the fall as doctors limited his travel due to a blood clot in his leg Ric Flair is recovering in the hospital after a fall outside a restaurant in Florida. The retired WWE legend, 77, was injured in a fall outside Wagamama in Tampa on Friday, Oct. 23, TMZ reported. The incident occurred hours after Flair revealed on Instagram that an upcoming appearance was being canceled due to a blood clot in his leg. In photos obtained by TMZ, Flair is seen lying on his back while surrounded by medical staff. He is also pictured being transported into an ambulance. Flair left his phone and drink behind as he walked across the street after visiting the restaurant that morning, per the outlet. He reportedly cut his head in the fall and his eye was "bleeding extensively." Flair's daughter, WWE wrestler Charlotte Flair , shared an update on his condition in a post on X on Saturday, Oct. 24. "Not my dad telling the doctor he fell bc of warrior dropping him on his head … (ps: he's going to be ok)," she wrote. The wrestling legend had shared a lengthy post about his health, hours before he fell. "I want to sincerely apologize to my agent, Steve Solomon … and especially all my fans in Seattle for having to cancel my scheduled appearance," said Flair. "Unfortunately, I am dealing with a blood clot in my leg, and my doctors have limited my travel to 3–4 hours. Seattle falls outside that range, and as disappointed as I am, I have to put my health and recovery first." "Blood clots are extremely serious and can be life-threatening. We have seen this recently with Jalen Hurts and the complications involving blood clots in his lungs," he continued. "It is a reminder that this is not something to take lightly, and I must follow medical advice." Flair said that he is scheduled to undergo a procedure "to strip the affected vein," which will hopefully allow him to travel more and continue with his work commitments. "Please know this decision was not made lightly. I am truly sorry for the inconvenience and disappointment, and I am incredibly grateful for your patience, understanding, and continued support," he concluded. In June 2025, the former wrestling star revealed to PEOPLE he had skin cancer for "the second time in three years." Flair announced in an Instagram post a month later that he was "cancer-free." PEOPLE has reached out to Flair's representative for comment.
summary: WWE Hall of Famer Ric Flair, 77, fell outside a restaurant in Tampa, Florida on October 23, cutting his head and injuring his eye. The incident came hours after he canceled a Seattle appearance because doctors restricted his travel due to a blood clot in his leg. His daughter Charlotte Flair stated on social media that he is going to be okay.

title: Matt Hardy Says Jeff May Take Time Off For Neck Injury
raw_title: Matt Hardy says Jeff Hardy may take time off due to neck injury
summary_src: Jeff Hardy may be taking some time off from TNA Wrestling to address a nagging neck injury, according to his brother Matt Hardy.
body: Jeff Hardy may be taking some time off from TNA Wrestling to address a nagging neck injury, according to his brother Matt Hardy. In January, Jeff revealed that he had been working with two bulging discs in his neck following The Hardys NXT Tag Team Championship match against DarkState at NXT Halloween Havoc 2025. During a recent episode of The Extreme Life of Matt Hardy, Matt was asked about potentially developing his “Booker Matt” character and responded: “It’s going to be interesting to see what my next character is, especially if Jeff takes a little time off to try and work on his neck a little bit. That may be happening, I guess we’ll see.” “He’s had this bulging disc that’s been bugging him for a year now. I think he’s done everything he can do in his power. I think he’s maybe going to take some time off and see what he can do to get it fixed up and correct it as much as possible.” The last time Jeff wrestled was at TNA’s TV tapings in Dothan, Alabama, on October 13, where he and Matt defeated AJ Francis and Expressions. The Hardys are also coming off a loss to Joseph Sawyer and Samuel Shaw in a Falls Count Anywhere match at TNA Bound for Glory 2026 at the Yuengling Center in Tampa, Florida. title: Three Reasons Bloodline vs The 946 Fits WarGames
raw_title: WWE Survivor Series WarGames 2026: Three Reasons The Bloodline Vs. The 946 Belongs Inside
body: Royce Keys' war with the family dates back to July. At SummerSlam on Aug. 1, LA Knight, Solo Sikoa, and Keys beat Jimmy Uso, Jey Uso, and Jacob Fatu. Fatu won a Street Fight against Keys on the Aug. 3 Raw and kept the Tongan Death Grip locked on after the bell with Reigns' approval. Keys returned on Aug. 24 with Bronco Nima and Lucien Price, the former NXT tag team OTM, and attacked The Usos, Sikoa, and Knight. Keys revealed the trio's name, The 946, in a vignette posted on Sept. 4. Jaida Parker, who aligned with OTM in NXT in January 2024, made a Raw debut on Sept. 28 by running down Fatu with a car in a parking lot. WWE later posted video of the Bloodline member being loaded into an ambulance. Carmelo Hayes joined the group on Oct. 12. The faction has four men, with Parker in its corner. The Bloodline has matched that count. Reigns picked Sikoa to team with The Usos in the Oct. 12 six-man tag team match. On Oct. 19, all four stood together in the ring. WWE has booked five-man teams for each men's WarGames match since 2022, so each side is one man short. A healthy Fatu would give the family a fifth member. The 946 has done most of its damage away from the ring. Keys, Nima, and Price set The Usos' car on fire on the Sept. 7 Raw , then abducted Sikoa on Sept. 21 before a Money in the Bank qualifying match. Neither attack happened inside a ring. Scheduled fights have not contained the feud either. After Reigns retained the World Heavyweight Championship against Knight at Money in the Bank on Oct. 10, The 946 appeared in the crowd. The Usos and Sikoa ambushed the group, and the brawl spilled into the parking lot. Parker drove off with the rest of The 946 in a truck. The Oct. 12 six-man tag match ended in a no contest after Hayes struck Sikoa with a crowbar, with the referee already pulled from the ring by Parker. On the Oct. 19 Raw , The 946 retreated through the crowd after Reigns speared Nima. WarGames takes that option away. The roofless steel cage surrounds two rings, and members enter at timed intervals until both full teams are inside. WWE's version of the match is decided by pinfall or submission. The Bloodline won the first men's WarGames match at Survivor Series on Nov. 26, 2022, in Boston. Reigns, The Usos, Sikoa, and Sami Zayn beat The Brawling Brutes, Drew McIntyre, and Kevin Owens. Jey pinned Owens after a low blow and a Helluva Kick from Zayn. The family split into two sides for the 2024 match in Vancouver. Reigns, The Usos, Zayn, and CM Punk beat a team featuring Sikoa and Fatu. A spear ended the match, with Sikoa taking the pin. Two years later, both former opponents are aligned with Reigns. Reigns and The Usos returned to the cage at Petco Park in San Diego on Nov. 29, 2025. Punk and Cody Rhodes completed the team, which lost to Bron Breakker, Bronson Reed, Logan Paul, McIntyre, and Brock Lesnar. Jey has been in every men's WarGames match at Survivor Series, including a 2023 win alongside Rhodes. What's your take? Post it in our fre
summary: The Bloodline and The 946 have been feuding since July. The rivalry escalated with a SummerSlam six-man tag match, a post-match attack by Jacob Fatu on Royce Keys, and Keys returning with former NXT tag team OTM to form The 946. Jaida Parker and Carmelo Hayes later joined the group while Roman Reigns united with Solo Sikoa, Jimmy Uso and Jey Uso.

title: B-FAB & Michin Shocks on 10/23 WWE SmackDown, Wins Women’s Tag Titles
raw_title: B-FAB & Michin Shocks on 10/23 WWE SmackDown, Wins Women’s Tag Titles
body: October 23, 2026 By Michael Joseph Sugue, Manager SmackDown , News , Pro Wrestling , WWE , WWE Universe , WWE Women This week’s October 23, 2026 WWE SmackDown saw B-FAB and Michin challenge for the WWE Women’s Tag Team Championship, held by Alexa Bliss and Tatum Paxley. It was only two weeks ago that Tater and Lexy won the titles off of Fatal Influence. However, B-FAB and Michin, with Jade Cargill would bring on the pain , and a their tactics, to shock Alexa and Tatum in Ontario, California . The WWE Women’s Tag Team Champions Alexa Bliss and Tatum Paxley looked liked a force when they won the titles off of Lainey Reid and Fallon Henley of Fatal Influence. And that’s why we thought they’d be ready and able to defend their titles for the first time after a stunning showing. Well, this week, they did work like a well-oiled machine, taking control for most of the match. However, the number’s game would soon catch up. One slip from Tatum Paxley and it was game over, as Jade Cargill and her crew had a plan in place all along. Paxley would try to go for the Cemetery Drive, only for Michin to sidestep her at the last moment. With Paxley lying on the second rope, Cargill would blast her. A groggy Paxley would stand before a waiting Michin, as she set her up for the Styles Clash, resulting in B-FAB and Michin becoming #AndNEW WWE Women’s Tag Team Champions. Was it clean? Absolutely not. But all’s fair in love and war . Congratulations to our new WWE Women’s Tag Team Champions, B-FAB and Michin. Puzzling. The word is puzzling. It was a great move for Paxley and Bliss to breathe new life into the division, and now, they’re not champions anymore. It’s not to say B-FAB and Michin are terrible performers, but this was such a random title change that it could definitely hurt their reign as a whole. We don’t know what direction WWE is taking, but this is not a great move with no plans in place. Nevertheless, we are happy B-FAB and Michin are going to make a run; it’s just unfortunate it’s at the expense of Tatum Paxley and Alexa Bliss. body: October 23, 2026 By Michael Joseph Sugue, Manager SmackDown , Pro Wrestling , WWE , WWE Universe ‘Tis the night before the spookiest holiday of the year, Halloween, and this week’s WWE SmackDown preview for October 30, 2026, will give insight into a terrifyingly loaded Friday night in the Charleston Coliseum in Charleston, West Virginia . All announced matches so far are for the richest prizes in all of WWE and AAA. We’re also one week away from WWE Crown Jewel 2026, so expect nothing less than heat when it comes to the Blue brand’s latest edition. Now that you know everything you need to, let’s get this started. Here’s the WWE SmackDown preview for October 30, 2026. Let’s run it down. WWE Women’s Champion Chelsea Green had one heck of a battle on last week’s WWE SmackDown against Roxanne Perez. The “Prodigy” almost had the champion beat after interference from Women’s Intercontinental Champion Raquel Rodriguez. Fortunately for Chelsea, IYO SKY had her back and let her do the work. If Perez had hit the Pop Rocks, she’d be facing Liv Morgan right now. But the Un-Pretty-Her was too much even for the former NXT Women’s Champion to handle. This Friday, there really is no rest for the weary, as Green has a date with Nikki Bella. Nikkie put the champ on notice two weeks ago, saying she’s got next after defeating rival Paige. Bella is a record-breaking WWE Divas Champion and a WWE Hall of Famer. That said, she has not won the WWE Women’s Championship, which haunts her to this day. summary_src: Drew McIntyre recalls meeting Robert Downey Jr as well as Sam Jones in two separate stories of meeting the popular actors.
